title: 第5章 历史唯物主义者与机械唯物主义者

zh: 第5章 历史唯物主义者与机械唯物主义者
en: Chapter 5. HISTORICAL AND MECHANICAL MATERIALISTS

zh: 斯密与恩格斯

迄今为止我们讨论的唯物主义者关注自然世界。他们描述了一个由原子构成的世界，原子运动受自然规律支配。我们今天称这些规律为经典力学，因此可以把这些思想家视为机械唯物主义者。在苏联文献中，“机械唯物主义”一词往往带有相当负面的含义，被视为一种原始理论，后来被辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义取代。随着本书展开，我们将论证这些负面含义没有根据。暂且不论这一点，本节关注两位最有影响的历史唯物主义者：亚当·斯密和弗里德里希·恩格斯。
en: The materialists we have dealt with up to now concerned themselves with the natural world. They described a world made up of atoms whose movements were governed by natural laws. We now call these laws classical mechanics, and we may thus consider these thinkers to have been mechanical materialists. In Soviet literature, the term ‘mechanical materialism’ tended to have a rather negative connotation, as something primitive that was later to be replaced by dialectical and historical materialism. As this book goes on, we will argue that these negative connotations are unjustified. Leaving that aside, this section will concern itself with the ideas of two of the most influential Historical Materialists: Adam Smith and Frederick Engels.

zh: 为什么我们把分别被视为资本主义和共产主义首席倡导者的两位作者归为一类？
en: Why do we group together two authors who are seen respectively as the arch advocates of capitalism and communism?

zh: 因为他们对历史的基本唯物主义方法几乎相同。恩格斯最有影响的著作是《家庭、私有制和国家的起源》
，1884 年出版。斯密关于这一主题的主要著作是《法理学讲义》，可追溯到1760 年代，但直到1978 年才出版。
因此，两位思想家推理中的相似之处是独立发现的结果，尽管恩格斯无疑对斯密的《国富论》有所了解。
en: It is because their basic materialist approach to history was almost the same. Engel’s most influential book was

The similarities in the reasoning of the two thinkers were thus the result of independent discovery, though Engels had undoubtedly some familiarity with Smith’s

zh: 国家源于私有财产
斯密说，政府因阶级不平等而产生。
en: Government, Smith said, arises due to class inequality.

zh: 斯密把社会划分为四个阶段：狩猎、畜牧、农耕和商业社会。前三个阶段与恩格斯所说的“蒙昧”“野蛮”和“文明”阶段相当吻合。到1880 年代，恩格斯已经接触到达尔文著作以及至少部分考古学，因此把狩猎社会划分为几个子阶段。第一子阶段，人类仍生活在热带森林中，至少主要还是树栖。第二阶段，石器和火被使用。狩猎采集社会最后阶段，人们已掌握手工织布和弓箭。
en: Smith conceives of four stages of society: hunting, herding, farming and commercial society. The first three correspond fairly closely to the stages that Engels referred to as savagery, barbarism and civilization. Engels, having access to Darwin and at least some archaeology by the 1880s, divides the hunting stage of society into sub-phases. In the first, man still lived in tropical forests and was primarily at least a tree dweller. In the second phase, stone tools and fire are put to use. In the final phase of hunter-gatherer society, hand weaving and bows and arrows are known.

zh: 斯密把从狩猎向畜牧的转变视为第一次重要过渡。恩格斯在旧大陆方面同意，但指出美洲缺乏驯化绵羊和牛，导致东西半球走上不同发展道路。
en: Smith saw the shift from hunting to herding as the first important transition. Engels agrees with this with respect to the Old World but says that the lack of domesticated sheep and cattle in the Americas led to distinct development paths in the Eastern and Western Hemispheres.

zh: 两人都认为，在生计方式尚无畜牧或农耕的人群中，国家不可能产生。
en: Both agreed that the state cannot arise among a population whose mode of subsistence lacks herding or farming.

zh: 人口极其稀少；仅在部落定居点处较密集，其周围呈大范围圆圈分布着狩猎场，外围则是将该部落与其他部落隔开的中立森林保护带。劳动分工纯粹原始，仅限于两性之间。男子在战争中作战，狩猎捕鱼，获取食物原料及所需工具。妇女负责家务、准备食物和缝制衣物，做饭、织布、缝纫。
en: The population is extremely sparse; it is dense only at the tribe’s place of settlement, around which lie in a wide circle first the hunting grounds and then the protective belt of neutral forest, which separates the tribe from others. The division of labor is purely primitive, between the sexes only. The man fights in the wars, goes hunting and fishing, procures the raw materials of food and the tools necessary for doing so. The woman looks after the house and the preparation of food and clothing, cooks, weaves, sews.

zh: 斯密同样强调人口密度有限的影响。
en: Smith similarly emphasizes the effect of a limited population density.

zh: 在一个以狩猎和捕鱼为生的民族中，很少有人能聚居，因为短时间内任何数量稍多的人群都会耗尽该地区全部猎物，从而失去生存手段。二十到三十个家庭是能聚居的上限，这些家庭共同构成一个村落。但由于他们聚居是为了相互防御和互助，各村落之间距离并不遥远。当不同村庄的人发生争端时，由两个村庄全体大会裁决。正如每个村庄都有自己的首领，整个民族共同体也有一位首领。这一共同体是由不同村庄组成的联盟，各部落首领对决议有重大影响。
en: In a nation of hunters and fishers few people can live together, for in a short time any considerable number would destroy all the game in the country, and consequently would want a means of subsistence. Twenty or thirty families are the most that can live together, and these make up a village. But as they live together for their mutual defence, and to assist one another, their villages are not far distant from each other. When any controversy happens between persons of different villages, it is decided by a general assembly of both villages. As each particular village has its own leader, so there is one who is the leader of the whole nation. The nation consists of an alliance of the different villages, and the chieftains have great influence on their resolutions

zh: 双方都认为，正是向畜牧的转变导致不平等。斯密描述如下：
en: Both agree that it is the transition to herding that gives rise to inequality. Smith described this process as follows:

zh: 在一个狩猎民族中，严格来说根本不存在政府。这个社会由少数独立家庭组成，他们居住在同一个村庄，说着同一种语言，并为了共同安全而商定团结在一起，但彼此之间并无权威。整个社会都会关注任何犯罪行为；如果可能，他们会让当事人和解；如果无法和解，就会将犯罪者驱逐出社会，处死，或交由受害者发泄怨恨。但这并非正规政府，因为尽管其中可能有人备受尊敬并在决策中有很大影响，但未经全体同意，他绝不能做任何事。
en: In a nation of hunters there is properly no government at all. The society consists of a few independent families who live in the same village and speak the same language, and have agreed among themselves to keep together for their mutual safety, but they have no authority one over another. The whole society interests itself in any offence; if possible they make it up between the parties, if not they banish from their society, kill or deliver up to the resentment of the injured him who has committed the crime. But this is no regular government, for though there may be some among them who are much respected, and have great influence in their determinations, yet he never can do anything without the consent of the whole.

zh: 正是牲畜的私有化导致财富不平等，这也正是正规政府产生的最初原因。在出现私有财产之前，不可能有政府，而政府的最终目的正是保障财富，并保护富人免受穷人侵害。
en: The appropriation of herds and flocks which introduced an inequality of fortune, was that which first gave rise to regular government . Till there be property there can be no government, the very end of which is to secure wealth, and to defend the rich from the poor.

zh: 最后一句——政府职能是保障财富并保护富人免受穷人侵害——对历史唯物主义的阐述之清晰，堪比列宁。
en: That last phrase that the function of government is to secure wealth and defend the rich from the poor is as clear an expression of historical materialism as you would get from Lenin.

zh: 斯密把动物驯化与私有财产直接联系起来，他说：“富人已把这些如今已驯服的猎物据为己有。”正是使原本野生的牛群被驯化的过程，消除了它们作为猎人潜在猎物的可能性。斯密在此运用了“原始积累”概念——一个阶级掠夺财富，另一个阶级因此陷入贫困——这一概念将在马克思对资本主义的分析中再次出现。
en: Smith directly links the domestication of animals to private property saying: ‘the rich had made the game, now become tame, their own property’. The very process that makes previously wild cattle domesticated eliminates them as potential prey animals for hunters. Smith is deploying a concept of ‘primitive accumulation’ as simultaneously appropriation by one class and pauperizing another that will recur in Marx’s analysis of capitalism.

zh: 根据《讲义》，在畜牧社会中，财富皆可携带，并以牲畜形式积累。与后来能把财富消耗为奢侈品的统治者不同，一个没有定居制造业的社会几乎无法提供奢侈品。因此，酋长的财富表现为对那些自身缺乏足够牲畜的依附者的影响力。穷人完全依赖酋长恩惠。游牧生活与酋长权威结合，导致无休止战争。
en: According to the

, in a herding society, wealth is all portable and accumulates in the form of animals. Unlike later rulers who can consume wealth as luxuries, a society without settled manufactures provides few luxury goods. The wealth of the chiefs thus takes the form of influence over dependents who lack sufficient animals of their own. The poor are fully dependent on the benevolence of the chiefs. The combination of nomadism and chiefly authority generates incessant warfare.

zh: 猎人的壮举，尽管勇敢英武，却从未十分惊人。由于他们很少能集体行军，人数极少超过200 人，即便这200 人也难以维持超过十四天。因此，一个由猎人组成的民族几乎不会构成威胁。我们的殖民地对他们极为恐惧，却毫无正当理由。他们确实可能通过突袭和远征给殖民地带来一些麻烦，但绝不会构成真正威胁。另一方面，数量庞大的牧民却能聚居生活。同一个村庄里可能有上千户人家。阿拉伯人和鞑靼人——他们历来以牧业为生——曾多次造成极其惨烈的破坏。鞑靼首领极其可怕，当其中一人战胜另一人时，总会引发最可怕、最激烈的动乱。他们会带着全部牛羊群随行出征，凡战败者，既失去部族，也失去财富。获胜一方则追随其畜群，继续征服；如果他们带着如此庞大的人数进入耕作区，那简直无人能挡。穆罕默德正是以这种方式蹂躏了整个亚洲。
en: The exploits of hunters, though brave and gallant, are never very considerable. As few of them can march together, so their number seldom exceeds 200 men, and even these cannot be supported above fourteen days. There is therefore very little danger from a nation of hunters. Our colonies are much afraid of them without any just grounds. They may indeed give them some trouble by their inroads and excursions, but can never be very formidable. On the other hand a much greater number of shepherds can live together. There may be a thousand families in the same village. The Arabs and Tartars, who have always been shepherds, have on many occasions made the most dreadful havoc. A Tartar chief is extremely formidable, and when one of them gets the better of another, there always happens the most dreadful and violent revolutions. They take their whole flocks and herds into the field along with them, and whoever is overcome loses both his people and wealth. The victorious nation follows its flocks, and pursues its conquest, and if it comes into a cultivated country with such numbers of men, it is quite irresistible. It was in this manner that Mahomet ravaged all Asia.

zh: 因此，在畜牧业作为主要财富形式的时代，各酋长国往往倾向于掠夺和无休止小规模战争。在他看来，这不仅符合鞑靼人（蒙古人）和阿拉伯人的历史社会，也符合荷马所描述的希腊英雄社会。他指出，荷马所描述的所有财产纠纷都与牲畜有关。
en: So during the ages when cattle herding was the predominant form of wealth, you had chiefdoms that were prone to raiding and incessant minor warfare. In his opinion, this corresponded not only to the historic societies of the Tartars (Mongols) and the Arabs but also to the heroic Greek society described by Homer. He notes that all property disputes described by Homer are over cattle.

zh: 随着农业地位日益重要，游牧生活变得难以维系，但牛群仍是最重要财富储备。社会现在能生产剩余产品，理论上可与邻近部落交易，但牛群始终面临被邻近部落盗窃的风险。这迫使人们建造设防聚落，以便冲突时期将人和牲畜迁入其中。设防城镇的人口比当地酋长所统治的聚落更多，通常由几个小部落组成。虽然该城镇最初政体由一位酋长居于至高地位，但很快被共和制取代。
en: As agriculture becomes more significant, nomadism becomes impossible, but the most significant store of wealth is still cattle. Society is now able to produce a surplus, which can potentially be traded with neighbouring tribes, but cattle are constantly subject to the risk of being stolen by neighbouring tribes. This forces the construction of fortified settlements into which the people and beasts can move in times of conflict. A fortified town has a bigger population than those that local chiefs ruled over, typically comprising several small tribes. While the first form of government of the town places one chief in a supreme position it is soon replaced by a republican form of state.

zh: 居住在这样国家的人民，当土地划分完成且耕作普遍开展时，自然会把产品剩余部分分销给邻近部落，这将刺激他们的生产热情。但与此同时，这也可能诱使邻近部落对他们发动侵袭。因此，他们必须想出某种方法来保障自身安全，并守护那些曾耗费巨大心力才获得的成果。在交通便利之处修筑一座城池，比加固整个国家边境要容易得多，因此他们便采用这种方法。他们在最便利的地方修建设防城池，每当遭到入侵时，便带着牲畜和动产躲进城中，并在那里发展工艺和科学。与此相符的是，我们发现忒修斯加固了雅典防御，并命令阿提卡人将所有财物运入城内，这不仅增强了他对民众的控制力，也提升了该城邦相对于其他城邦的权威。当人们以这种方式同意定居城镇后，各氏族酋长很快就会失去权威，政体也会转向共和制，因为他们的收入微薄，无法使自己显得如此显赫、与众不同，以致于能让民众继续依赖他们。公民财富逐渐增加，随着其地位日益接近酋长，便开始嫉妒酋长的权威。因此，我们可以看到，忒修斯本人最终也被赶下了台。
en: A people inhabiting such a country, when the division of land came to take place and the cultivation of it to be generally practised, would naturally dispose of the surplus of their product among their neighbours, and this would be a spur to their industry. But at the same time it would be a temptation to their neighbours to make inroads upon them. They must therefore fall upon some method to secure themselves from danger, and to preserve what it formerly cost them so much trouble to procure. It would be more easy to fortify a town in a convenient place than to fortify the frontiers of the whole country, and accordingly this was the method they fell upon. They built fortified towns in the most convenient places, and whenever they were invaded took shelter in them with their flocks and moveable goods, and here they cultivated the arts and sciences. Agreeable to this, we find that Theseus fortified Athens and made the people of Attica carry into it all their goods, which not only increased his power over them, but also the authority of that state above others. When people agreed in this manner to live in towns, the chieftains of the several clans would soon lose their authority, and the government would turn republican, because their revenue was small, and could not make them so conspicuous and distinguished above others as to retain them in dependence. The citizens gradually increase in riches, and coming nearer the level of the chieftain, become jealous of his authority. Accordingly we find that Theseus himself was turned out.

zh: 此后，设立了九位摄政官，起初他们拥有终身权力，但后来任期被缩短为十年。就这样，雅典以及所有希腊城邦，都从酋长制演变为类似君主制的政体，进而发展为贵族制。
en: After this nine regents were set up who were at first to have authority for life, but were afterwards continued only for ten years. Thus Athens, and in like manner all the Greek states, came from a chieftainship to something like monarchy, and from thence to aristocracy.

zh: 恩格斯描述了同样过程，尽管他遗漏了斯密指出的某些经济和军事演变。须知，尽管斯密著作问世较早，但恩格斯当时无法接触到这些著作，而且恩格斯并非像马克思或斯密那样具有重要地位的经济学家。
en: Engels describes the same process, though he misses out on some of the economic and military processes that Smith identified. Remember that although Smith’s work was earlier, Engels did not have access to it, and Engels was not an economist of the stature of Marx or Smith.

zh: 据称由忒修斯制定的宪法由此问世。该宪法带来的主要变革是在雅典建立中央权威——即，此前由各部落独立管理的部分事务被宣布为公共事务，并委托给设在雅典的共同议会处理。通过采取这一步骤，雅典人走得比美洲任何土著民族都更远：他们没有像邻近部落那样仅仅组成一个简单邦联，而是融合成一个单一民族。由此诞生了共同的雅典民法，其地位凌驾于各部落和氏族的法律习俗之上。
en: The constitution ascribed to Theseus was introduced. The principal change which it made was to set up a central authority in Athens – that is, part of the affairs hitherto administered by the tribes independently were declared common affairs and entrusted to the common council sitting in Athens. In taking this step, the Athenians went further than any native people of America had ever done: instead of neighboring tribes forming a simple confederacy, they fused together into one single nation. Hence arose a common Athenian civil law, which stood above the legal customs of the tribes and gentes.

zh: 据称，忒修斯采取的第二项措施是把全体人民——无论所属氏族、胞族或部落——划分为三个阶层：贵族（eupatridai）、农民（geomoroi）和手工业者（demiourgoi），而担任公职的权利则完全归属于贵族阶层。除了贵族担任公职这一规定外，这种划分并未产生实际作用，因为它并未在阶级之间建立任何其他法律上的区别。然而，这一划分之所以重要，是因为它揭示了那些此前未被察觉的新兴社会要素。这表明，某些家族成员惯常被任命担任氏族公职的做法，已经演变为这些家族几乎无可争议的任职权利；这表明，这些家族凭借财富已然强大，开始在氏族之外形成群体，成为一个独立的特权阶级，而正在成形的国家则认可了这种僭越。
en: By a second measure ascribed to Theseus, the entire people, regardless of gens, phratry or tribe, was divided into three classes: eupatridai, or nobles, geomoroi, or farmers, and demiourgoi, or artisans, and the right to hold office was vested exclusively in the nobility. Apart from the tenure of offices by the nobility, this division remained inoperative, as it did not create any other legal distinctions between the classes. It is, however, important because it reveals the new social elements which had been developing unobserved. It shows that the customary appointment of members of certain families to the offices of the gens had already grown into an almost uncontested right of these families to office; it shows that these families, already powerful through their wealth, were beginning to form groupings outside their gentes as a separate, privileged class, and that the state now taking form sanctioned this presumption.

zh: 据斯密，尽管希腊人和罗马人最初实行贵族制政府——其贵族家族可追溯至城市化之前的酋长阶层——但有两个经济进程促使国家逐渐向更共和的形式转变。
en: According to Smith, while the Greeks and the Romans initially had aristocratic forms of government, with the aristocratic families inherited from the pre-urban class of chiefs, two economic processes tended to shift the state towards a more republican form.

zh: 其一是奴隶制存在。这使自由但非贵族的公民能出席公民大会，而他们的奴隶则负责照料农场或作坊。他把此与更现代的意大利和荷兰共和国对比，指出后者完全由贵族阶层统治。
en: The first was the existence of slavery. This allowed free, but non-aristocratic citizens to attend the assembly while their slaves minded the farm or workshop. He contrasts this with the more modern Italian and Dutch republics which, he says, were exclusively run by the aristocracy.

zh: 其次，劳动分工的发展和奢侈品生产意味着贵族养活的随从减少，转而把财富用于奢侈消费。由于减少了对依附者的开支，他们在公民大会上左右投票结果的能力也随之减弱。民粹主义者推动允许平民当选公职。由于这两大经济进程，在罗马和希腊，民选公职都向非贵族公民开放了。
en: Secondly, the development of the division of labour and the production of luxury goods meant that the aristocrats supported fewer retainers, choosing instead to spend their wealth on luxuries. Since they spent less on their clients, their ability to swing votes in the assembly diminished. Populists pushed to allow plebs to be elected to office. As a result of these two economic processes, in both Rome and Greece, elected offices became open to non-noble citizens.

zh: 我们在此看到一种社会模式：政治形式因物质生活方式的变迁而产生并演变。不仅如此，用恩格斯和马克思的话来说，这些城市文明社会的历史，就是一部阶级斗争史。
en: What we have here is a model of society in which political forms arise and change as a result of the mode of material life. Not only that, the history of these urban, civilized societies is, to paraphrase Engels and Marx, a history of class struggles.

zh: 斯密还意识到，任何形式的宪法或政府在历史上都是暂时的。每一种政治和经济形式都会在其内部孕育出最终导致其覆灭的进程。谈到罗马帝国覆灭时，他写道：
en: Smith was also aware that any form of constitution or government was historically transitory. Each political and economic form generated within itself the processes which would ultimately lead to its downfall. Speaking of the fall of the Roman Empire, he wrote:

zh: 我们现在要说明，这种军事君主制如何也遭遇了等待每一个国家和宪法的命中注定的解体。
en: We come now to show how this military monarchy came to share that fated dissolution that awaits every state and constitution whatever.

zh: 每个时期导致解体的具体冲突各不相同，但某些共同主题反复出现。劳动分工的发展使上层阶级能把更多资金用于奢侈品。在封建制度下，这种奢侈消费增长意味着贵族用于维持随从的开支减少。随着随从队伍缩减，他们的军事影响力也减弱，这为近代早期专制君主制兴起创造了条件。他的论点是，王室收入如此庞大，以至于国王很难把所有收入都花在奢侈品上。总会有部分资金留作军费开支，而随着男爵们转而建造豪华宅邸，而非在简朴大厅里养活大批随从，王室军事力量便取得胜利。
en: For each period, the specific conflicts that led to the dissolution were different, but certain common themes recur. The development of the division of labour allows the upper classes to spend more on luxuries. Under feudalism, this growth in luxury consumption meant that the aristocrats had less to spend on retainers. As their retinues declined, so too did their military influence, allowing the growth of the absolute monarchies of the early modern period. His argument being that the revenues of the Crown were so large that it was hard for a king to spend it all on luxuries. Some was always left over for the army, and as the barons built luxury homes rather than maintaining hordes of retainers in simple halls, the military Power Royal was triumphant.

zh: 在论述罗马衰落时，他也运用了这一“经济发展导致军事变革”的主题。随着社会日益“文明”，人们逐渐习惯家庭生活中的奢华，“他们便不再热衷于打仗”。一个经济发达的国家会发现，若把从事制造业的人口动员起来参战，其税收收入将受到影响；而一个蛮族社会或纯粹农业社会，则可以在播种与收获之间的夏季空档期把男子送上战场。游牧牧民最能动员全体民众进行征服，因为他们没有不动产，整个民族都可以出征征服。正因如此，从邻近蛮族国家征召士兵比从罗马公民中征召更廉价，而且这样做不会损害罗马工业。蛮族军队首领们最终发现，他们可以把武器对准罗马政府，并成为这个国家的统治者。
他声称，这一过程反复发生：
en: This same theme of economic development leading to military change was deployed in his account of the fall of Rome. As society became more ‘polite’ and people became acquainted with domestic luxury, ‘they become less fond of going to war’. An economically developed state finds that its tax revenues are hurt if it mobilizes its manufacturing population for war, while a barbarian society or a purely agricultural one can send its men off to war during the summer gap between sowing and harvest. Nomadic herdsmen were the most able to mobilize their entire populations for conquest, since they had no immovable possessions and the entire nation could venture forth to conquer. So it was that soldiers could be recruited more cheaply from among the barbarian nations nearby than from among the Roman citizens, and this could be done without harm to the industries of the Romans. The leaders of the barbarian armies, in due course, found that they could turn their arms against the Roman government and make themselves masters of the country.
This process, he claimed, happened repeatedly:

zh: 所有亚洲政权都是以同样方式瓦解的。他们的士兵是从鞑靼地区雇来的，手工业和制造业得以持续，人民靠经商获得的收益比参战更多。
en: In the same manner all the Asiatic governments were dissolved. Their soldiers were hired from Tartary, arts and manufactures were carried on, the people made more by their trades than by going to war.

zh: 关于“亚洲政权”覆灭的叙述中，可见哈勒敦
的回响；然而，斯密的分析植根于更广阔的历史唯物主义理论中，其视野从狩猎社会延伸至资本主义，这一宏大视角在恩格斯和马克思著作中再次显现。当一位唯物主义者似乎在延续前人已开始探索的思想时——无论是阿基米德和牛顿对无穷小的运用，哈勒敦和斯密对劳动价值的探讨，还是斯密和恩格斯关于生产方式演进的论述——人们往往会倾向于认为这是一种思想传承，而非重新发明。
鉴于《导论》在18 世纪仅有阿拉伯语版本，而《法理学讲义》直到恩格斯去世很久之后才面世，这一推测似乎缺乏依据。
en: There are echoes of Khaldun

in the account of the fall of ‘Asiatic governments’, Smith’s analysis, however, is set within a much broader historical materialist theory, going from hunting society to capitalism, a vast perspective that reappears in the work of Engels and Marx. When one materialist appears to extend ideas that an earlier one started to work on, whether it be the use of infinitesimals by both Archimedes and Newton, labour value in Khaldun and Smith or the progression of modes of production in Smith and Engels, there is a temptation to suppose that transmission not reinvention was involved.
Since the Al-Muqaddimah was only available in Arabic in the eighteenth century, and the Lectures on Jurisprudence only became available long after Engels was dead, this seems unsupported.

zh: 狄德罗的非人类中心主义唯物主义世界观

狄德罗的唯物主义可以被称为——沿用托马斯·奈尔的术语——“运动唯物主义”：运动是有机物质产生的驱动力，也是惰性物质向有机（生命）物质转变的动力。与包括亚里士多德在内的传统哲学观点不同，狄德罗并未把运动和变化定义为“空间位移”——这种定义以把空虚空间等同于本体论虚无为前提，从而排除了（或如亚里士多德那样，瘫痪了）任何关于变化与运动的思考尝试（本书第二章对此有论述）。与热相关的物理过程——这一特定“热力学”论点
，正是狄德罗与达朗贝尔对话的核心——催生了日益复杂的有机生命，而人类与动物之间的差异仅被视为程度问题。这一切的基础是物质，而第一且不可分割的构成单元是原子。
en: Diderot’s materialism is what one might call, following Thomas Nail’s use of the term, kinetic materialism:
is behind the creation of organic matter, or the transition from inert to organic (living) matter. Differently from the traditional philosophical views, including Aristotle’s, Diderot does not define

and change as ‘displacement in place’ premised on the equation of empty space and ontological nothingness which precluded, or paralysed as in the case of Aristotle, any attempt to think about change and movement (discussed in Chapter 2 of this book). Physical processes linked to heat – a particular ‘thermodynamic’ thesis,

at the centre of Diderot’s dialogue with D’Alembert – lead to the creation of organic life in its ever-increasing complexity, while the difference between human and animal is seen only as a matter of degree. The foundation of it all is material, and the first and indivisible building bloc is the atom.

zh: 但且看一枚蛋。这正是对世间所有神学派别和所有神庙的驳斥。这枚蛋是什么？在胚胎被植入之前，它只是一团无感的物质；而当胚胎被植入后，它又变成了什么？依然是一团无感的物质，因为胚胎本身也仅仅是一种惰性的、原始的液体。这团物质是如何形成不同的组织结构，从而获得感知和生命的？靠的是热量。而热量又由什么产生？运动。
en: But take an egg. This is what refutes all the schools of theology and all the temples on earth. What is this egg? A mass that is insensible until the embryo is introduced into it, and when this embryo is introduced, what is it then? An insensible mass, for in its turn, this embryo is only an inert and crude liquid. How does this mass arrive at a different organisation, arrive at sensibility and life? By means of heat. And what produces heat? Motion.

zh: 此外，狄德罗在与达朗贝尔的上述对话中指出，感觉内在于物质本身。简而言之，狄德罗解释道，一切认知都取决于物质性生命成分的组织结构——这种组织结构源于感觉，进而形成具有不同认知能力的各类有机体（例如动物与人类）。引用狄德罗本人的话（也是作为引述对话中的人物，对达朗贝尔的回应）：“一个能解释一切的简单假设，即感觉能力是物质的普遍属性，或是其组织结构的产物。”
至于人类与动物的区别，就认知而言，狄德罗的表述十分明确：
en: Furthermore, sensation, argues Diderot in the already cited dialogue with D’Alembert, is built into matter itself. In short, Diderot explains that all cognition depends on the organization of the material living components as they ensue from sensation, which amounts to different forms of organisms (animal, for example, vversus humans) with different cognitive faculties. To quote Diderot himself (also as the character appearing in the cited dialogue, responding to D’Alembert): ‘a simple supposition which explains everything, namely, that the faculty of sensation is a general property of matter, or a product of its organisation’.
As far as the difference between human and animal is concerned, as far as cognition is concerned, Diderot is explicit:

zh: 你是否会像笛卡尔那样坚持认为，这不过是一台简单的模仿机器？小孩子都会嘲笑你，而哲学家们则会反驳说：如果这是台机器，那么你自己也是一台机器。如果你承认这些动物与你的区别仅仅在于组织形式，你就证明了自己的常识和睿智，你就是对的。但这将引出一个对你不利的结论，即：由以某种方式组织起来的无生命物质，在热和运动的作用下，被另一部分无生命物质渗透，从而产生了感觉、生命、记忆、意识、情感和思想。狄德罗接着说，二者必居其一：要么承认蛋中存在某种“隐秘元素”，它在发育的某个阶段以未知方式渗入其中——这种元素究竟是否占据空间、是否具有物质性，抑或是否专为此目的而创造，目前尚无定论——这与常识相悖，并会导致自相矛盾和荒谬；要么我们必须提出一个简单的假设，这个假设能解释一切，即感觉能力是物质的普遍属性，或是其组织结构的产物。（狄德罗致达朗贝尔）
小孩子会嘲笑你，而哲学家们会反驳说：如果这是台机器，那么你也是台机器。如果你承认这些动物与你的区别仅在于组织结构，你将证明你的常识和机智，你也是对的。但由此将得出一个对你不利的结论：即，由以某种方式组织起来的惰性物质，通过热和运动与另一部分惰性物质相互作用，从而产生了感觉、生命、记忆、意识、情感和思想。
en: Would you maintain with Descartes that this is a simple imitating machine? Little children will laugh at you, and the philosophers will reply that if this be a machine then you too are a machine. If you admit that the difference between these animals and you is only one of organisation, you will prove your common sense and sagacity, you will be right. But from this will follow a conclusion against you; namely, that from inert matter organised in a certain way, impregnated with another bit of inert matter, by heat and motion—sensibility, life, memory, consciousness, emotion, and thought are generated. One of the two, continues Diderot, either admit some ‘hidden element’ in the egg, that penetrates to it in an unknown way at a certain stage of development, an element about which it is unknown whether it occupies space, whether it is material or whether it is created for the purpose – which is contradictory to common sense, and leads to inconsistencies and absurdities; or we must make a simple supposition which explains everything, namely, that the faculty of sensation is a general property of matter, or a product of its organisation. (Diderot to D’Alembert)

Little children will laugh at you, and the philosophers will reply that if this be a machine then you too are a machine. If you admit that the difference between these animals and you is only one of organisation, you will prove your common sense and sagacity, you will be right. But from this will follow a conclusion against you; namely, that from inert matter organised in a certain way, impregnated with another bit of inert matter, by heat and motion—sensibility, life, memory, consciousness, emotion, and thought are generated.

zh: 当代实验哲学借鉴认知科学（包括进化生物学）的成果，证明“抽象”或模式识别不仅发生在蛋白质物质和细胞组织层面，
也发生在其他层面，例如蜜蜂的计数能力。
借用狄德罗的话来说，高等“物理组织”形式——即人类以外的动物——具备“抽象”或识别数学模式甚至计数的能力，这在21世纪绝非一个有争议的观点。
除了所谓新理性主义者对“理性”的形而上学遐想之外，
几乎没有任何科学哲学或与认知科学这一跨学科、多学科领域相关的科学本身，会把“理性”视为人类独有能力。正如“自然”或“情感”等与其相对的概念一样，“理性”这一概念已被当代科学视为过时概念——它们都是同一信息生态系统连续体的一部分。
en: Contemporary experimental philosophy, operating with knowledge from the cognitive sciences including evolutionary biology, demonstrates that ‘abstracting’ or pattern recognition happens on the level of protein mass and cell organization,
as it does on the level of, for example, bee’s ability of counting.

The ability of the higher forms of ‘physical organization’, to paraphrase Diderot, that is, of the animals other than humans, to ‘abstract’ or to recognize mathematical patterns and even count, in the twenty-first century, is by no means a controversial idea.
Apart from the metaphysical reveries of Reason among the so-called neo-rationalists,

hardly any philosophy of science or the sciences themselves linked with the interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary area of cognitive sciences believes in Reason as the exclusive faculty of humanity. Reason has been rendered obsolete as a notion by contemporary science just as its opposites, such as nature or emotion, have been – they are all part of the same continuum of informational ecosystems.

zh: 感觉、认知和心理设计源于物质基础，因此，借用马克思的术语来说
，“人类作为类存在”的社会关系的“目的”，正是物质必然性的产物，旨在维持和扩展生命，或者说其“形式”——即亚里士多德所定义的特定“自动机”，一种自运动、自维持的系统（这是我对马克思定义的转述，或者更确切地说，是我的诠释）。用马克思自己的话来说：
en: Sense, cognition and mental design are derived from the material foundation, and thus the ‘purpose’ of social relations of the ‘species being of humanity’, to borrow Marx’s term,

is the product of material necessity to sustain and expand life or its ‘form’ as design of particular ‘automaton’, self-moved and self-sustained system, as Aristotle would define it (my paraphrase or rather interpretation of Marx’s definition). In Marx’s own words:

zh: 人之所以是“类存在”（Gattungswesen），不仅因为他在实践和理论中把物种（包括他自身以及其他事物的物种）作为其对象，而且——这只是另一种表述方式——还因为他把自己视为实际的、活生生的类；因为他把自己视为一种普遍的、因而也是自由的存在。无论在人类还是动物身上，物种的生命在生理上都体现在这样一个事实：人（如同动物一样）依赖有机自然而生存；而人（或动物）越是普遍，他赖以生存的无机自然领域就越普遍。正如植物、动物、石头、空气、光等在理论上构成人类意识的一部分——部分作为自然科学对象，部分作为艺术对象——即他必须先加以加工才能使其可口且易于消化的精神上的无机自然、精神上的养分——同样，在实践领域中，它们也构成人类生活和人类活动的一部分。从生理上讲，人仅靠这些自然产物维生，无论它们以食物、取暖、衣物、住所等形式出现。人的普遍性在实践中恰恰体现在这种普遍性上，即使整个自然成为他的无机躯体——既因为自然是（1）他直接的生活手段，也是（2）他生活活动的物质、对象和工具。自然是人的无机躯体——即自然本身并非人体的那一部分。人依靠自然生存——这意味着自然就是他的身体，若不想死亡，他就必须与之保持持续交流。人的肉体和精神生活与自然相联，这仅仅意味着自然与自身相联，因为人是自然的一部分。
en: Man is a species-being [Gattungswesen], not only because in practice and in theory he adopts the species (his own as well as those of other things) as his object, but – and this is only another way of expressing it – also because he treats himself as the actual, living species; because he treats himself as a universal and therefore a free being. The life of the species, both in man and in animals, consists physically in the fact that man (like the animal) lives on organic nature; and the more universal man (or the animal) is, the more universal is the sphere of inorganic nature on which he lives. Just as plants, animals, stones, air, light etc constitute theoretically a part of human consciousness, partly as objects of natural science, partly as objects of art – his spiritual inorganic nature, spiritual nourishment which he must first prepare to make palatable and digestible – so also in the realm of practice they constitute a part of human life and human activity. Physically man lives only on these products of nature, whether they appear in the form of food, heating, clothes, a dwelling etc. The universality of man appears in practice precisely in the universality which makes all nature his inorganic body – both inasmuch as nature is (1) his direct means of life, and (2) the material, the object, and the instrument of his life activity. Nature is man’s inorganic body – nature, that is, insofar as it is not itself human body. Man lives on nature – means that nature is his body, with which he must remain in continuous interchange if he is not to die. That man’s physical and spiritual life is linked to nature means simply that nature is linked to itself, for man is a part of nature.

zh: 作为生命的物质活动，把有机和无机物质（自然或“自然”——这一自然概念既远离德国唯心主义的浪漫理解，也不同于费尔巴哈的唯物主义）视为人类本质的延伸或定义，或者说与之构成一种生态统一体。因此，本质与目的——即物种的存在——在于维持和扩展生命；而生命既包含有机部分也包含无机部分，它既由人类活动决定，也由其非人类的延伸或扩展——即向自然与技术共同决定的生态系统中的延伸或扩展——所决定。生命是机械的，因此从这个意义上说它是无机的，而非笛卡尔那种把动物等同于可鄙钟表式机器的还原论等式所指的无机（与有机、自然的——仿佛被一种崇高或神性实体驱动——相对）。它是“mekhane”或“techne”的产物，即拼接任何形式物质所固有的并持续执行的信息片段——从蛋白质折叠到所谓自然语言的语音学——因此，“有机”仅仅是程度问题，而非与“机械”在实质上的差异。尽管如此，在我们凭常识以及某些更古老科学语言所指代的“生命”之间，既存在连续性，也存在仅是程度上的差异而非本质上的差异。这正是当代科学所教导我们的，正如原子论者——尤其是伊壁鸠鲁学派的卢克莱修——以及青年马克思和列宁所揭示的那样。
en: The material activity which is life treats organic and inorganic matter (nature or ‘nature’, as this notion of nature is far from the romantic understanding of German idealism, as well as from Feuerbach’s materialism) as an extension of the substance or definition of humanity or rather constitutes an ecological unity with it. Thus, the essence and the purpose – the being of the species – consist in sustaining and expanding life, whereas life is both organic and inorganic and it is determined by activity both human and its inhuman extension or expansion into the co-determining ecosystem of nature and technology. Life is mechanic, and it is thus inorganic in that sense and not in the sense of the Cartesian reductionist equation of the animal and the contempt-worthy clock-like machine (as opposed to the organic, natural as if moved by a sublime or godlike substance). It is the product of the
or

of piecing bits of information any form of matter is endowed with and perpetually executes – ranging from protein folding to phonetics of the so-called natural languages – and thus the ‘rganic’ is merely a matter of degree, not of substantive difference from the ‘mechanic’. Still, there is a continuity and also difference of mere degree and not of substance between what we commonsensically and in some more archaic scientific language mean by ‘life’. This is what the contemporary science teaches us as did the atomists, in particular the Epicurean Lucretius, as well as young Marx and Lenin.

zh: 在此意义上所说的“目的”或“telos”，显然并非线性的，它并不作为“目的因”（causa finalis）发挥作用，因此我们无法确定能否将其称为“telos”。鉴于目前尚无更恰当术语，我们将暂且使用这一术语。在《偶然性与递归性》中，许煜解释说，按照德国唯心主义（特别是谢林）的理解，有机体或自然的“telos”归根结底是一种永恒的偶然性与递归性，这与我们视为计算自动机奠基原则的那些特性如出一辙。尽管许煜秉持谢林和唯心主义立场，但其分析所揭示的运作机制表明，“理想”与自然密不可分。此外，人们可以把他的分析解读为揭示了机械性与有机性之间某种连续性，这种二分法是多余的，在分析中毫无意义。
或者用许煜自己的话来说：
en: The ‘purpose’ or the telos one might speak of in this sense is apparently not linear, it does not operate as
, and we are, therefore, not certain that one can speak of ‘telos’. We will use the term on a provisory basis, in the absence of a more fitting one. In

, Yuk Hui explains that the ‘telos’ of the organic or nature, understood in line with German idealism and Schelling in particular, comes down to a perpetual contingency and recursion akin to the ones we find as founding principles of computing automata. Despite Hui’s allegiance with Schelling and idealism, the operations his analysis reveals demonstrate that the ‘ideal’ is inextricable from nature. Also, one can read his analysis as demonstrating a certain continuity between mechanicity and organicity, the dichotomy is redundant and serves no purpose in the analysis.
Or in Hui’s own words:

zh: 自然目的是一种无法客观观察的事物。我们可以看到某棵树或某种动物，但无法通过机械规则把握自然整体。理性只能通过反思性判断来理解自然目的，这意味着它会递归地抵达一个自我组织的存在。从这个意义上说，目的论思维是循环的：*A→B→C→A。
en: The natural end is something that cannot be observed objectively. We can see such and such a tree or such and such an animal, but we cannot grasp nature as a whole through mechanical rules. Reason can only understand the natural end through reflective judgment, meaning that it recursively arrives at a self-organising being. Teleological thinking is in this sense circular: *A→B→C→A

zh: 那套旨在维持人类“类存在”（形式与功能）的设计——该设计由社会关系构成，旨在维持其存在并提升其效能——所包含的一系列功能，本身具有循环性。
en: The set of functions that amount to maintaining the design (form and function) of the ‘species being’ of humanity, which is built of social relations and with the goal of sustaining its existence and enhancing its effectiveness, is circular.

zh: 换言之，该“存在”在生产与再生产过程中持续进行自我组织，同时改善着技术与自然之间的生态系统（即非人工建造的、非人类“技艺”（technē）或巧思所创造的——此处“技艺”（technē）取其字面含义）。这里似乎是在谈论一种自动机，即亚里士多德所指的那种——一种不受外部原因或推动者驱动的存在，但同时也缺乏“目的因”（causa finalis）；或者，正如亚里士多德所解释的，它运作起来仿佛拥有一个“目的”（telos），尽管它实际上并没有（因为它缺乏理性）。
唯有“不动的推动者”是自运动的，它是一种理念，
是一切事物的“为什么”——这就是为什么自动机——这种自运动的物质现实——在亚里士多德宇宙中，看似具有目的性和意义，却并非如此。
en: In other words, the ‘being’ is perpetually self-organizing in production and reproduction while improving the ecosystem between technology and nature (that which is not artificially built, which is not the product of the human
or artfulness, the literal meaning of
). One seems to be talking of an automaton here, in Aristotle’s sense – a being unmoved by an external cause, or by a mover, but also bereft of
, or, as Aristotle explains, it operates as if it had a telos nonetheless it doesn’t have one (as it is void of Reason).
Only the ‘unmoved mover’ is self-moved, and it is an Idea,
the ‘why’ of it all – that is why the automaton, the self-moved material reality resembles a purposeful and meaningful reality, yet it is not – in Aristotle’s universe.

zh: 人们常说亚里士多德对马克思影响相当大，如果抽去“自我观照的完美理念”或“不动的推动者”这一概念，亚里士多德所发展的形式与物质之间的辩证关系，很大程度上可以在马克思思想中看到反映，包括他的博士论文。在该论文中，马克思提出以下论点：
en: It is often said that Aristotle’s influence on Marx has been considerable, and if one abstracts the notion of the perfect Idea contemplating itself or the ‘unmoved mover’, much of the dialectics between form and matter developed by Aristotle can be seen as reflected in Marx’s thought, including his doctoral dissertation. In said thesis, Marx puts forward the following argument:

zh: 原子通过其属性获得了一种与其概念相矛盾的存在；它被假定为一种与本质相异的、外化的存在。正是这种矛盾最令伊壁鸠鲁感兴趣。因此，一旦他设定某种属性并由此推导出原子的物质性质，他便同时反设一些规定，这些规定又在其自身范畴内摧毁了该属性，转而验证了原子的概念。因此，他以一种使所有属性自相矛盾的方式来界定它们。另一方面，德谟克利特在任何地方都没有把属性与原子本身联系起来考虑，也没有把属性中固有的概念与存在之间的矛盾对象化。
en: Through the qualities the atom acquires an existence which contradicts its concept; it is assumed as an externalised being different from its essence. It is this contradiction which mainly interests Epicurus. Hence, as soon as he posits a property and thus draws the consequence of the material nature of the atom, he counterposits at the same time determinations which again destroy this property in its own sphere and validate instead the concept of the atom. He therefore determines all properties in such a way that they contradict themselves. Democritus, on the other hand, nowhere considers the properties in relation to the atom itself, nor does he objectify the contradiction between concept and existence which is inherent in them.

zh: 这里并不存在某种外部理念值得向往或寻求实现——如同黑格尔设想那样，通过物质的自我消亡回归到该理念——而是原子的“概念”不可避免地通过其物质属性的对象化而得以物质化并作为物质存在而得到验证。这种“形式”（概念）与物质的辩证关系，与其说是黑格尔或其他唯心主义者的，不如说更接近亚里士多德形而上学（在其原始的亚里士多德意义上）。同样，社会（包括技术）设计是无产阶级直接的、物质的需求和阶级利益的产物——它在这个词的任何意义上都不是观念性的（或唯心主义的），包括“伦理的”或道德的（或道德主义的）意义。
en: There is no external idea to aspire to or seek to fulfil – by returning to it through self-annihilation of the material as in Hegel’s vision – but rather ‘the concept’ of the atom is unavoidably materialized and validated as such through its objectivization via material properties. This dialectic of ‘form’ (concept) and matter resembles Aristotle’s metaphysics (in its original, Aristotelian sense) far more than that of Hegel or the other idealists. Similarly, social (including technological) design is the product of the immediate and material needs and class
of the proletariat – it is not ideal(ist) in any sense of the word, including ‘ethical’ or moral(ist).

zh: 唯心主义是以主体性为中心的，是人类中心主义的，这不仅符合马克思观点，也符合狄德罗观点：
en: Idealism is subjectivity-centred, it is anthropocentric, not only according to Marx but also according to Diderot:

zh: 那些哲学家被称为唯心主义者，因为他们只意识到自己的存在以及自身内部接连不断的感觉，而不承认其他任何东西。这是一个荒诞的体系，依我之见，唯有盲人才可能提出；这一体系虽是所有体系中最荒谬的，却也是最难反驳的，这令人类智慧和哲学蒙羞。
en: Those philosophers are called idealists who, being conscious only of their existence and of the sensations which succeed each other within themselves, do not admit anything else. An extravagant system which, to my thinking, only the blind could have originated; a system which, to the shame of human intelligence and philosophy, is the most difficult to combat, although the most absurd of all.

zh: 在《对黑格尔哲学的总体批判》（《1844 年经济哲学手稿》的一部分）
中，马克思讨论了“主体性”概念，认为正是哲学的定义所在，而诉诸主体性则是破坏任何“马克思主义”思想试图确立其科学性的关键因素。
马克思所倡导的客观思维方式与奥古斯特·孔德的实证主义截然不同。恰恰相反，它以把思维从（个体）人类主体中“去中心化”为前提。引用马克思的话：
en: In ‘Critique of Hegel’s Philosophy in General’ (part of

children: The Economic and Philosophic Manuscripts of 1844

en: Marx discusses the concept of subjectivity as being what defines philosophy, and a resort to subjectivity as the key factor of undermining any attempt of ‘Marxist’ thought to establish itself as scientific.

The type of objective thought Marx advocates is in no way similar to August Comte’s positivism. Quite the opposite, it is premised on decentring thinking from the (individual) human subject. To quote Marx:

zh: 作为对象性的、自然的、感性的存在，同时在自身之外拥有对象、自然和感性，或者自身对于第三者而言就是对象、自然和感性，乃是一回事。
en: To be objective, natural and sensuous, and at the same time to have object, nature and sense outside oneself, or oneself to be object, nature and sense for a third party, is one and the same thing.

zh: “感性”和“自然”这两个术语的使用应与狄德罗的学术传统联系起来，而非德国活力论者，因为这种用法是反人类中心的——即使在激进人文主义语境下也是如此——而且当马克思进行唯物主义论证时，这两个术语（包括“物理的”和“真实的”）的使用远比“物质”或“材料”更为常见。我认为这种术语选择的原因在于他避免被等同于另一种青年黑格尔派唯物主义——即费尔巴哈的唯物主义，这个问题我在我的著作《迈向社会主义的激进形而上学》（卡塔琳娜·科洛佐娃，Punctum Books，2015）中进行了详细讨论。
让我们注意狄德罗这段话结语（即前文引用的与达朗贝尔的对话）中的相似之处：
en: The use of ‘sensuous’ and ‘natural’ should be linked to Diderot’s heritage rather than the German vitalists as it is anti-anthropocentric – even when radically humanist – and the use of both terms, including that of ‘the physical and the real’ is far more common in Marx when he makes a materialist argument (rather than ‘matter’ or ‘material’). I find the reasons for this terminological choice in his avoidance to be equated with the other young-Hegelian materialism, that of Feuerbach, a question I discuss in detail in my bookKaterina Kolozova, (Punctum Books, 2015).

zh: 达朗贝尔：例如，你的体系并未阐明我们如何形成三段论或作出推论。狄德罗：我们并不作出这些推论；它们全是由自然推导出来的。我们只是陈述相互关联的现象的存在，这些现象是我们通过实践所知的，这些现象的存在可能是必然的，也可能是偶然的；在数学、物理学及其他精确科学中是必然的；在伦理学、政治学及其他推测性科学中则是偶然的。
en: d’Alembert: For instance, your system doesn’t make it clear how we form syllogisms or draw inferences. Diderot: We don’t draw them; they are all drawn by nature. We only state the existence of connected phenomena, which are known to us practically, by experience, whose existence may be either necessary or contingent; necessary in the case of mathematics, physics, and other exact sciences; contingent in ethics, politics and other conjectural sciences.

zh: 我们认为，在这些专门论述狄德罗唯物主义及其与马克思联系的段落中，我们已经证明：二者既不是哲学意义上的自然主义，也不是某种泛灵论式的活力论，而是非人类中心的唯物主义世界观。与此同时，他们确实提出了“人道主义”理想，以及关于一个更公正的（人类）社会关系宇宙的愿景，但两位作者都极其明确地强调，这些理想和愿景是超越资本主义对“自然资源”剥削态度的生态系统的产物。
en: We believe we have demonstrated in these passages dedicated to Diderot’s materialism and its links with Marx that both are neither naturalism in the philosophical sense nor some sort of animistic vitalism, but rather non-anthropocentric materialist world views. At the same time, they do propose ‘humanist’ ideals and visions of a more just universe of (human) social relations, but the emphasis on them being the result of ecosystems that transcend the capitalist exploitative attitude towards ‘natural resources’ is more than clear in both authors.

zh: 牛顿式的马克思
一个国家可以也应该向其他国家学习。甚至当一个社会已经走上发现其运动自然规律的正确轨道时——而本著作的最终目标，正是揭示现代社会的经济运动规律——它既无法通过大胆飞跃来跨越，也无法通过立法来消除其正常发展各阶段所面临的障碍。但它可以缩短并减轻这些分娩的阵痛。
en: One nation can and should learn from others. And even when a society has got upon the right track for the discovery of the natural laws of its movement – and it is the ultimate aim of this work, to lay bare the

of modern society – it can neither clear by bold leaps, nor remove by legal enactments, the obstacles offered by the successive phases of its normal development. But it can shorten and lessen the birth-pangs.

zh: 上述引自《资本论》序言的目标，是确立现代社会的运动规律。换言之，就是对现代社会做牛顿对自然界所做的工作。马克思在《资本论》中的方法如何契合牛顿式科学实践？
en: The aim, stated above from the preface to Capital, was to establish a law of motion for modern society. In other words, to do for modern society what Newton had done for the natural world. How does the method of Marx in Capital fit into the Newtonian scientific practice?

zh: 因为哲学的一切困难似乎都在于这一点——从运动的现象出发去探究自然力，然后又从这些自然力出发去推导出其他现象。（牛顿，《自然哲学的数学原理》序言）
en: for all the difficulty of philosophy seems to consist in this – from the phænomena of motions to investigate the forces of nature, and then from these forces to demonstrate the other phænomena. (Newton, introduction to the

zh: 牛顿的方法是：
en: The method of Newton was,

zh: 1. 从实验和观察出发，表述运动定律。
2. 借助几何学进行演绎，进而得出向心力的普遍性质。
3. 根据木星卫星的周期和轨道半径，推导出引力定律必须遵循平方反比关系。
4. 从万有引力平方反比定律推导出关于行星轨道的更精确预测。
en: 1. From experiment and observation to formulate laws of motion.
2. By deduction, via geometry to then derive general properties of centripetal forces.
3. From the periods and orbital radii of the satellites of Jupiter to deduce that the gravitational force must be inverse square.
4. From an inverse square law of gravitation to deduce more accurate predictions about the planetary orbits.

zh: 当我们审视马克思从抽象到具体的论证过程时，会发现其中存在非常相似的逻辑路径。
en: When we look at the process of argument from the abstract to the concrete in Marx, we see a very similar process.

zh: 这两种情况下都提出了守恒定律。
en: Formulation of conservation laws in both cases.

en: Movement from abstract laws to concrete conclusions about motion in both cases.

zh: 牛顿：向心力在等时间内扫过等面积，引力遵循平方反比定律；• 马克思：随着资本积累加深，利润率下降。

zh: 从《资本论》一开始，马克思就致力于阐明商品交换涉及一种守恒关系：
en: Right from the start of Capital, Marx is concerned to establish that commodity exchange involves a conservation relation:

zh: 让我们以两种商品为例，例如谷物和铁。无论它们的交换比例如何，总可以用一个等式来表示这个比例，使一定量的谷物与一定量的铁相等：例如，1夸特谷物＝x英担铁。这个等式告诉我们什么？
en: Let us take two commodities, eg corn and iron. The proportions in which they are exchangeable, whatever those proportions may be, can always be represented by an equation in which a given quantity of corn is equated to some quantity of iron: eg 1 quarter corn = x cwt. iron. What does this equation tell us?

zh: 它告诉我们，在两种不同的东西中——在1夸特谷物和x英担
铁中——存在着某种两者共有的、数量相等的东西。因此，这两种东西必定等于第三种东西，而这第三种东西本身既不是前者，也不是后者。因此，两者中的每一种，就其作为交换价值而言，都必定能够还原为这第三种东西。
en: It tells us that in two different things – in 1 quarter of corn and x cwt.

of iron, there exists in equal quantities something common to both. The two things must therefore be equal to a third, which in itself is neither the one nor the other. Each of them, so far as it is exchange value, must therefore be reducible to this third.

zh: 一个简单的几何图解可以说明这一点。为了计算和比较直线图形的面积，我们将它们分解为三角形。但三角形本身的面积，是用一种与其可见形状完全不同的东西来表示的，即底边与高之积的一半。同样地，商品的交换价值必须能够用它们所共有的某种东西来表示，而它们所代表的正是该东西的多少。
en: A simple geometrical illustration will make this clear. In order to calculate and compare the areas of rectilinear figures, we decompose them into triangles. But the area of the triangle itself is expressed by something totally different from its visible figure, namely, by half the product of the base multiplied by the altitude. In the same way the exchange values of commodities must be capable of being expressed in terms of something common to them all, of which thing they represent a greater or less quantity.

zh: 他从这些观察到的性质中推导出：既然存在等价关系，那么在等价关系背后必然存在某种抽象的第三种东西。等价关系是守恒的标志。关于这种共同实体存在的推导，在结构上等同于以下推导：在行星绕太阳公转过程中，一种共同实体——能量——会在势能和动能形式之间交换。我们仅通过能量强加于运动上的等价关系，才知晓能量存在。
en: His deduction from these observed properties is that because there is an equivalence relation, there is some abstract third thing behind the equivalence. An equivalence relation is an indicator of conservation. The deduction that this common substance exists is structurally equivalent to the deduction that a common substance
is exchanged between potential and kinetic forms during a planet’s orbit around the Sun. We only know of the existence of
via the equivalence relationships that it imposes on motions.

zh: 在马克思撰写《资本论》之时，关于能量守恒的研究早已远远超出动能和势能范畴。当时他能接触到的科学文献，正在探讨电能、化学能、热能和光能中的能量守恒问题。关于“共同实体”——即以多种形式存在的能量——这一概念，在撰写《资本论》之前，马克思与恩格斯之间就已展开热烈讨论。
en: By the time Marx was writing Capital, work on the conservation of energy had gone much further than just kinetic and potential energy. The science available to him was discussing energy conservation in electricity, chemical energy, heat and light. The idea of a common substance, energy present in multiple forms, was being actively discussed between him and Engels prior to writing Capital.

zh: 另一个会让老黑格尔欣喜若狂的发现，是物理学中的力之关联，即在特定条件下，机械运动（即机械力，例如通过摩擦产生的力）转化为热能，热能转化为光能，光能转化为化学亲和力，化学亲和力（例如在伏打堆中）转化为电能，而电能又转化为磁力。这些转化过程也可能以不同方式发生，既可以是正向的，也可以是逆向的。一位我记不清名字的英国人［焦耳］现已证明，这些力以非常具体的定量比例相互转化，因此，例如，某一种力（如电）的特定量，对应于其他每种力量（如磁、光、热、化学亲和力（正或负——结合或分离）以及运动）的特定量。
en: Another result that would have delighted old Hegel is the correlation of forces in physics, or the law whereby mechanical motion, ie mechanical force (eg through friction), is, in given conditions, converted into heat, heat into light, light into chemical affinity, chemical affinity (eg in the voltaic pile) into electricity, the latter into magnetism. These transitions may also take place differently, backwards or forwards. An Englishman [Joule] whose name I can’t recall has now shown that these forces pass from one to the other in quite specific quantitative proportions so that eg a certain quantity of one, eg electricity, corresponds to a certain quantity of each of the others, eg magnetism, light, heat, chemical affinity (positive or negative — combining or separating) and motion.

zh: 从交换中必定有一种共同实体保持守恒这一推论出发，马克思立即把这一实体认定为劳动。
en: From the deduction that there must be a common substance conserved in exchange, Marx immediately identifies this with labour.

zh: 这种共同的“某种东西”既不能是商品的几何属性，也不能是化学属性，更不能是任何其他自然属性。这些属性只有在影响商品效用、使商品成为使用价值时，才值得我们关注。但商品交换显然是一种完全抽去使用价值的行为……
en: This common ‘something’ cannot be either a geometrical, a chemical, or any other natural property of commodities. Such properties claim our attention only in so far as they affect the utility of those commodities, make them use values. But the exchange of commodities is evidently an act characterised by a total abstraction from use value. . . .

zh: 因此，如果我们不考虑商品的使用价值，它们就只剩下一项共同属性，即作为劳动产品的属性。……
en: If then we leave out of consideration the use value of commodities, they have only one common property left, that of being products of labour . . .

zh: 随着产品本身有用性质的消失，体现在产品中的各种劳动的有用性质及其具体形式也被撇开了；剩下的只有它们所共有的东西；它们全都还原为同一种劳动，即抽象的人类劳动。现在让我们考察这些产品各自的残余：每一种产品中都留下同样的无形的实在，不过是同质人类劳动的凝结，是不管以何种方式耗费的人类劳动力的凝结。这些东西现在仅仅表明，在它们的生产中耗费了人类劳动力，其中凝结了人类劳动。作为这种共同社会实体的结晶来考察，它们就是——价值。
en: Along with the useful qualities of the products themselves, we put out of sight both the useful character of the various kinds of labour embodied in them, and the concrete forms of that labour; there is nothing left but what is common to them all; all are reduced to one and the same sort of labour, human labour in the abstract. Let us now consider the residue of each of these products; it consists of the same unsubstantial reality in each, a mere congelation of homogeneous human labour, of labour power expended without regard to the mode of its expenditure. All that these things now tell us is, that human labour power has been expended in their production, that human labour is embodied in them. When looked at as crystals of this social substance, common to them all, they are – Values.

zh: 受边际经济学熏陶的现代评论家们认为，这种推论过于牵强。尽管他们或许愿意接受马克思关于“交换是一种等价关系”的结论，但他们认为马克思关于“劳动是守恒量”的结论站不住脚。如今，我们已拥有大量实证证据表明马克思是正确的。
这些新证据依赖于投入产出表等现代经济统计数据。马克思当时虽未掌握这些数据，但在他著述之际，劳动决定价值已被视为政治经济学中已经确立的真理。这种劳动决定价值理论，早在斯密《国富论》中便已确立。
正如牛顿把伽利略的发现视为既定事实一样，马克思也可以假定劳动含量决定价格这一原理已被广泛理解。直到马克思分析所蕴含的颠覆性影响被广泛认可之后，经济学界的共识才逐渐偏离斯密的结论。对当代读者而言，把劳动视为共同要素的论述似乎有些武断。然而，马克思最初证明交换是一种具有守恒实体的等价关系的步骤，对于他后续论证阶段至关重要。
en: Modern commentators, raised on marginal economics, see this as a leap too far. While they may be willing to accept his conclusion that exchange is an equivalence relation, they believe Marx’s conclusion that labour is the conserved quantity to be unsound. We now have considerable empirical evidence that Marx was correct.

This new evidence relies on modern economic statistics like I/O tables. Marx did not have this data, but at the time he was writing, the determination of value by labour was already taken as an established truth of political economy. The determination of value by labour had been established by Smith in the Wealth of Nations.

Just as Newton accepted Galileo’s findings as a given, Marx could assume the determination of prices by labour content was well understood. It was only after the disruptive implications of Marx’s analysis became widely recognized that the economic consensus moved away from Smith’s conclusions. To contemporary readers, the reference to labour as the common element may appear arbitrary. However, Marx’s initial step of proving that exchange is an equivalence relation with a conserved substance is crucial for the subsequent phase of his argument.

How is this possible?

Variable capital, a term coined by Marx, refers to the labour power purchased by the capitalist. It is deemed ‘variable’ because it is the component of the capital that increases in value; unlike constant capital, its value is not fixed but grows. The value of constant capital remains preserved, simply transferring its existing value to the final product without alteration.

zh: 关于不变资本，马克思指出：
en: Of constant capital, he says:

zh: 这不会对价值创造或价值量变化产生任何影响。卢克莱修所言不言自明：“nilposse creari de nihilo”，即“无中不能生有”。价值的创造就是把劳动力转化为劳动。劳动力本身是通过营养物质转移到人体内的能量。
en: this will have no influence on the creation of value or on the variation in the quantity of value. What Lucretius says is self-evident; ‘nil posse creari de nihilo,’ out of nothing, nothing can be created. Creation of value is transformation of labour-power into labour. Labour-power itself is energy transferred to a human organism by means of nourishing matter.

zh: 多么精彩的段落！它把马克思博士论文的研究主题——原子论，与“功率”“功”和“能量”等概念融为一体。
en: What a great passage! It brings together Atomism that was the subject of Dr Marx’s PhD with concepts of power, work and energy.

zh: 像斯密这样的18 世纪历史唯物主义者仅把工资视为劳动报酬，而马克思能区分“功率”与“功”。如果劳动是一种商品，且商品按其价值——即其劳动含量——进行交换，那么我们就面临一个矛盾。
en: Where a historical materialist of the eighteenth century like Smith just saw in wages a payment for labour, Marx could make the distinction between power and work. If labour were a commodity and if commodities exchanged in proportion to their value, their labour content, then we have a contradiction.

zh: 劳动本身的价值究竟是什么？
en: What is the value of labour itself?

zh: 功与功率
乍看之下，人们可能会说一小时劳动的价值仅仅是一小时。然而，政治经济学家们认为，其价值实际上由生产工人该小时所需生活资料——食物和衣物——所需要的劳动量决定。这种观点在未承认其内在矛盾的情况下一直被沿用。
en: At first glance, one might say the value of an hour’s labour is simply one hour. However, political economists argue that its value is actually determined by the amount of labour needed to produce the sustenance – food and clothing – that a worker requires for that hour. This perspective was maintained without acknowledging the inherent contradiction.

zh: 亚当·斯密及其继承者李嘉图提出理论时，劳动主要依靠人力。马克思后来提出的把“劳动”与“劳动力”区分开来的概念，在当时难以想象。当马克思著书立说之时，经过一个多世纪机械技术进步，蒸汽机已成为英国工业主要能源。为了区分产品，蒸汽机制造商以马力为单位对机器进行评级，从而提供一种与竞争对手发动机进行比较的标准衡量方式。
en: Adam Smith and his successor, Ricardo, developed their theories during a time when labour was predominantly human-powered. The concept that Marx later introduced, distinguishing labour from labour power, was inconceivable then. By the time Marx was writing, after over a century of mechanical progress, steam engines had become the primary source of energy for British industry. To differentiate their products, steam engine manufacturers rated their machines in terms of horsepower, providing a standard measure to compare against competitors’ engines.

zh: 蒸汽机最初任务是从矿井中运出煤炭，或把矿井中水抽出来。据估算，一匹马在绞盘上每秒可把550 磅重量提升1 英尺。如果一台蒸汽机能在1 秒内把同等重量煤炭提升10 英尺，那么它就是一台10 马力蒸汽机，以此类推。
en: The initial task of steam engines was hauling coal from mines, or pumping water from mines. It was reckoned that a horse on a windlass could raise a 550 lb weight at 1 foot a second. If a steam engine could raise the same weight of coal 10 feet in a second then it was a 10 horsepower engine, etc.

zh: 随着机械工程实践发展，所做功与作为做功能力的功率之间的区别变得显而易见。通过简单量纲分析可发现，所做功等同于能量。
en: As a result of practical mechanical engineering, the distinction between work done and power as the ability to do work became evident. A little dimensional analysis revealed that work done was the same as energy.

zh: 功被等同于能量，而功率被定义为在特定时间单位内所做的功。在维多利亚时期英国，能量或功以英尺–磅为单位量化，而功率以马力为单位衡量。一个专门工程领域应运而生，旨在通过示功图准确测量蒸汽机功率输出。这些图是通过把发动机活塞连接到纸张x 轴上自动绘制的曲线图，同时与压力表相连的铅笔垂直移动以记录压力变化。这些图被用来向持怀疑态度的买家证明发动机功率。
en: Work was equated with energy, and power was defined as the amount of work done in a specific time unit. In Victorian England, energy or work was quantified in foot-pounds, while power was measured in horsepower. A specialized field of engineering emerged to accurately measure the power output of steam engines through indicator diagrams. These diagrams were graphs automatically drawn by connecting the engine’s piston to the x-axis of a paper, while a pencil, linked to the pressure gauge, moved vertically to record the variations. These diagrams were used to prove, to dubious buyers, the power of the engine.

zh: 在21 世纪，解读示功图或衡量蒸汽机功率似乎是冷门话题。然而在19 世纪，蒸汽技术是当时最前沿技术。对蒸汽技术的了解，就如同我们今天对计算机的理解一样，蒸汽时代的概念和计量单位对维多利亚时代的人来说，就像今天的千兆字节和像素一样熟悉。
en: In the twenty-first century, interpreting indicator diagrams or gauging the power of steam engines may seem like obscure subjects. However, in the nineteenth century, steam was the cutting-edge technology of the era. Knowledge of steam was akin to our understanding of computers, with steam-era concepts and metrics as familiar to Victorians as gigabytes and pixels are to us today.

zh: 马克思对“劳动力”（即劳动能力）与“劳动本身”（即所完成的劳动）的区分，对于1860 年代读者来说立即可理解。在机械工程语境中，这些区分司空见惯。恩格斯拥有一家蒸汽动力工厂，想必对这些概念了如指掌。马克思和恩格斯，本质上就是蒸汽朋克式共产主义者，他们用能量、力与功率的术语来阐述思想。
en: Marx’s differentiation between labour power – the capacity to work – and labour itself – the work performed – would have been instantly comprehensible to a readership in the 1860s. These were commonplace distinctions within the context of mechanical engineering. Engels, owning a steam-powered mill, would have been well-versed in these concepts. Marx and Engels, in essence, were the steampunk communists, articulating in a vernacular of energy, force and power.

zh: 以一位租用10 马力蒸汽机的矿主为例。他每小时能否实际完成
英尺–磅的煤炭提升功，取决于他让蒸汽机运转的强度。如果运到竖井底部的煤车数量不足，就会出现蒸汽机闲置时段。因此，蒸汽机功率与实际所做的功被理解为两件不同事情。
en: Take the example of a mine owner who hired a 10-horsepower steam engine. Whether he actually got

foot-pounds of coal lifting done each hour would depend on how intensively he worked the engine. If there were not enough truckloads of coal brought to the foot of the shaft, there would be periods when the engine stood idle. So the power of the engine and the work actually done were understood to be two different things.

zh: 从马克思把劳动，即所做的功，引入为价值实体的那一刻起，他就把它等同于劳动力——劳动能力——的耗费。由此，他得出对
过程所隐含矛盾的解决之道。马克思认为，资本家雇佣一名工人工作一天，劳动力价值由维持该工人在此期间生存所需生活资料决定。然而，实际工作时长可能不同。正如矿主会尽可能长时间利用蒸汽机一样，资本家对工人也是如此。他们支付报酬仅够工人维持每日生存。马克思指出，如果六小时劳动就足以生产工人生存所需必需品，那么资本家就不受任何必须在六小时后让工人下班的强制。相反，资本家会设法把工作日延长到最大程度。
en: From the very moment that Marx introduces labour, work done, as the substance of value he equates this with the expenditure of labour power – the ability to work. From this, he derives his resolution to the contradiction implicit in

. According to Marx, a capitalist employs a labourer for a day, with the labour power’s value determined by the sustenance needed to keep the worker alive for that period. However, the actual hours worked can vary. Similar to a mine owner utilizing a steam engine for the longest possible duration, the capitalist does the same with his workers. They are paid just enough for daily survival. Marx suggests that if six hours of labour suffice to produce the necessities for a worker’s survival, there is no compulsion for the capitalist to release the workers after six hours. Instead, the capitalist aims to extend the working day to its fullest extent.

zh: 因此，工作日并非一个常量，而是一个变量。当然，其中一部分由劳动者自身劳动力再生产所需工作时间决定。但其总时长则随剩余劳动的持续时间而变化。因此，工作日虽然可以确定，但就其本身而言却是未定的。
en: The working day is thus not a constant, but a variable quantity. One of its parts, certainly, is determined by the working-time required for the reproduction of the labour-power of the labourer himself. But its total amount varies with the duration of the surplus labour. The working day is, therefore, determinable, but is, per se, indeterminate.

zh: 这一上限由两方面条件决定。首先，是劳动力的生理极限。在自然日24 小时内，一个人只能消耗一定量生命力。同样，一匹马每天也只能工作8 小时。在一天中的部分时间里，这种生命力必须休息、睡眠；在另一部分时间里，人必须满足其他生理需求，如进食、洗漱和穿衣。除了这些纯粹生理限制外，工作日长度延长还面临道德限制。劳动者需要时间满足其智力和社会需求，而这些需求的范围和数量取决于社会进步总体状况。因此，工作日长度变化在生理和社会界限内波动。但这两种限制性条件都具有极大弹性，允许最大自由度。于是，我们发现工作日有8、10、12、14、16、18 小时之长，即长度千差万别。
en: This maximum limit is conditioned by two things. First, by the physical bounds of labour-power. Within the 24 hours of the natural day a man can expend only a definite quantity of his vital force. A horse, in like manner, can only work from day to day, 8 hours. During part of the day this force must rest, sleep; during another part the man has to satisfy other physical needs, to feed, wash, and clothe himself. Besides these purely physical limitations, the extension of the working day encounters moral ones. The labourer needs time for satisfying his intellectual and social wants, the extent and number of which are conditioned by the general state of social advancement. The variation of the working day fluctuates, therefore, within physical and social bounds. But both these limiting conditions are of a very elastic nature, and allow the greatest latitude. So we find working days of 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18 hours, ie of the most different lengths.

zh: 马克思把工人除赚取工资所需劳动时间之外必须额外劳动的时间定义为“剩余劳动”。他断言，所做剩余劳动与资本家攫取的剩余价值之间存在直接关联。基于这一基本原理，马克思推导出他所观察到的资本主义社会的一系列经验特征。
en: Marx defined the additional time a worker must labour beyond what is needed to earn their wages as surplus labour. He asserted that there is a direct correlation between the surplus labour done and the surplus value seized by the capitalist. From this fundamental principle, Marx inferred a range of empirical characteristics of the capitalist society he observed.

zh: 由于资本家试图把利润最大化，而利润又取决于剩余劳动，因此他们不断推动把工作日延长至人类耐力极限。马克思把此称为绝对剩余价值。
en: Since the capitalists try to maximize profit, and since this depends on surplus labour, they constantly push to extend the working day to the limits of human endurance. This he termed absolute surplus value.

zh: 资本家实现利润最大化的另一种途径是减少生产工资购买的生活资料所需时间。如果通过织布机械化，为工人提供服装所需工作可以在更短时间内完成，那么在任何给定工作日中，归属于资本的部分就会增加。由此产生不断推动机械化的动力。马克思把此称为相对剩余价值。
en: The other way they can maximize profit is by reducing the hours required to produce wage goods. If, through mechanization of weaving, the work required to clothe the workers can be performed in fewer hours, then the share of any given working day falling to capital will increase. From this stemmed the constant drive towards mechanization. This he called relative surplus value.

zh: 类似于牛顿的轨道力学，马克思表述了一个维持资本对劳动支配的循环过程（见图5.1，该图根据Cockshott、Cottrell与Michaelson计算的数据绘制
）。他把这称为资本积累的一般规律。这是支配资本主义社会的运动规律。
en: Analogous to Newton’s orbital mechanics, he formulates (see Figure 5.1 drawn from data computed in Cockshott, Cottrell and Michaelson
) a rotating process by which the dominance of capital over labour is maintained. This he called the General Law of Capital Accumulation. It was the governing law of motion of capitalist society.

zh: 牛顿力学所研究的行星系统演变在很大程度上是周期性的。各种周期相互交织：地球自转周期影响每日潮汐，而月球轨道改变高潮发生时间。年度周期决定四季更替，更长周期控制地球自转轴及其轨道长轴岁差。如今人们认识到，正是这些漫长米兰科维奇周期引发冰河时代。
en: The progression of planetary systems, as studied by Newtonian mechanics, was largely cyclical. Various cycles overlapped: the Earth’s rotation cycle influenced daily tides, while the lunar orbit altered the timing of high tides. The annual cycle dictated the seasons, and even longer cycles controlled the precession of Earth’s axis and its orbital major axis. It is now understood that these extended Milankovitch cycles are responsible for initiating Ice Ages.

zh: 图5.1 以维多利亚时期的一个经济周期说明马克思的资本积累一般规律。该规律描述了一个循环过程：相对充分就业的时期（1881—1883年）使工资得以上涨。资本家的应对是投资于节省劳动的机器（1882—1885年）。这使工人加入劳动后备军，并导致工资下降（1883—1887年）。在这一较低工资水平上，资本家再次雇佣更多工人，工资开始上涨，循环重新开始。这样的周期通常略短于十年。作者绘图。
Marxian cycle of accumulation：马克思式积累周期；实线rate of change of money wage：货币工资变化率；点线reserve army of labour：劳动后备军；虚线fixed capital accumulation as a percent of profit：固定资本积累占利润的百分比；横轴数字为年份。
en: Figure 5.1 Illustration of Marx’s General Law of Capital Accumulation using a Victorian economic cycle. The law describes a cyclical process whereby a period of relatively full employment (1881–3) allows wages to rise. The capitalists respond by investing in labour-saving machinery (1882–5). This throws workers onto the reserve army of labour and causes wages to fall (1883–7). At this lower wage, the capitalists again take on more workers, wages start to rise and the cycle repeats. The cycle typically took just under a decade. Figure by authors.

zh: 对马克思而言，经济世界也是类似周期叠加：商品周期
以及基本资本周期

相互交织，且速度极快，通常以天或周为单位。在此之上，还有由他的“一般规律”驱动的周期，持续时间约十年。除此之外，还存在一个漫长过程，其间其他趋势逐渐显现：利润率下降以及工业无产阶级社会和政治影响力稳步增强。资本主义制度兴衰时间线——从16 世纪所谓“原始积累”到最终革命危机——跨越数百年。各种生产方式都融入一个“大周期”，从原始共产主义演进到高级共产主义。对马克思而言，这些周期是向上螺旋的，未来共产主义将超越其前身，而推动这一进程的正是他用另一个机械隐喻所称的“生产力”。
en: For Marx, the economic world was a similar superposition of cycles: the commodity cycle
and the basic capital cycle

interleaved and were fast, of the order of days or weeks. On top of this came the cycle driven by his General Law, which lasts a decade or so. Beyond that, there was a protracted process through which other trends emerged: a declining rate of profit and the steadily increasing social and political influence of the industrial working class. The timeline for the rise and fall of the capitalist system, from the so-called primitive accumulation in the sixteenth century to a final revolutionary crisis, spanned hundreds of years. The modes of production fit into a Grand Cycle, evolving from primitive to advanced communism. For Marx, these cycles were upward spirals, with the future communism surpassing its predecessor, propelled by what he termed, in another mechanical metaphor, the productive forces.

zh: 任何社会制度，在其中所能容纳的所有生产力都得到发展之前，绝不会消失；而新的、更高的生产关系，在支撑其存在的物质条件于旧社会子宫中成熟之前，也绝不会出现。因此，人类总是只去解决那些它能够解决的问题，因为如果我们更仔细地观察，就会发现：一个问题本身只有在解决该问题所必需的物质条件已经存在，或者至少正在形成过程中，才会出现。从大体上讲，我们可以把亚细亚的、古代的、封建的和现代资产阶级的生产方式，视为社会经济形态演进过程中的若干阶段。资产阶级生产关系是社会生产过程中最后一种对立形式——这种对立并非指个体间对立，而是源于个体在社会中生活所处环境条件；与此同时，在资产阶级社会内部发展起来的生产力，为解决这种对立创造了物质条件。因此，这种社会形态构成了人类社会史前阶段的最后一章。
en: No social order ever dissappears before all the productive forces, for which there is room in it, have been developed; and new, higher relations of production never appear before the material conditions of their existence have matured in the womb of the old society. Therefore, humanity always takes up only such problems as it can solve, since, looking at the matter more closely we will always find that the problem itself arises only when the material conditions necessary for its solution already exist or are at least in the process of formation. In broad outline we can designate the Asiatic, the ancient, the feudal, and the modern bourgeois methods of production as so many epochs in the process of the economic formation of society. The bourgeois relations of production are the last antagonistic form of the social process of production – antagonistic not in the sense of individual antagonism, but of one arising from conditions surrounding the life of individuals in society; at the same time the productive forces developing in the womb of bourgeois society create the material conditions for the solution of that antagonism. This social formation constitutes, therefore, the closing chapter of the prehistoric stage of human society.

熟悉当前马克思主义哲学辩论的读者会发现，我们所阐述的牛顿式和机械论式马克思，与近几十年来逐渐占据上风的某些新黑格尔主义对马克思的诠释截然不同。这类诠释多种多样，但其中一个特别清晰的例子见于……

These accounts are multiple, but a particularly clear example is given by.

en: It became real money, by the general alienation of commodities, by actually changing places with their natural forms as useful objects, and thus becoming in reality the embodiment of their values.

en: But with the development of circulation, conditions arise under which the alienation of commodities becomes separated, by an interval of time, from the realisation of their prices.

zh: 《资本论》第三章德语原文使用的是“Veräußerung”（出售），而非“Entfremdung”——后者在马克思早期著作英译本中被译为“alienation”（异化）或“estrangement”（疏离）。这绝非《1844年经济学哲学手稿》（EPM）中“异化劳动”（entfremdete Arbeit）所涉及的问题，即使它们在英文中可能被译为相同词。
en: The German original of Capital Chapter 3 uses veräußerung or sale, not entfremdung, the word that is translated as alienation or estrangement in English translations of the early writings. This is by no means the problematic of ‘alienated labour’ ‘entfremdete Arbeit’ in the EPM, even if they may be given the same English translation.

zh: 斯塔罗斯塔还宣扬了一种目前虽流行但颇为奇怪的解释，即认为马克思在讨论商品时，仅指资本主义社会：
en: Starosta also propagates the currently fashionable, but rather odd, interpretation that when discussing commodities, Marx was only talking about capitalist society:

zh: 正如如今已得到广泛承认的那样，这个出发点并不是源自恩格斯、又经斯威齐和米克等作者普及的正统解释所认为的那种简单商品生产社会——无论它是理想类型，还是更糟，是历史上实际存在过的社会。
en: As has now been widely acknowledged, this starting point is not an ideal– typical – or worse, historically existent – simple commodity–producing society, as in the orthodoxy derived from Engels and popularised by authors such as Sweezy and Meek.

zh: 这一点极具争议。正如米克尔（Meikle）所指出的，马克思提出的使用价值与交换价值之间的基本区分源自亚里士多德。
马克思在脚注和正文中明确把许多思想归功于亚里士多德。特别值得一提的是，由于这直接关系到价值形式，马克思非常明确指出，他在《资本论》中提出的等价形式源自亚里士多德：
en: That is highly disputable. The basic distinction between use value and exchange value that Marx presents is drawn from Aristotle as was shown by Meikle.

Marx explicitly credits many of his ideas to Aristotle in footnotes and body text. Particularly relevant, because it relates directly to the value form, Marx was quite specific that the equivalent form of value that he presents in Capital was derived from Aristotle:

zh: 如果我们回溯到那位最先分析了如此多种形式——无论是思想、社会还是自然的形式，其中也包括价值形式——的伟大思想家，那么等价形式的后两项特殊性就会变得更易理解。我指的是亚里士多德。
en: The two latter peculiarities of the equivalent form will become more intelligible if we go back to the great thinker who was the first to analyse so many forms, whether of thought, society, or Nature, and amongst them also the form of value. I mean Aristotle.

zh: 首先，他明确指出，商品的货币形式仅仅是简单价值形式的进一步发展——即用任意另一种商品来表示一种商品的价值；因为他说：
en: In the first place, he clearly enunciates that the money form of commodities is only the further development of the simple form of value – ie of the expression of the value of one commodity in some other commodity taken at random; for he says:

zh: 5 张床＝1 栋房子与“5 张床＝若干货币”并无区别。
en: 5 beds = 1 house is not to be distinguished from 5 beds = so much money.

zh: 他进一步指出，产生这种表达方式的价值关系，要求房屋在质上必须与床等同；若无这种等同，这两种显然不同的事物便无法作为可通约的量相互比较。他说：“没有相等就不能交换，没有可通约性就不能相等。”
en: He further sees that the value relation which gives rise to this expression makes it necessary that the house should qualitatively be made the equal of the bed, and that, without such an equalisation, these two clearly different things could not be compared with each other as commensurable quantities. ‘Exchange,’ he says, ‘cannot take place without equality, and equality not without commensurability’.

zh: ……然而，他到此便停下来，放弃了对价值形式的进一步分析。“然而，实际上，如此不同的事物不可能具有可通约性”——即在质上相等。这种等同只能是与其真实本质相悖的，因此仅是“一种为实际目的而采取的权宜之计”。
en: . . . Here, however, he comes to a stop, and gives up the further analysis of the form of value. ‘It is, however, in reality, impossible , that such unlike things can be commensurable’ – ie qualitatively equal. Such an equalisation can only be something foreign to their real nature, consequently only ‘a makeshift for practical purposes.’

zh: 因此，亚里士多德本人告诉我们，是什么阻碍了他进一步分析；那就是缺乏任何价值概念。究竟是什么等价物、什么共同实体，使得床的价值能够用一所房子来表达？亚里士多德说，事实上，这样的东西不可能存在。为什么呢？与床相比，房子确实代表了与床等价的东西，因为它代表了床和房子中真正等价的东西。那就是——人的劳动。
en: Aristotle therefore, himself, tells us what barred the way to his further analysis; it was the absence of any concept of value. What is that equal something, that common substance, which admits of the value of the beds being expressed by a house? Such a thing, in truth, cannot exist, says Aristotle. And why not? Compared with the beds, the house does represent something equal to them, in so far as it represents what is really equal, both in the beds and the house. And that is – human labour.

zh: 然而，有一个重要事实阻碍了亚里士多德认识到：赋予商品以价值，仅仅是把一切劳动表述为等值的人类劳动，进而表述为质上相等的劳动的一种方式。希腊社会建立在奴隶制基础上，因此其自然基础就是人与人之间及其劳动能力的不平等。价值的表达之谜——即各种劳动之所以平等且等价，是因为且仅在它们作为一般人类劳动范围内——只有当人类平等观念已经取得一种普遍成见的牢固性之后，才能被破译。
en: There was, however, an important fact which prevented Aristotle from seeing that, to attribute value to commodities, is merely a mode of expressing all labour as equal human labour, and consequently as labour of equal quality. Greek society was founded upon slavery, and had, therefore, for its natural basis, the inequality of men and of their labour powers. The secret of the expression of value, namely, that all kinds of labour are equal and equivalent, because, and so far as they are human labour in general, cannot be deciphered, until the notion of human equality has already acquired the fixity of a popular prejudice.

理论，表明看似合理且符合唯物主义的解释最终仍可能被证明是错误的：
