en: Nitrous ACID is by some excluded from the foffil kingdom, because they suppose it to be produced from the putrefaction of organic bodies. But these bodies when deprived of life are again received amongst the folds, from whence their miore fixed parts were originally derived.
body.review: 此处及下文nitrous acid是引文所用旧称；原注61明确以现代发烟硝酸解释。底本folds、miore等拼写原样保留于英文。

zh: 在人工能制备出的最高浓度状态下，其比重为1.580。纯净时无色；但因其对燃素的强烈吸引力，必须采取特殊处理手段才能使其呈现这种无色状态。与不同比例燃素结合时，它会形成燃素酸和亚硝气。
en: In the most concentrated state that art can procure it, its specific gravity is 1, 580. Colourless when pure; but its strong attraction*to phlogiston renders particular management necessary to procure it so *. With different proportions of phlogiston it forms phlogisticated acid and nitrous air.
body.review: 底本在attraction和so后留有星号，但本书此处没有相应星号注释；英文保留星号。

zh: 颜色最深且冒烟的硝酸
若在敞口容器中快速煮沸，便能轻易使其无色。部分酸会挥发，同时把过量燃素以亚硝气形式带走。
en: The most highly coloured and fuming nitrous acid
may readily be rendered colourlets by boiling it hastily in an open veffel. Part of the acid fies off, carrying the fuperabundant phlogiston along with it, in the form of nitrous air

zh: 18 世纪化学家给出的论证在结构上与马克思辩证论述极为相似。共同性质（可燃性、可交换性）和表现形式（火焰、以黄金表示的价格）——由此辩证推导出必然存在一种共同实体（燃素、价值）。但我们知道，燃素说是不正确的，可燃物之间并不存在共同实体；相反，火是由燃料氧化产生的。普里斯特利的“纯燃素”实际上是氢。金属与其“氧化物”之间的差异源于氧化，而非燃素损失。最终发现的共同特征是：可燃物质可以通过氧化转变为较低能量状态。
en: The justification given by eighteenth-century chemists is structurally very similar to Marx’s dialectical presentation. Common properties (combustibility, exchangeability) and forms of expression (flame, price in gold) – dialectical inference there must be a common substance (phlogiston, value). But we know that the phlogiston theory was wrong, that there is no common substance to things that combust; instead, fire is produced by the oxidation of the fuel. Priestly’s pure phlogiston was actually hydrogen. The difference between a metal and its ‘calc’ is due to oxidation, not the loss of phlogiston. The shared characteristic eventually discovered was that combustible substances could transition to a lower energy state through oxidation.

zh: 虽然马克思可能把价值视为可交换商品中的共同实体，并论证劳动在抽象层面上可量化且是商品存在必要条件，但仅凭这一点并不能证实劳动就是那种共同实体。
en: While Marx may have identified value as a common substance in exchangeable commodities and argued that labour is abstractly quantifiable and essential for a commodity’s existence, this alone does not confirm labour as that substance.

zh: 这并非要质疑马克思正确性；而是可以设想，可能存在另一种被他忽略的共同实体。能量是一个首要候选者，它既具备抽象可量化特性，又能以热能、电能、动能和化学能等多种具体形式表现出来。
en: It is not a matter of contesting Marx’s correctness; rather, it is conceivable that there exists another common substance he overlooked. Energy is a prime candidate, possessing the qualities of abstract quantifiability and the ability to manifest in various concrete forms, such as heat, electricity, kinetic energy and chemical energy.

zh: 马克思推导的正确性并不取决于其理论上的合理性，而在于商品价值是否确实与劳动含量成正比。如果经实测发现，价格与生产商品所需瓦特秒（即焦耳）数量的相关性，远高于与人类劳动人秒数量的相关性，那么马克思观点就是错误的。如今我们已知，从经验上看马克思是正确的。商品价格与劳动人秒相关性远高于与所耗能量焦耳相关性。若是那种情况，马克思关于资本主义运动的定律就只会是能量守恒定律的一个特例，而非更高阶统计力学定律。
en: The correctness of Marx’s derivation rests not on its intellectual plausibility, but on whether in fact commodity values are proportional to labour content. If it turns out when we measure things that prices correlate much more closely with the number of watt-seconds = Joules needed to make a commodity rather than the number of person-seconds of human effort, then Marx would be wrong. We now know that empirically Marx was right. Commodity prices do correlate much more closely with person-seconds of labour than with Joules of energy used. In that case, Marx’s laws of capitalist motion would just be a special case of the conservation of energy rather than higher order statistical mechanics laws.
body.review: 底本在陈述劳动相关性更强之后，紧接In that case ... would ...，其指代与段内次序存在歧义。中文保留假设语气；未调换原句顺序或删去该句。

zh: 当然，马克思并非随意选择劳动作为价值实体。他遵循了从哈勒敦
到李嘉图
的学术传统——他们曾通过粗略而简便的方法观察到，这种必要经验关系确实存在。
en: Of course, Marx was not arbitrarily selecting labour as the value substance. He was following a tradition from Khaldūn
to Ricardo
who had observed, by rough and ready means, that the requisite empirical relation actually existed.

zh: 作为一种科学方法，马克思做法确实是一条捷径。它未达到现代科学的严谨性标准，依赖辩证法“障眼法”。理想情况下，他本应提供自己的实证数据来证实“劳动是价值本质”这一主张，或者至少援引其前辈的观察论据，以支持“劳动含量决定价格”这一观点。
en: Marx’s approach, as a scientific procedure, was indeed a shortcut. It lacked the modern standards of scientific rigour, relying on dialectical sleight of hand. Ideally, he should have provided his own empirical data to substantiate the assertion that labour is the essence or at least referenced the observational arguments of his predecessors that supported the notion that labour content dictates price.

zh: 这些来源——即他的前辈们——并未被隐瞒。《资本论》第四卷题为《剩余价值理论》，整卷都献给了他的前辈及其思想。从中，我们可以辨别出他认为哪些观点正确，他们之间存在哪些概念争论，以及他认为他们的推理在哪些地方存在缺陷。
en: These sources, his predecessors, are not concealed. The entire fourth volume of Capital, titled Theories of Surplus Value, is dedicated to his predecessors and their thoughts. Within, we can discern which ideas he deemed correct, the conceptual disputes among them, and where he found their reasoning flawed.

zh: 然而，对于像《资本论》这样兼具科学性和论战性的著作，辩证法或许大有裨益。当目标是说服读者时，辩证修辞可被视为一种有效策略。问题在于，后世把这些方法视为值得效仿的研究标准时，问题便出现了。
en: However, dialectical methods might offer benefits in a work that is both scientific and polemical, such as Capital. When the goal is to persuade readers, dialectical rhetoric can be judged as an effective strategy. The issue arises when later generations regard these methods as a standard for investigation worthy of emulation.

zh: 马克思的论点之所以成立，是因为他站在了前辈们“巨人的肩膀”上。
他得以把斯密和李嘉图此前已奠定的理论基础融入自己的辩证论述之中。
en: Marx’s argument only works because he stood on the giant shoulders of his predecessors.
He could introduce into his dialectical argument something which had been prepared earlier by Smith and Ricardo.

zh: 这也是为何此后进一步尝试应用辩证法都是徒劳的。马克思主义经济学中的黑格尔学派未能通过这种方法进行创新或产生新知识，因为该方法本身并非为此目的而设计。它仅仅是把现有知识重新表述为修辞结构罢了。
en: This is also why further attempts to apply the dialectical method are futile. The Hegelian school of Marxist economists has failed to innovate or generate new knowledge through this method, as it is not designed for such purposes. It merely reformulates pre-existing knowledge into rhetorical constructs.

zh: 这一点在关于自然辩证法的那些荒谬论述中尤为明显。这些理论的支持者并未发现任何新东西。相反，他们只是把通过常规研究方法获得的科学知识，用“对立统一”和“量变到质变”等辩证概念术语重新包装了一下。
en: This is particularly evident in the non-sensical writings on natural dialectics. Proponents of these theories have not uncovered anything novel. Instead, they have repackaged scientific knowledge, obtained through conventional research methods, in the terminology of dialectical concepts like the unity of opposites and the transition from quantity to quality.

zh: 恩格斯
之所以能把水转化为蒸汽作为“量变到质变”以及“辩证飞跃”的例证，完全是因为此前热力学领域已有相关研究。布莱克及其助手瓦特的研究所揭示的，正是热本身可以量化
，并且汽化潜热这一现象确实存在。辩证法并非他们这些发现的必要条件。事实上，布莱克教授早在1761 年就发现了潜热，这比黑格尔时代要早得多。我们提及布莱克有两个原因：其一，他的思想后来被恩格斯作为自然辩证法范例加以阐述；其二，这些思想与马克思在《资本论》中后续论述的一个阶段——剩余价值奥秘——密切相关。
en: Engels

is only able to use the transition of water into steam as an example of a change of quantity into quality and as an example of dialectical leap because of prior work in thermodynamics. The investigations of Black and his assistant Watt had to have shown that heat itself was quantifiable

and that there was such a thing as a latent heat of steam vapourization. The dialectical method was not essential for their discoveries. Indeed, Professor Black discovered latent heat in 1761, well before Hegel’s time. We reference Black for two reasons: his ideas were later showcased by Engels as examples of natural dialectics, and they pertain to a subsequent stage in Marx’s discourse in ‘Capital’—the mystery of surplus value.

zh: 马克思通过把劳动视为价值的共同本质，来回应亚里士多德关于使用价值与交换价值的二分法——这一见解源自他从早期政治经济学家那里汲取的智慧。随后，他解决了另一个重大辩证矛盾：剩余价值谜题。如你所知，他首先提出一个悖论：资本的
循环过程确实存在，但这似乎与商品等价交换的一般原则相冲突。他问道：如果沿途所有商品交换都是等值交换，那么
的情况如何可能发生？
en: Marx addresses Aristotle’s dichotomy between use value and exchange value by positing labour as the shared essence of value, an insight he gained from earlier political economists. He then resolves another significant dialectical contradiction: the enigma of surplus value. If you recall, he first presents the paradox that the circuit of capital m-c-m’ exists, which appears to conflict with the general principle of equivalent exchange of commodities. How, he asks, can you have m<m’ if all commodity exchanges along the way are exchanges of equal value?

zh: 正如我们在第5.3.1 节中所解释的，马克思通过在“劳动”与“劳动力”之间作出概念区分来解决这一问题。他把劳动力定义为劳动能力。马克思认为，资本家用工资购买的是劳动力，而不是劳动本身。剩余价值奥秘在于：劳动力价值由其再生产劳动成本决定——这与所有商品一样——但维持工人一天生活所需劳动量却少于一整天劳动。这部分多余时间，即工作日长度与工资购买的生活资料的劳动价值之间的差额，便成为剩余价值来源。
en: As we explain in Section 5.3.1, Marx addressed the issue with a conceptual distinction between labour and labour power. He defined labour power as the capacity to work. According to Marx, it is labour power, not labour itself, that the capitalist purchases with wages. The mystery of surplus value is unveiled by the fact that the value of labour power is set by its labour cost of reproduction, similar to all commodities, yet it requires less than a full day’s labour to sustain the worker for a day. The excess time, which is the difference between the working day’s length and the labour value of the wage goods, becomes the source of surplus value.

zh: 这种把劳动与劳动力区分开来的观点，是政治经济学领域一项创新。斯密和李嘉图等前辈曾把工资等同于劳动本身价值，其中李嘉图认为，工资与维持工人生活所需劳动量相等。此外，李嘉图还指出工资与构成资本家利润的价值份额之间的反向关系。
en: This differentiation between labour and labour power was an innovation in political economy. Predecessors like Smith and Ricardo had equated the wage with the value of labour itself, with Ricardo determining that the wage matched the labour needed to sustain the worker. Furthermore, Ricardo identified the inverse relationship between wages and the proportion of value that forms the capitalist’s profit.

zh: 马克思在此处的创新有两方面：
en: Marx’s innovations here were twofold:

zh: 1. 从利润推广到剩余价值——其中还包括地租和利息。
2. 把“劳动”与“劳动力”区分开来。
en: 1. Generalization from profit to surplus value – which included also rent and interest.
2. The distinction between labour and labour power.

zh: 可以认为，《资本论》中对这一问题的阐述采用了黑格尔式修辞技巧：先从“
”之间推导出矛盾，然后通过“劳动力”这一新概念来化解矛盾。但这并不能解释，这种辩证“魔术”究竟是从何处衍生出“劳动力”这一概念的。
en: It can be argued that the mode of presentation of the issue in Capital uses Hegelian rhetorical tricks: deriving a contradiction between c-m-c and m-c-m’ and then resolving the contradiction in a new concept, labour power. But that does not explain where the dialectical conjuration produces the idea of labour power from.

zh: 这一概念显然并非源自黑格尔，在斯密或李嘉图著作中也找不到。相反，如前所述，它源于瓦特（Watt）的概念。瓦特研究为马克思理论奠定了双重基础。瓦特与布莱克（Black）共同发现蒸汽具有潜热后，意识到通过添加独立冷凝器可以显著提高蒸汽机效率。这一洞见不仅确保了他作为工程师的成功，也推动了资本主义工业化进程。马克思指出，手摇磨坊催生了封建领主，而蒸汽磨坊则催生了工业资本家。实际上，瓦特发明对产生马克思所称的“相对剩余价值”起到了关键作用。它促成了蒸汽动力机械的广泛应用，取代了人力劳动，并为马克思提供了揭开剩余价值之谜所需的理论工具。马克思指出，亚里士多德由于受奴隶社会意识形态束缚，未能认识到劳动是价值的共同实体。只有随着经济发展，斯密才看清了这一点。
en: This idea certainly did not originate from Hegel, nor can it be found in Smith or Ricardo. Rather, as previously mentioned, it stemmed from Watt’s concepts. Watt’s work laid a dual foundation for Marx’s. Watt, having discovered with Black that steam had latent heat, realized he could significantly enhance steam engine efficiency by adding separate condensers. This insight not only secured his success as an engineer but also propelled capitalist industrialization. Marx noted that the hand mill yielded the feudal lord, while the steam mill brought forth the industrial capitalist. Practically, Watt’s invention was pivotal in generating what Marx termed relative surplus value. It enabled the widespread adoption of steam-powered machinery, supplanting human labour and providing Marx with the theoretical tools needed to unravel the mystery of surplus value. Marx observed that Aristotle failed to recognize labour as the common substance of value due to the ideological constraints of slave society. It was only through economic advancement that this became apparent to Smith.

zh: 因此，到马克思著书立说之时，工程实践已把“功”与“功率”之间、以及“功”与“做功能力”之间的概念区分，纳入了工业化英国的普遍基础知识范畴。同样，资本主义商业实践中蒸汽机租赁行为，也确立了按月费出租这些机器做功能力的原则。
en: So by the time Marx is writing, engineering practice has made the conceptual distinction between work and power, between work and the ability to perform work, part of the common basic knowledge of industrial England. Similarly, capitalist commercial practice in the renting of steam engines had established the principle of hiring out the ability of these engines to perform work for a monthly rate.

zh: 当斯密著书时，他的熟人瓦特仍在捣鼓原型机，
甚至在李嘉图时代，与水磨相比，蒸汽机也相对罕见。但到马克思著书之时，热力学和资本主义文明实践已经为他提供了必要的概念抽象，使他能够区分劳动与劳动力，从而解决了剩余价值问题。
en: When Smith was writing, his acquaintance Watt was still tinkering with his prototypes,

and even in Ricardo’s time steam engines were relatively rare compared to water mills. But by the time Marx was writing, thermodynamics and the practice of capitalist civilization had provided the conceptual abstractions necessary for him to make the distinction between labour and labour power and thus solve the problem of surplus value.

zh: 此外，还有一个平行概念——剩余价值率对应于蒸汽机的煤炭回报率：即消耗煤炭与运出煤炭之比。这被称为能源投资回报率，代表了工业资本主义社会在热力学或能源方面的本质限制。正的剩余对于正的相对剩余价值率至关重要。随着我们日益接近化石燃料资本主义危机，这些比率之间关联值得政治经济学家进一步研究。
en: Additionally, there is a parallel concept – the rate of surplus value corresponds to the steam engine’s coal return rate: the proportion of coal consumed versus coal hauled. Known as the energy return on investment, this represents the essential thermodynamic or energy limitation of industrial capitalist society. A positive surplus is crucial for a positive rate of relative surplus value. The correlation between these rates warrants further investigation by political economists as we near the fossil fuel capitalism crisis.
body.review: 底本将此比率写为“消耗煤炭与运出煤炭之比”，随后称energy return on investment；本译保留其比率方向，不擅自倒置。

zh: 此外，我们不应把辩证法修辞策略与实际历史或观念结构混为一谈。辩证法家的成功取决于能否利用现有概念。其方法有效性在于按适当顺序揭示这些概念，并假定听众对所呈现思想有一定了解。在19 世纪中叶，“劳动作为价值来源”以及“功”与“功率”的区分等概念，对《资本论》普通读者而言，大概已经足够熟悉，足以理解马克思论点。
en: Furthermore, we should not confuse the dialectical method’s rhetorical manoeuvres with actual historical or ideational structures. A dialectician’s success hinges on the availability of pre-existing concepts to utilize. The effectiveness of their method depends on unveiling these concepts in an appropriate sequence and assumes the audience has some understanding of the presented ideas. In the mid-nineteenth century, concepts such as labour as a value source and the distinction between work and power were presumably familiar enough for the typical reader of ‘Capital’ to grasp Marx’s points.

zh: 马克思把某些概念融入政治经济学的独创性并不受质疑。然而，这些基础思想并非源自黑格尔，而是源于更早期的社会研究和工程研究。当今要推进马克思主义科学，就必须研究经济和社会数据中的具体模式，并广泛借鉴各门科学和工程学中的分析工具。辩证法研究，充其量只能提供一种围绕研究发现构建有说服力叙事的方式。然而，这种方法风险重重，因为要取得成功，需要具备与马克思相媲美的非凡修辞才能。若由那些缺乏马克思博士写作造诣和广博知识的人来操作，结果很可能平淡无奇、索然无味。
en: Marx’s originality in adapting certain concepts to political economy is not under scrutiny. However, the foundational ideas originated not from Hegel but from earlier social and engineering studies. Advancing Marxist science today necessitates studying tangible patterns in economic and social data and drawing extensively from the sciences and engineering for analytical tools. Dialectics study, at best, offers a way to craft compelling narratives around your findings. However, this approach is fraught with risk, as it requires an extraordinary rhetorical talent akin to that of Marx to succeed. In the hands of individuals lacking Dr Marx’s writing prowess and extensive knowledge, the outcome is likely to be dull and uninspiring.

zh: 达尔文与目的论的终结

children: Darwin and the end of teleology

zh: 顺便提一句，我正在阅读的达尔文著作绝对精彩绝伦。目的论曾有一个方面尚未被推翻，而如今这一工作已然完成。此前从未有人以如此宏大尝试来论证自然界中的历史演化，更遑论取得如此卓著效果了。
en: Darwin, by the way, whom I’m reading just now, is absolutely splendid. There was one aspect of teleology that had yet to be demolished, and that has now been done. Never before has so grandiose an attempt been made to demonstrate historical evolution in Nature, and certainly never to such good effect.

zh: 达尔文著作至关重要，且恰好符合我的目的，因为它为历史性阶级斗争提供了自然科学基础。……尽管存在种种不足，正是在此处，自然科学中的“目的论”不仅首次遭受致命打击，其理性含义也得到了经验性阐释。
en: Darwin’s work is most important and suits my purpose in that it provides a basis in natural science for the historical class struggle. . . . Despite all shortcomings, it is here that, for the first time, ‘teleology’ in natural science is not only dealt a mortal blow but its rational meaning is empirically explained.

zh: 达尔文著作中有两个重要主题特别值得关注。第一个是通过自然选择理论对目的论的解构，这一点曾被恩格斯和马克思强调。其次是挑战人类例外论，把人类单纯视为哺乳动物中的又一物种。达尔文基本方法是通过动物行为视角来解读人类行为。他并不回避把类似人类的特质归于动物，而且提出：要理解人类特征，就必须承认我们共同的哺乳动物血统。
en: Two significant themes in Darwin’s work are particularly noteworthy. The first is the dismantling of teleology through his theory of natural selection, a point that Engels and Marx emphasized. The second is the challenge to human exceptionalism, viewing humans simply as another species of mammal. Darwin’s fundamental approach was to interpret human behaviour through the lens of animal behaviour. Rather than shying away from attributing human-like qualities to animals, he posited that understanding human traits requires acknowledging our shared mammalian heritage.

zh: 对这一观点的抵制很可能源于与早期经济体系相关的意识形态。例如，亚里士多德关于某些个体天生就是奴隶的论断，反映了当时社会状况。同样，依赖马、牛等动物劳动的经济体系，需要明确划分人类与动物界限。人类，如同奴隶主一样，被视为理性生物，而动物或奴隶据称则缺乏这种特质。
en: The resistance to this perspective likely stems from the ideologies tied to earlier economic systems. For instance, Aristotle’s assertion that some individuals were naturally slaves mirrored the societal conditions of his time. Similarly, an economy reliant on animal labour, such as that of horses and oxen, necessitated a clear demarcation between humans and animals. Humans, akin to slave masters, were deemed rational beings, a quality supposedly absent in animals or slaves.

zh: 达尔文出身于当时正在崛起的贵格会工业阶级家庭，是奴隶制的坚定反对者，
他在撰写相关著作时，蒸汽动力正逐渐取代马力，成为社会驱动力。他既致力于主张白人与黑人的共同人性，也致力于阐明人类与动物作为哺乳动物的共同特征。
en: Darwin, whose family background was in the rising Quaker industrial class, was a passionate opponent of slavery,

and he wrote when steam was displacing horsespower as the motive force of society. He could work both to assert the common humanity of white and black and the common mammalian character of human and animal.

zh: 终结目的论
en: Ending teleology

zh: 19 世纪中叶，如何解释漫长地质时间以及地球物种曾多次经历彻底变迁这一事实，成为一项重大挑战。这一过程显然具有方向性，而非循环往复。于是问题随之而来：这该如何解释？同样，从资本主义工业文明角度来看，历史似乎也具有方向性。究竟哪种因果模型能够解释这一现象？
en: In the mid-nineteenth century, there was a significant challenge in explaining the vast expanse of time and the realization that Earth’s species had undergone complete transformations repeatedly. This process was clearly directional, not cyclical. The question arose: how could this be explained? Similarly, from the perspective of capitalist industrial civilization, history appeared to have a direction. What causal model could explain this phenomenon?

zh: 目的论是其中一种解决方案。马克思和恩格斯把达尔文对目的论的否定视为一个关键性进展。要理解这一点，必须了解达尔文提出其思想时的思想背景。他否定了何种目的论概念？
en: Teleological theories were one solution. Marx and Engels saw Darwin’s rejection of teleology as a pivotal development. To comprehend this, it’s essential to understand the intellectual milieu in which Darwin formulated his ideas. What teleological concept did he dismiss?

zh: 关于物种历史演化的目的论理论中最成熟版本，是由钱伯斯在其1844 年首次出版的《创世自然史遗迹》中提出的。《创世自然史遗迹》一书极具争议性，因为它普及了赫顿、米勒和莱尔的地质深时观，并将其与基督教视角相调和，从而彻底打破了厄舍主教关于“公元前4004 年创世”的说法。钱伯斯很难为该书争取到书评，但该书为《物种起源》问世铺平了道路。
en: The most developed version of a teleological theory of the historical evolution of species had been put forward by Chambers in his

children: Vestiges of the Natural History of Creation

en: , first published in 1844. Vestiges was extremely controversial as it popularized Hutton/Miller/Lyell’s geological deep time reconciled with a Christian perspective, breaking decisively with Bishop Usher’s creation in 4004 BC. Chambers found it hard to get it reviewed, but it paved the way for Origin of Species.

zh: 这本书有趣之处在于，当时人们对天文学和地质学了解程度之深。钱伯斯不仅对太阳系规模，而且对半人马座α 星距离都有相当准确估算，并对我们银河系形状也有相当清晰认识。他知道还有其他许多星系。他对太阳系形成过程描述，与如今学校天文学教科书中内容相差无几。
en: What is interesting about the book is just how much was known about astronomy and geology at this point. Chambers had a pretty good estimate of the size not only of the solar system but also of the distance to Alpha Centauri, a fair idea of the shape of our galaxy. He was aware that there were multiple other galaxies. His account of how the solar system was formed was not so far off from what you would now get in a school astronomy book.

zh: 书中概述了地质年代大致脉络。令人着迷的是，坎布里亚纪（Cumbrian，并非寒武纪Cambrian）、泥盆纪、志留纪、石炭纪和白垩纪这些地质年代，并未像如今那样被呈现为带有起止日期的抽象时期，而是直接与英国特定地区岩层相关联——例如泥盆纪位于德文郡，坎布里亚纪位于威尔士，白垩纪位于苏塞克斯郡。
en: The broad outlines of geological time are recounted. It is fascinating how the ages: Cumbrian (not Cambrian), Devonian, Silurian, Carboniferous and Cretaceous are not presented as abstract epochs with start and end dates as they are now, but rather are directly related to the rocks in specific parts of Britain, such as Devonian in Devon, Cumbrian in Wales and Cretaceous in Sussex.
body.review: 底本明确写Cumbrian (not Cambrian)，并在后文将其对应威尔士；中文保留底本这一区分与地理表述。

zh: 他对主要动植物类群出现时间顺序有大致了解，但在地质成因方面，他持有一些当时看似合理、如今却显得荒诞不经的观点。例如，他认为沉积“古红砂岩”的海域深度达数百英里，且直到石炭纪之前都不存在陆地。他提出一个引人入胜假说：在石炭纪之前，二氧化碳
浓度过高，陆地动物无法生存。根据他的理论，碳的封存使得陆地动物得以在他所称的“新红砂岩”时期出现，而我们现在把这一时期认定为二叠纪至侏罗纪。
en: He had a rough understanding of the chronological appearance of major animal and plant classes, but he held what might have seemed plausible, yet now appears to be wild ideas about geological causes. For example, he believed that the seas where the Old Red Sandstone was deposited were hundreds of miles deep and that dry land did not exist until the Carboniferous period. He proposed the intriguing hypothesis that before the Carboniferous,

levels were too high for land animals to exist. According to his theory, the sequestration of carbon allowed land animals to emerge during what he referred to as ‘the new red sandstone’, which we now identify as the Permian to Jurassic periods.

zh: 他提出观点中明显体现了目的论：形成煤层的森林既是为了净化空气以维持动物生命，也是为了提供我们文明所需燃料。
en: The teleology is evident in his suggestion that the
of the forests giving rise to the coal beds was both to purify the air for animal life and to provide the fuel needed for our civilization.

zh: 这与他关于动物形态如何产生的理论密切相关。他强调，用他的话说，生命会抓住任何机会。在现代人听来，这似乎是生命为适应生态位而快速进化的观念，但在他看来，这被视为形态规律的发展。他是一位鲜明的自然主义者。生命遵循自然法则而产生，生命形态同样受这些法则驱动。早在19 世纪初，他就确信电是生命源泉。这与玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦》所探讨主题遥相呼应。
en: This was tied to his theory of how animal forms arise. He emphasized that life as he put

on any opportunities. To a modern ear, this sounds like the idea of life rapidly evolving to fit ecological niches, but in his case, it was seen as the development of the laws of form. He was a pronounced naturalist. Life arises by natural laws and the forms of life are driven by them as well. He was convinced by the early nineteenth century that electricity was the source of life. This echoed the same themes as Mary Shelly’s Frankenstein.

zh: 例如，他声称电放电中出现的树枝状或分支图案与树木形态相同，因为在带负电地球与带正电大气之间，起作用的是相同电学定律。这种电势推动了植物生长，并造就了树木、棕榈等植物特征形态。他甚至引用了克罗斯先生进行的一项类似《弗兰肯斯坦》的实验——该先生声称，通过向“硅酸钾”通入强电流，观察到了昆虫生命自发生成。据称，威克斯先生使用“亚铁氰化钾”也成功复现了这一实验。
en: As an example, he claimed that the dendritic or branching pattern that you get in electric discharges was the same as you get in trees because the same electric laws operate between the negatively charged Earth and the positively charged atmosphere. This electric potential drove plant growth and gave rise to the characteristic shapes of trees, palms, etc. He even cited a Frankenstein-like experiment by a Mr Crosse, who claimed to have observed the spontaneous generation of insect life by passing strong electric currents through ‘silicate of potash’. This was apparently replicated by Mr Weekes using ‘ferro-cyanet of potash’.

zh: 这些昆虫据说非常微小，“是一种微小的、半透明的、长有长刚毛的ascuraus”。
en: The insects were apparently rather minute, ‘a species of ascuraus minute and semi transparent and furnished with long bristles’.

zh: 这一系列实验的引用并不十分令人信服：“参见威克斯先生于1842 年发行的一份小册子”。
en: The citation for this series of experiments is not very convincing: ‘see a pamphlet circulated by Mr. Weekes in 1842’.

zh: 钱伯斯把自然法则与“摩西经文”相调和的基本方式是：上帝意欲让生命存在，而非亲手创造了每一类生物。相反，宇宙的大建筑师设计了自然法则，以确保行星首先形成，随后生命会通过电作用从无机化合物中自发产生。然后，一旦出现新的物理条件，相应生命形式就会自发发展起来以填补这一空间。
en: The basic way Chambers reconciles natural law with ‘the Mosaic texts’, is to say that God willed that there be life, not that he created each line of organisms. Instead, natural laws were so designed by The Great Architect of the Universe as to ensure that first planets would come into existence, and then that life would spontaneously be generated by electricity from inorganic compounds. Then, as soon as new physical conditions arose, the appropriate form of life would spontaneously develop to fill the space.

zh: 对现代读者而言，他反复使用“物种作为过渡形式”这一概念令人困惑。如今，我们从达尔文主义角度理解“过渡形式”——始祖鸟作为爬行动物与鸟类之间过渡形式，是指它源自爬行动物，而后来的鸟类则源自它（或其近亲之一）。
en: To the modern reader, it is disconcerting that he repeatedly uses the idea of species being links. We now think of links in Darwinian terms –
being the link between reptiles and birds in the sense that it was descended from reptiles and that subsequent birds descend from it (or one of its close relatives).

zh: 然而，他所指的“过渡形式”如今已被认为可信度极低。他认为，具有骨质外层的泥盆纪盾皮鱼是甲壳类与鱼类之间过渡形式。他提出，鸵鸟——其膀胱和膈肌与哺乳动物相似，羽毛则类似于毛发——是哺乳动物与鸟类之间过渡形式。他还视鸭嘴兽为鸟类与哺乳动物之间过渡形式。他提出的演化序列是：鱼类、爬行动物（包括两栖动物）、鸟类，然后是哺乳动物。因此，鸵鸟正在演化为哺乳动物的观点与这一序列相吻合。他经常使用时间顺序术语，把鱼类置于首位，而把爬行动物置于更高位置或随后位置，这反映了一种目的论序列，与物种出现的地质记录相吻合。他作品中核心的目的论主题是：存在一种与生俱来的“发展法则”，它引导着更高等生命形式的产生。钱伯斯以蜜蜂为例——蜜蜂幼虫喂养方式决定了它们长大后是成为蜂王、工蜂还是雄蜂——据此推测，胚胎环境条件改变将导致后代发育得更为完善。他声称，一旦摆脱野蛮状态艰辛，生活在欧洲环境中的非洲人不仅会同化于欧洲人的生活方式，而且外貌也会趋同于欧洲人：
en: However, the links he refers to are now considered to have little credibility. He believes that Devonian placoderms with bone coverings are a transitional form between crustaceans and fish. He suggests that ostriches, with their urinary bladder and diaphragm similar to mammals and feathers resembling hair, are a link between mammals and birds. He also views the platypus as an intermediary between birds and mammals. His proposed sequence is Fish, Reptiles (including amphibians), Birds and then Mammals. Thus, the notion that ostriches are evolving into mammals aligns with this sequence. He frequently employs temporal terms, placing fish first and reptiles either higher or subsequent, reflecting a teleological sequence that coincides with the geological record of species emergence. The central teleological theme of his work was the notion that there was an innate ‘law of development’ that led to the generation of higher forms of life. Using the analogy with honey bees, the feeding of whose larvae determines whether they emerge as queens, workers or drones, Chambers hypothesized that changed conditions in embryo will lead to more developed offspring. He claimed that once removed from the hardships of barbarism, Africans who lived in European conditions would assimilate not only to the mode of life of Europeans but also to their appearance:

zh: 黑人种族的粗犷五官及其他结构上的特殊性，仅在这些人生活在通常与野蛮状态相关联的环境中时才会持续存在。在气候更为温和、社会状态更高级的环境中，面部和体态会变得极为精致。那些拥有一定文明的少数非洲民族，其外貌也呈现出接近欧洲人的特征。
en: The coarse features, and other structural peculiarities of the negro race only continue while these people live amidst the circumstances usually associated with barbarism. In a more temperate clime, and higher social state, the face and figure become greatly refined. The few African nations which possess any civilisation also exhibit forms approaching the European.

zh: 他是一位极端环境决定论者。他认为，居住在欧洲的非洲人第三代后裔之所以看起来更“精致”，并非归因于通婚，而是归因于生活条件。钱伯斯毫不犹豫地断定，他在本国同胞身上最熟悉的那些特征才是最先进的。在他看来，整个自然发展法则似乎以孕育出一位营养充足的英国上层阶级成员为最终目标。
en: He was an extreme environmentalist. That third-generation descendants of Africans resident in Europe might look more ‘refined’ was not put down to intermarriage, but to living conditions. Chambers unhesitatingly assumed that those features he was most familiar with among his own countrymen were the most advanced. The whole law of development of nature aimed, it seemed to him, to produce as its goal a well-fed member of the British upper classes.

zh: 他利用哺乳动物、鱼类、爬行动物等之间胚胎学相似性，论证哺乳动物胚胎分化是内在发育规律的结果，只要条件允许，鱼类胚胎也具备这种能力。
en: Using the embryological similarity between mammals, fish, reptiles, etc., he argues that the differentiation of a mammalian embryo is the result of an inbuilt developmental law, which, given the appropriate opportunities, a fish embryo is also capable of.

zh: 人类胎儿的躯体中，往往有一处最重要部位发育不完全：例如，心脏仅停留在三腔结构阶段，因此它实际上是爬行动物的心脏。甚至还有这样的例子：该器官仍保留着双腔或鱼类形态。此类缺陷纯粹是由于母体机体发育能力不足所致，而这种不足又源于体质虚弱或生活困苦。在这里，我们显然看到了一种与那些使物种向另一物种转变的条件相反的情况——至少就这一器官而言是如此。既然在这个特定点上出现了完全的物种退化，那么不难想象，一旦有利条件充分增加，便足以逆转这一现象，使鱼类母亲发育出爬行动物心脏，或使爬行动物母亲发育出哺乳动物心脏。推测如下并非过于大胆：若这种“不足”程度被“过度补偿”（前者与后者似乎同样是自然现象），就足以使一只鹅的后代拥有老鼠身体，从而产生鸭嘴兽；或者，使鸭嘴兽后代拥有真正啮齿动物嘴巴和脚，从而在两个阶段内完成从鸟类到哺乳类转变。
en: A human foetus is often left with one of the most important parts of its frame imperfectly developed: the heart, for instance, goes no farther than the three-chambered form, so that it is the heart of a reptile. There are even instances of this organ being left in the two-chambered or fish form. Such defects are the result of nothing more than a failure of the power of development in the system of the mother, occasioned by weak health or misery. Here we have apparently a realisation of the converse of those conditions which carry on species to species, so far, at least, as one organ is concerned. Seeing a complete specific retrogression in this one point, how easy it is to imagine an access of favourable conditions sufficient to reverse the phenomenon, and make a fish mother develop a reptile heart, or a reptile mother develop a mammal one. It is no great boldness to surmise that a super-adequacy in the measure of this under-adequacy (and the one thing seems as natural an occurrence as the other) would suffice in a goose to give its progeny the body of a rat, and produce the ornithorynchus, or might give the progeny of an ornithorynchus the mouth and feet of a true rodent, and thus complete at two stages the passage from the aves to the mammalia.

zh: 他深信，生命不仅存在于火星和木星上，而且由于这一发育定律，这些生命与地球上生命极为相似；在其他恒星周围无数行星上，也存在着类似生物。这种自负观点，在当今时代，也被《星球大战》制片人所共享。
en: He was convinced that life existed not only on Mars and Jupiter but that, thanks to this developmental law, it looked very much like Earth life, and that similar organisms exist on countless planets around other stars. A conceit which is shared, in our day, by the producers of Star Wars.

zh: 钱伯斯著作描绘了一幅生物在内在发展规律引导下，不断、渐进地向上发展图景——这一概念无疑具有目的论色彩，尤其是考虑到钱伯斯把它解释为上帝设计体现。然而，这种进步观念与某些对马克思主义的常见诠释颇为相似：其中，从鱼类到爬行动物、鸟类，最终到哺乳动物的必然演进，恰与不同生产方式演进相呼应。例如，塞耶斯
指出：
en: Chambers’ book presents a vision of a relentless, progressive ascent of organisms, guided by an inherent law of development – a concept that is undeniably teleological, especially considering Chambers’ interpretation of it as the manifestation of God’s design. However, this notion of progress bears a resemblance to certain common portrayals of Marxism, where the inevitable advancement from fish to reptiles, birds and ultimately mammals parallels the progression through different modes of production. Sayers
for example, claims that

zh: 马克思主义把历史发展的进步模式理解为阶级斗争以及生产力与生产关系之间冲突的结果。马克思——就像达尔文一样——最恰当的理解并非在于他否定了目的论观念，而在于他采用了一种与现代科学相一致的自然主义版本的目的论。
en: Marxism comprehends the progressive patterns of historical development as the outcome of class struggle and the conflict between the forces and relations of production. Marx – like Darwin – is best understood, not as repudiating teleological notions, but rather as using a naturalistic version of them that is consistent with modern science.

zh: 这种观点的问题在于，钱伯斯（Chambers）那种颇具影响力的达尔文之前理论，同样可以被描述为提出了一种符合19 世纪中叶现代科学的自然主义目的论。马克思赞扬达尔文打破了这一范式，这表明他认为自己和达尔文研究都与目的论有着根本性区别。
en: The problem with this is that the influential pre-Darwinian account of Chambers could also be described as presenting a naturalistic version of teleology consistent with modern science as it stood in the mid-nineteenth century. That Marx applauded Darwin for breaking with this paradigm indicates that he saw both his own work and Darwin’s as radically distinct from teleology.

zh: 查尔斯·达尔文提出的因果机制概要如下：
en: An outline of the causal mechanism proposed by Charles Darwin is:

zh: 所有动植物物种中都存在变异。
en: Variation exists in all animal and plant species.

zh: 可变性状可以遗传。
en: Variable traits can be inherited.

zh: 对可变性状的选择会增加其出现频率，这一点从农民和园艺师对动植物选育中即可得到印证。
en: Selection for variable traits increases their frequency, as evidenced by the selective breeding of animals and plants by farmers and gardeners.

zh: 生存竞争会筛选出最适应环境、从而能繁育后代的个体。
en: The struggle for survival selects those best adapted to produce offspring.

zh: 这可能导致足够大变化，从而产生新物种。
en: This can lead to sufficient change that new species arise

zh: 他在《物种起源》第三章中用一段话很好总结了自己的理论：
en: He gives a good one-paragraph summary of his theory in the third chapter of

zh: 由于这种生存斗争，任何变异——无论多么微小，无论源于何种原因——只要在某一物种的个体与其他生物及外部自然环境的无限复杂关系中，能给该个体带来任何程度的益处，就会有助于该个体保存，并且通常会遗传给其后代。后代也将因此获得更大生存机会，因为在任何物种周期性诞生的众多个体中，只有少数能够存活下来。我把这一原则——即任何微小变异，只要是有益的，就会被保留下来——称为“自然选择”，以此标明它与人类选择能力之间关系。我们已经看到，人类通过人工选择确实能够取得巨大成果，并能利用大自然赋予的微小但有益的变异，通过其积累，使生物适合自身需求。但正如我们今后将看到的，自然选择是一种随时准备发挥作用的力量，它比人类微弱努力要高明无数倍，正如自然之作远胜于人工之作。
en: Owing to this struggle for life, any variation, however slight and from whatever cause proceeding, if it be in any degree profitable to an individual of any species, in its infinitely complex relations to other organic beings and to external nature, will tend to the preservation of that individual, and will generally be inherited by its offspring. The offspring, also, will thus have a better chance of surviving, for, of the many individuals of any species which are periodically born, but a small number can survive. I have called this principle, by which each slight variation, if useful, is preserved, by the term of Natural Selection, in order to mark its relation to man’s power of selection. We have seen that man by selection can certainly produce great results, and can adapt organic beings to his own uses, through the accumulation of slight but useful variations, given to him by the hand of Nature. But Natural Selection, as we shall hereafter see, is a power incessantly ready for action, and is as immeasurably superior to man’s feeble efforts, as the works of Nature are to those of Art.

zh: 达尔文理论常与拉马克进化论相互对照，人们认为两者关键区别在于后代能否继承获得性状——例如海豹增强的游泳能力。然而，把这种遗传现象称为“拉马克主义”，而把其否定视为“达尔文主义”，实属时代错置。在遗传学被理解之前，后天习得性状与遗传性状是否截然不同并不明显，而且达尔文从未排除获得性状遗传可能性。在某些地方，
他提到后代会继承后天习得的情感表达习惯。
en: Darwin’s theory is frequently contrasted with Lamarckian evolution, where the key distinction is thought to be the inheritance of acquired traits, such as a seal’s improved swimming ability, by offspring. Labelling this inheritance as Lamarckian and its rejection as Darwinian is, however, anachronistic. Before genetics was understood, it wasn’t obvious that learnt traits were separate from inherited ones, and Darwin never ruled out the inheritance of acquired characteristics. In places, in
he speaks of learnt habits of emotional expression being inherited by offspring.

zh: 在
中，他强调自己所要求仅仅是变异存在，无论导致或引发变异具体情况如何。变异起源：
en: In
he emphasizes that all he requires is that variation exists, irrespective of the circumstances that cause it or give rise to it. Origins of variation:

zh: 关于变异原因——无论其具体为何——通常在生命周期哪个阶段起作用，一直存在争议：是在胚胎发育早期还是晚期，抑或是在受精瞬间。杰弗鲁瓦·圣伊莱尔实验表明，对胚胎进行非自然处理会导致畸形；而畸形与单纯变异之间无法用任何明确界限加以区分。但我强烈倾向于认为，变异最常见原因或许可归因于雄性和雌性生殖细胞在受精行为发生之前已受到影响。……事实上，“变异体”支持我的观点，即变异性很大程度上可归因于胚珠或花粉，或二者，在受精行为发生前受到亲本所受环境影响。
en: It has been disputed at what period of life the causes of variability, whatever they may be, generally act; whether during the early or late period of development of the embryo, or at the instant of conception. Geoffroy St. Hilaire’s experiments show that unnatural treatment of the embryo causes monstrosities; and monstrosities cannot be separated by any clear line of distinction from mere variations. But I am strongly inclined to suspect that the most frequent cause of variability may be attributed to the male and female reproductive elements having been affected prior to the act of conception. . . . in fact, ‘sports’ support my view, that variability may be largely attributed to the ovules or pollen, or to both, having been affected by the treatment of the parent prior to the act of conception.

zh: “变异体”是植物品种中我们现在所称“突变”的旧称。尽管当时尚未有“基因突变”这一概念，但这一论述在功能上具有相似性。他的意思是，影响物种性器官的环境压力可能会诱发变异。如果我们将暴露于背景辐射等因素视为此类压力，那么这一观点仍然成立。
en: Sports is the old term for what we now call mutations in plant varieties. Although the concept of genetic mutation was not yet available, this account is functionally analogous. He is saying that environmental stress affecting the sex organs of a species may induce variation. If we rate exposure to background radiation, etc., as such stress, then this would still be acceptable.

zh: 如果后天习得习惯也能诱导出额外变异，这对他的选择理论影响甚微。无论变异来源是什么，关键在于选择过程。
en: If additional variation could be induced by learnt habits, that makes little difference to his theory of selection. Whatever the source of the variation, the important thing is the selection process.

zh: 他在驯化动植物背景下引入了变异与选择概念。其前几章列举大量实例，展示驯化物种中存在着多么广泛变异。他强调，例如家犬变异程度远比野犬更为广泛。他甚至加入了鸽友协会和鸽育种协会，以深入了解这些鸟类变异范围及其育种者经验之谈。每当他试图阐明一个理论观点时，都会援引大量支持性观察结果。其中一些观察结果对于19 世纪著作而言显得格外现代。例如，他早已意识到家养动物身上存在某些特征，而这些特征直到20 世纪末才得到证实。
en: He introduces variation and selection in the context of domesticated animals and plants. His first chapters contain a wealth of examples showing what vast range of variation there is in our domestic species. He emphasizes that domestic dogs, for example, vary far more widely than wild ones. He went so far as to join pigeon fancier and pigeon breeding societies to educate himself on the range of variation of these birds and the lore of their breeders. Whenever he attempts to establish a theoretical point, he brings in a wealth of supporting observations. Some of his observations seem strikingly modern for nineteenth-century books. For instance, he was aware of traits associated with domesticated animals that were confirmed in the late twentieth century.

zh: 举不出任何一种家养动物，它在所有国家都不出现垂耳；一些作者提出，垂耳是因为这些动物不常受到危险惊吓，导致耳部肌肉不用，这一看法似乎是可信的。
en: Not a single domestic animal can be named which has not in some country drooping ears; and the view suggested by some authors, that the drooping is due to the disuse of the muscles of the ear, from the animals not being much alarmed by danger, seems probable.

zh: 这一经验观察结果得到了现代研究的证实，

但达尔文关于家养性状成因理论并未得到支持。垂耳、短吻、幼态持续行为和斑驳毛色等性状，如今被统称为“驯化综合征”（DS）。20 世纪50 年代末在苏联启动的长期实验——该实验通过选择圈养狐狸进行驯化——为这一过程提供了新见解。经过五十年的选择性育种，由柳德米拉·特鲁特（Lyudmila Trut）领导的研究项目表明，即使在没有驯化历史的物种中，仅通过选择温顺性，也能迅速出现一整套DS 性状。当同一研究团队对大鼠和貂施加相同选择压力时，也观察到了类似结果。
en: The empirical observation is borne out by modern research,

but Darwin’s theory of the causes of domestic traits is not supported. Floppy ears, shorter muzzles, neotonous behaviour and patchy coat are all traits that in combination are now called the domestication syndrome (DS). Long-term experiments begun in the USSR in the late 1950s, which involved selecting captive foxes for domestication, have provided insight into this process. Over fifty years of selective breeding, the research programme led by Lyudmila Trut has shown that a full suite of DS traits can quickly emerge through selecting solely for tameness in a species without prior domestication history. Comparable results have been seen in rats and mink when subjected to the same selection pressures by the same research team.

zh: 通过反复选择所需性状，育种者成功培育出了变异性极强的家养种群。这种变异程度之大，以至于如果把不同犬种置于野外环境中观察，它们看起来会像是不同物种。如果人为选择能制造出物种形成表象，那么何种形式选择才会导致真正物种形成？
en: By repeatedly selecting for desired traits, breeders have been able to create enormously variable domestic stock. The variation is so great that were the different breeds of dogs to be observed in the wild, they would appear to be different species. If deliberate selection can create the appearance of speciation, what form of selection produces actual speciation?

zh: 随后，他引入了自然界中的生存斗争。其根本在于任何生物都具有指数级繁殖潜力。
en: He then introduces the struggle for existence in nature. At its base is the exponential reproductive potential of any living organism.

zh: “每个有机体自然增长的速度都高得惊人，若不被消灭，地球很快就会被一对生物的后代所覆盖”——这一规律没有例外。
en: There is no exception to the rule that every organic being naturally increases at so high a rate, that if not destroyed, the Earth would soon be covered by the progeny of a single pair.

zh: 如果指数增长持续下去，生物数量将很快超出其栖息地承载极限。即便最肥沃环境也是有限。对于每一个生物来说，都存在潜在竞争者。竞争者可能试图捕食你，也可能与你争夺食物或空间。正如他所说，大自然面容常常洋溢着喜悦，而且食物似乎俯拾皆是；然而我们却忽略了一个事实：周围那无忧无虑鸟鸣，源自那些以昆虫或种子为生、不断终结其他生命的生物。我们也忽视了这些歌者、它们的卵或幼崽在多大程度上沦为其他掠食者猎物。此外，我们未能意识到，这种食物丰裕并非在一年四季中始终如一。
en: If exponential growth continues, an organism will quickly outgrow the limits of its habitat. Even the most fertile environments are finite. For every organism, there is a potential competitor. The competitor may be trying to eat you, or may compete for food or space. As he said, the face of nature often beams with joy, and food seems plentiful; yet we overlook the fact that the carefree birdsong around us comes from creatures that survive on insects or seeds, perpetually ending lives. We also disregard the extent to which these singers, their eggs or their young fall prey to other predators. Moreover, we fail to remember that this abundance of food is not consistent throughout the year’s cycles.

zh: 生命是一场永无止境斗争。动物与环境抗争。它们面临周期性干旱或霜冻威胁。它们与竞争物种争夺生态位。同一物种个体则在该生态位内相互竞争，以期让后代繁衍其中。
en: Life is a ceaseless struggle. Animals struggle against the environment. They are threatened by periodic drought or frost. They compete against rival species for their ecological niche. Individuals of a species compete within that niche to populate it with their offspring.

zh: 只要稍微减轻任何制约，哪怕只是微乎其微地缓解破坏，该物种数量几乎会瞬间激增到任意规模。大自然面貌可以比作一块柔韧表面，上面密密麻麻堆满了一万个锋利楔子，它们被无休止打击向内驱入，有时击中一个楔子，接着又以更大力气击中另一个。
en: Lighten any check, mitigate the destruction ever so little, and the number of the species will almost instantaneously increase to any amount. The face of Nature may be compared to a yielding surface, with ten thousand sharp wedges packed close together and driven inwards by incessant blows, sometimes one wedge being struck, and then another with greater force.

zh: 达尔文虽然没有使用“生态位”“栖息地”或“食物链”等现代生态学术语，但他的论点仍然基于类似概念。他描述了熊蜂为红三叶草授粉过程；熊蜂数量丰富，三叶草便生长茂盛。然而，田鼠以熊蜂地下蜂巢为食，随着田鼠数量增加，三叶草数量便随之减少。在村庄里，家猫捕食田鼠，从而使村庄花园里熊蜂数量丰富，三叶草生长茂盛。因此，在每一个生态系统中，错综复杂相互作用施加着持续压力，只有少数后代能够存活。在每个物种中，适应性最强后代得以存活并繁衍后代。
en: Darwin, while not using modern ecological terms like niche, habitat or food chain, still bases his arguments on similar concepts. He describes the pollination of red clover by bumblebees; an abundance of these bees leads to thriving clover. However, field mice prey on the bees’ underground hives, reducing the clover as their numbers increase. In villages, domestic cats hunt the mice, resulting in bountiful bumblebees and flourishing clover in village gardens. Thus, in every ecosystem, intricate interactions exert constant pressure, allowing only a few offspring to survive. In each species, the best adapted offspring survive to reproduce themselves.

zh: 既然对人类有益变异无疑已经发生，那么在漫长而复杂的生存斗争中，对每个生物都以某种方式有益的其他变异，在数千代演变过程中偶尔出现，难道就难以想象吗？如果确实发生了这样变异，我们岂能怀疑（须知出生个体远多于能够存活数量），那些比其他个体具有任何优势——无论多么微小——的个体，拥有最大生存机会并繁衍后代？
en: Can it, then, be thought improbable, seeing that variations useful to man have undoubtedly occurred, that other variations useful in some way to each being in the great and complex battle of life, should sometimes occur in the course of thousands of generations? If such do occur, can we doubt (remembering that many more individuals are born than can possibly survive) that individuals having any advantage, however slight, over others, would have the best chance of surviving and of procreating their kind?

zh: 自然选择不断作用于每个物种，以优化其适应性。随着时间推移，适应性不断提升，物种随之演变。旧物种逐渐灭绝，新的、适应性更强物种取而代之。
en: Natural select acts constantly to hone the fitness of every species. Over time, fitness improves and species change. Old species die out as new better-adapted ones replace them.

zh: 可以说，自然选择每天、每时每刻都在全世界范围内审视着每一个变异，哪怕是最微小变异；淘汰不良，保留并积累所有有益；只要机会出现，无论何时何地，它都在默默无闻、悄无声息地运作，致力于使每个有机体在其有机和无机生活条件下适应性得到提升。在这些缓慢变化进行过程中，我们一无所见，直到时间之手标记了漫长岁月流逝，而到那时，我们对久远地质时代的洞察仍如此不完善，以至于只能看到，如今生命形态与过去已不相同。
en: It may be said that natural selection is daily and hourly scrutinising, throughout the world, every variation, even the slightest; rejecting that which is bad, preserving and adding up all that is good; silently and insensibly working, whenever and wherever opportunity offers, at the improvement of each organic being in relation to its organic and inorganic conditions of life. We see nothing of these slow changes in progress, until the hand of time has marked the long lapse of ages, and then so imperfect is our view into long past geological ages, that we only see that the forms of life are now different from what they formerly were.

zh: 但我们究竟能从何种意义上谈论“方向”呢？过去那种把动物划分为“高等”和“低等”的说法，难道不是一种以人类为中心投射吗？
en: But in what sense can we speak of direction? Is the old language of higher and lower orders of animals not just an anthropocentric projection?

zh: 我们是否真的能在某种意义上说，今天周围野生动物比五千万年前那些更“先进”或更好？
en: Is there any real sense in which we can say that wild animals around today are more ‘advanced’ or better than those from fifty million years ago?

zh: 也许进化中看似存在方向，不过是我们基于对祖先谱系了解而产生错觉。马真的比始马“更好”吗？
en: Perhaps the apparent direction of evolution is just an illusion prompted by our knowledge of ancestral lines. Is the horse really ‘better’ than

zh: 难道始马（Eohippus）不正是完美适应了它所栖息的始新世森林世界吗？
en: Might it not be that Eohippus was perfect for the kind of forested Eocene world that it inhabited?

zh: 如果我们采纳这种观点，自然选择就不会赋予进化以长期方向。并不存在整体上进步，只有对气候变化或快或慢适应。
en: If we take that view, natural selection gives no long-term direction. There is no overall improvement, just more or less rapid adaptation to climate change.

zh: 达尔文坚信“改良”是真实存在。他认为在任何特定环境中，都存在逐步适应空间。他援引入侵物种如何压倒本土物种例子，作为存在改良空间证据。
en: Darwin was convinced that improvement is real. That in any given environment there is room for progressive adaptation. He cites the way that invasive species outcompete natives as proof of the room for improvement.

zh: 没有任何一个国家能被列举出来，其所有本土物种如今都已彼此之间以及与所处自然环境如此完美地适应，以至于其中任何一种都无法再得到任何改善；因为在所有国家，本土物种都已被归化物种所征服，以至于它们允许外来物种牢牢占据了这片土地。既然外来物种在各地都已击败了部分本土物种，我们便可确信地推断，本土物种本可通过改良获得优势，从而更好地抵御此类入侵者。
en: No country can be named in which all the native inhabitants are now so perfectly adapted to each other and to the physical conditions under which they live, that none of them could anyhow be improved; for in all countries, the natives have been so far conquered by naturalised productions, that they have allowed foreigners to take firm possession of the land. And as foreigners have thus everywhere beaten some of the natives, we may safely conclude that the natives might have been modified with advantage, so as to have better resisted such intruders.

zh: 古尔德
认为这一证据无可辩驳。他以南美洲有袋类物种为例，指出自然选择促进了马类生物和类似剑齿虎食肉动物趋同进化。然而，随着巴拿马地峡形成，这些物种被更具优势北美动物群所取代并灭绝。真正猫科动物确实优于其有袋类对应物。引入澳大利亚欧洲兔数量激增，已泛滥成灾。相反，被放养到欧洲的小袋鼠仅能在孤立小岛上生存。
en: Gould

argues that the evidence is incontestable. He refers to the marsupial species of South America, where natural selection has fostered the convergent evolution of horse-like creatures and carnivores akin to sabre-toothed cats. However, following the creation of the Panama isthmus, these species were outcompeted and eradicated by the more dominant North American fauna. The true felines were indeed superior to their marsupial counterparts. European rabbits introduced in Australia proliferated to pestilential levels. Conversely, wallabies released in Europe only survive on isolated, small islands.

zh: 因此，我们观察到改进、提升以及设计般表象，却没有目的论或设计者。达尔文生物学界定了几个层次：谱系、营养级和适应性。从纯粹达尔文主义角度来看，尽管存在改进，但不能把动物分为低等和高等。人们之所以不愿使用“高等”和“低等”等术语，是因为这些词可能暗示“高等”物种比“低等”物种更擅长生存。通常，人们认为海鸥优于海胆。尽管海鸥可能在海胆上方翱翔并以海胆为食，但它们并不争夺相同生态位。生物学家现在更倾向于把棘皮动物描述为比鸟类更“基底”的物种。“基底”指的是在祖先树上位置。总体而言，海胆和棘皮动物比鸟类更接近棘皮动物与脊椎动物共同祖先。海鸥在食物链中地位更高，在演化谱系上也更接近顶端，但它们对自身独特生活方式适应程度并不比海胆更好。
en: Thus, we observe improvement, enhancement and the semblance of design, yet without teleology or a designer. Darwinian biology delineates several hierarchies: lineage, trophic levels and adaptability. From a pure Darwinian standpoint, despite the presence of improvement, one cannot categorize animals into lower and higher orders. The hesitation to use terms like ‘higher’ and ‘lower’ stems from the potential insinuation that ‘higher’ species are more adept at survival than ‘lower’ ones. Commonly, seagulls are perceived as superior to sea urchins. Although gulls may soar over, feed on, sea urchins, they do not compete for the same ecological niche. Biologists now prefer to describe echinoderms as more basal than birds. Basal refers to a position on an ancestral tree. Sea urchins and echinoderms, in general, are closer to the common ancestor of echinoderms and vertebrates than birds are. Gulls are higher in the food chain and less basal in terms of descent, but they are no better adapted to their own peculiar mode of life than sea urchins.

zh: 针对达尔文的“目的论”指控在“有袋类障碍”上碰壁了。那么，斯密或恩格斯提出的“生产方式的等级体系”又该如何解释呢？
en: The accusation of teleology against Darwin falls on the marsupial hurdle. What about the hierarchy of modes of production advanced by Smith or Engels?

zh: 回顾一下，斯密的序列是从狩猎社会到牧业社会，再到农业文明。恩格斯的序列是：蒙昧、野蛮、奴隶社会、封建主义、资本主义和共产主义。他对前两个术语的使用与摩根相同。
蒙昧大致对应于狩猎社会。野蛮则对应于从事园圃种植或畜牧、但尚未实行犁耕农业的经济形态。
en: Recall that Smith’s sequence went from hunting society to pastoral society to agricultural civilization. Engels had the sequence: savagery, barbarism, slave society, feudalism, capitalism and communism. The first two terms he used in the same sense as Morgan.
Savagery maps roughly onto hunting society. Barbarism maps onto those economies that practice horticulture or herding but not plough agriculture.

zh: 恩格斯的框架把社会发展同时看作谱系上的承续和进步。资本主义被视为比封建主义更先进，野蛮状态则比蒙昧状态更先进。现代人的敏感意识往往排斥“野蛮人”或“蒙昧人”等词，因为其中带有欧洲中心主义或中国中心主义的偏见，甚至可能接近种族主义。然而，从马克思主义视角来看，从事园圃种植和畜牧的野蛮社会，相较于仅依赖狩猎的社会，其进步性不可否认。同样，资本主义也被视为比封建主义更先进。这基于古尔德指出的同一标准：竞争能力。历史上，处于野蛮阶段的民族与处于蒙昧阶段的民族接触时，常常取代后者，占据其原有领土的大片区域。来自西非和安纳托利亚、拥有家畜和农业的人群迫使更早的狩猎采集社会退却，就体现了这一点。
en: Engels’s framework views societal development as both ancestral and progressive. Capitalism is seen as more advanced than feudalism, and barbarism as more advanced than savagery. Modern sensitivity often rejects terms like ‘barbarian’ or ‘savage’ due to their Euro-centric or Sino-centric biases, which can border on racism. However, from a Marxist perspective, the advancement of a barbarian society engaged in horticulture and animal husbandry over a society solely reliant on hunting is undeniable. Similarly, capitalism is deemed more advanced than feudalism. This is based on the same criterion Gould identifies: the ability to compete. Historically, when barbarian nations came into contact with savage ones, they often displaced them, taking over large areas of their original territories. This was evident as populations from West Africa and Anatolia, equipped with domesticated animals and agriculture, pushed back the earlier hunter-gatherer societies.

zh: 工业资本主义同样席卷全球，征服了处于野蛮阶段的民族，并迫使处于封建阶段社会实现现代化。更先进社会秩序取代了较落后社会秩序，正如胎盘类猫科动物在南美洲取代了有袋类博尔海尼科动物一样。
en: Industrial capitalism likewise spread out across the world, subduing barbarian nations and forcing those at a feudal level to modernize. The more advanced social order displaced the less advanced just as the placental felids replaced the marsupial borhyaenids in South America.

zh: 让我们从目的论问题转向“何为人类”这一议题。达尔文主义通过确立人类与猿类共同祖先，动摇了唯心主义或宗教世界观。取代了“按上帝形象创造的理性人类”与“无理性的动物”之间那种绝对区分的，是“裸猿”这一人类概念。那些看似为人类独有的特征，往往只是早期动物特征演化结果。
en: Let’s go from the question of teleology to what it means to be human. Darwinism undermined the idealist or religious world view by establishing the common descent of humans and apes. In the place of a categorical distinction between rational humans made in the image of God and brute animals, there came the conception of humans as naked apes. What seems specially human is often just a development of earlier animal traits.

zh: 在考察任何人类特征时，达尔文出发点是把它置于我们哺乳动物祖先语境中审视。无论是讲述黑猩猩使用简单石器，还是埃塞俄比亚狒狒使用投掷武器，
他都不断强调，那些被认为是人类独有的特征，不过是共同遗产一部分。
en: When looking at any human trait, Darwin’s starting point is to treat it in the context of our mammalian ancestors. Whether he is recounting the use of simple stone tools by chimps or projectile weapons by baboons in Ethiopia,
he constantly emphasizes that supposedly unique human traits are just part of a common heritage.

zh: 人们常说，没有动物会使用任何工具；但在自然状态下，黑猩猩会用石头敲开一种类似核桃的当地水果。（37. Savage 和Wyman 在《波士顿自然史杂志》第IV 卷，1843—44 年，第383 页。）伦格（Rengger）（38.《巴拉圭哺乳动物》，1830 年，第51—56页。）轻松教会了一只美洲猴子用这种方法敲开坚硬棕榈果；此后，这只猴子便主动用石头打开其他种类坚果以及盒子。它还去除了味道难闻水果软皮。另一只猴子被教导用棍子撬开一个大箱子盖子，之后它便把棍子当作杠杆来移动重物；而我本人也曾亲眼目睹一只幼年猩猩把一根棍子插入缝隙中，把手伸到另一端，并恰当地把它作为杠杆使用。……布雷姆（40.《动物生活》，第一卷，第79、82 页）援引著名旅行家辛珀记载，在阿比西尼亚，当一种狒狒（C. gelada）成群结队从山上下来掠夺农田时，有时会遇到另一种狒狒（C. hamadryas）群体，随后便会爆发战斗。格拉达狒狒把巨石滚下山坡，哈马德里亚斯狒狒则试图躲避，随后两个物种在喧嚣声中狂暴地向对方冲去。布雷姆曾陪同科堡—哥达公爵，在阿比西尼亚门萨山口协助用火器袭击了一群狒狒。作为反击，狒狒们把大量巨石——其中有些甚至大如人的头颅——滚下山去，迫使攻击者仓皇撤退；该山口甚至一度对商队关闭。值得注意的是，这些狒狒当时表现出了高度协同行动。
en: It has often been said that no animal uses any tool; but the chimpanzee in a state of nature cracks a native fruit, somewhat like a walnut, with a stone. (37. Savage and Wyman in ‘Boston Journal of Natural History’, vol. iv. 1843-44, p. 383.) Rengger (38. ‘Saugethiere von Paraguay’, 1830, s. 51-56.) easily taught an American monkey thus to break open hard palm-nuts; and afterwards of its own accord, it used stones to open other kinds of nuts, as well as boxes. It thus also removed the soft rind of fruit that had a disagreeable flavour. Another monkey was taught to open the lid of a large box with a stick, and afterwards it used the stick as a lever to move heavy bodies; and I have myself seen a young orang put a stick into a crevice, slip his hand to the other end, and use it in the proper manner as a lever. . . . Brehm (40. ‘Thierleben’, B. i. s. 79, 82.) states, on the authority of the well-known traveller Schimper, that in Abyssinia when the baboons belonging to one species (C. gelada) descend in troops from the mountains to plunder the fields, they sometimes encounter troops of another species (C. hamadryas), and then a fight ensues. The Geladas roll down great stones, which the Hamadryas try to avoid, and then both species, making a great uproar, rush furiously against each other. Brehm, when accompanying the Duke of Coburg-Gotha, aided in an attack with fire-arms on a troop of baboons in the pass of Mensa in Abyssinia. The baboons in return rolled so many stones down the mountain, some as large as a man’s head, that the attackers had to beat a hasty retreat; and the pass was actually closed for a time against the caravan. It deserves notice that these baboons thus acted in concert.

zh: 在探讨动物心理学时，他同样把人类情感全部谱系——羞耻、愤怒、勇气和亲情——归因于动物。
en: When discussing the psychology of animals, he likewise attributes to them the full gamut of human emotions:, shame, anger, courage and affection.

zh: 我认为，毫无疑问，狗会感到羞耻——这与恐惧不同——而且当它们过于频繁乞食时，还会表现出一种非常类似于羞怯情绪。一只大狗会轻蔑地忽视小狗咆哮，这可以称为胸襟宽广。
en: There can, I think, be no doubt that a dog feels shame, as distinct from fear, and something very like modesty when begging too often for food. A great dog scorns the snarling of a little dog, and this may be called magnanimity.

zh: 针对这属于拟人化的偏见，他提出相反的原则：只要我们拥有情感生活，我们之所以能够感受这些情绪，就只能是因为我们共有的哺乳动物遗产。情绪本身被视为身体的状态和姿态。他认为，情绪表达受对立原则支配：对立的情绪调动相反的肌肉群。
en: Against the prejudice that this is anthropomorphism, he counterposes the opposite principle. Insofar as we have an emotional life, we can only feel these emotions because of our common mammalian heritage. Emotions themselves are treated as states and postures of the body. Their expression, he claims, is govererned by the principle of opposition. Opposing emotions bring into play opposing sets of muscles.

zh: 他以猫或狗行为为例加以说明。当猫感到攻击性时，它会采取蹲伏姿势，背部放平，耳朵向内收拢，尾巴猛烈摆动。这些姿势具有生存优势：低矮姿态略微改变了扑击前姿势，既不引人注意，又让后腿随时准备跃起；贴平耳朵能防止被咬，而甩动尾巴和嘶嘶声则起到威慑作用。相反，友善猫会挺直身子，四肢伸展，背部拱起，尾巴竖起。情绪与神经肌肉活动有着内在联系；如果没有相应身体表现，情绪就无法显现。达尔文先是利用动物行为来阐释这一概念，随后证明其对人类情绪和表情适用性，从而提出了一种根本上的唯物主义观点。
en: He illustrates this with the behaviour of cats or dogs. When a cat feels aggressive, it assumes a crouching position, flattens its back, tucks its ears and lashes its tail. These postures offer a survival benefit. The low stance slightly alters the pre-pounce posture, staying inconspicuous with hind legs ready to spring. Flattened ears prevent bites, while a thrashing tail and hissing serve as deterrents. Conversely, a friendly cat stands tall, with extended legs, an arched back and a raised tail. Emotions are intrinsically linked to neuromuscular actions; without corresponding physical expressions, emotions do not manifest. Darwin used animal behaviours to illustrate this concept before demonstrating its applicability to human emotions and expressions, presenting a fundamentally materialistic viewpoint.

zh: 这一观点得到了介于盖伦与赫布
之间的一种神经系统观念支持。达尔文写道，神经力量沿着神经并穿过神经传递。这与盖伦的“精神之气”（psychic pneuma）仅有一步之遥。
en: It is backed up by a conception of the nervous system that sits halfway between Galen and Hebb.
Darwin writes of
being transmitted along and through the nerves. This is only one step removed from Galen’s

zh: 但这一观点结合了对反射认识，以及“习惯性动作会强化神经系统各部分之间相互连接”这一概念。
en: But it is combined with an awareness of reflexes and the concept that habitual action reinforces interconnection between parts of the nervous system.

zh: 经验表明，每当脑脊髓系统受到刺激时，神经力就会产生并释放出来。这种神经力所遵循方向必然由神经细胞之间以及神经细胞与身体各部位之间连接线路所决定。但该方向同样在很大程度上受到习惯影响；因为神经力会顺着习惯通道轻松地传递。
en: Experience shows that nerve-force is generated and set free whenever the cerebro-spinal system is excited. The direction which this nerve-force follows is necessarily determined by the lines of connection between the nerve-cells, with each other and with various parts of the body. But the direction is likewise much influenced by habit; inasmuch as nerve-force passes readily along accustomed channels.

zh: 达尔文对遗传和神经活动有着正确直觉，尽管他并不了解其背后实际机制：DNA 和突触。达尔文使用“力”这一非常物理化术语来描述神经系统。但在盖伦所处的时代，他的“气”（pneuma）本身就是一种关于神经系统的物理理论。随着时间推移，盖伦这一唯物主义理论逐渐演变为与其截然相反观点——当它被翻译成拉丁语spiritus 并由神职人员宣扬时，便成为了一种神秘主义概念。在达尔文与赫布之间时期，我们也能看到同样潜在歧义。卡哈尔和巴甫洛夫探索了机械唯物主义道路，阐明了基本机制，从而使赫布能够断言：
en: Darwin had the right basic intuitions on heredity and nervous action, though he did not know the actual mechanisms by which it came about: DNA and the synapse. Darwin uses a language of ‘force’, which is very physical, to describe the nervous system. But in its own day, Galen’s
was a physical theory of the nervous system. In time, this materialist theory of Galen became its opposite, so that translated into the Latin

and intoned by priests, it became something mystical. We can see the same potential ambiguity in the period between Darwin and Hebb. Cajal and Pavlov explored the mechanical materialist path, elucidating basic mechanisms leading to the point where Hebb could declare:

zh: 现代心理学完全理所当然地认为，行为与神经功能是完美相关的，一方完全由另一方所决定。并不存在独立灵魂或生命力，时不时地向大脑“插一脚”，迫使神经细胞做它们原本不会做事情。实际上，当然，这仅在行为中存在未解之谜时才是一种工作假设。……我们迄今未能解决一个问题，并不意味着它无法解决。从逻辑上讲，一个人不可能在物理、化学和生物学领域是决定论者，而在心理学领域却成为神秘主义者。
en: Modern psychology takes completely for granted that behaviour and neural function are perfectly correlated, that one is completely caused by the other. There is no separate soul or life-force to stick a finger into the brain now and then and make neural cells do what they would not otherwise Actually, of course, this is a working assumption only as long as there are unexplained aspects of behaviour. . . . Our failure to solve a problem so far does not make it insoluble One cannot logically be a determinist in physics and chemistry and biology and a mystic in psychology.

zh: 在此，赫布隐含地批评了心理学中从弗洛伊德到荣格的发展轨迹——这一轨迹起初源于年轻弗洛伊德对神经系统实际研究，后来却分岔走向了一条神秘主义神经能量学之路。
由于当时弗洛伊德在美国仍极具影响力，赫布在批评时不得不保持委婉，但其核心观点依然清晰明确。
en: In this, Hebb was implicitly criticizing the Freud-to-Jung trajectory in psychology that starting out from actual research into the nervous system by the young Freud, later branched out along a path of mystical neuro-energetics.
Working in a US context in which Freud was still highly influential, Hebb had to be tactful in his criticism, but the thrust is no less clear.

zh: “自我”“本我”和“超我”是帮助人们洞察并阐明行为重要事实的概念，但人们也极易把它们视为虚幻实体——仿佛是那些想要这样、反对那样，凭力量或诡计彼此压倒，并施加惩罚或遭受惩罚的人格化主体。弗洛伊德留给我们任务，是把这些暂时理论表述进一步发展，直至这种危险不复存在。当理论变得僵化时，就容易沦为教条；而且，只要它仍有这么多问题尚未解决，心理理论还面临着另一重危险，即可能导致人们重新陷入传统思想中的活力论和非决定论。
en: Ego, Id, and Superego are conceptions that help one to see and state important facts of behavior, but they are also dangerously easy to treat as ghostly realities, as anthropomorphic agents that want this or disapprove of that, overcoming one another by force or guile, and punishing or being punished. Freud has left us the task of developing these provisional formulations of his to the point where such a danger no longer exists. When theory becomes static it is apt to become dogma; and psychological theory has the further danger, as long as so many of its problems are unresolved, of inviting a relapse into the vitalism and indeterminism of traditional thought.

zh: 遗憾的是，这种对弗洛伊德式非决定论和活力论的倒退，到20 世纪60 年代已对法国马克思主义理论家产生了如此深远影响，以至于廷帕纳罗甚至指出，这已成为他们主要特征。
en: Unfortunately, this lapse into Freudian indeterminism and vitalism had, by the 1960s, so influenced French Marxist theorists that Timpanaro
could remark that it was their main distinguishing feature.

zh: 新的原子论
化学家们每天发现的那些令人惊叹事实，正是对原子论的一项项新证明。

children: The remarkable facts that chemists daily discover are as many new proofs of atomism.

zh: 牛顿是卢克莱修追随者，也就是一位原子论者。他对声波传播解释明确基于“物体由原子构成”这一思想。由此，他能够正确预测声音应存在衍射现象，
这堪称原子假说力量早期杰出证明。但原子论之所以得以具体化，是通过化学而非我们如今所称物理学实现的。
en: Newton was a follower of Lucretius, that is, an atomist. His account of the propagation of sound waves is explicitly based on the idea that bodies are made of atoms. From this, he was able to correctly predict that diffraction of sound should exist,
a remarkable early demonstration of the power of the atomic hypothesis. But it was through chemistry rather than what we would now call physics that atomism became concrete.

zh: 道尔顿
虽然“原子”一词在18 世纪期间仍在使用，但主要出现在对伊壁鸠鲁学派的历史叙述中
，或作为通俗散文中文学隐喻——其前提是受过教育人都读过卢克莱修作品。直到道尔顿开展研究后，化学家才开始严肃使用这一术语。
en: While the term ‘atom’ continued to be used during the eighteenth century, it was mentioned mainly in the context of historical accounts of the Epicureans
or as a literary metaphor in popular prose, the assumption being that educated people had read Lucretius. It was not used seriously by chemists until the work of Dalton.

zh: 他在研究不同气体在水中可溶解量的实验过程中，
逐步形成了关于原子思想。由此，他提出了溶液中气体分压概念，这一概念至今仍在当代化学中沿用。他关于分压理论模型是：当一种气体（例如氧气）溶解于水时，氧气原子会与水“原子”交错排列，形成规则网格。
en: He developed his thoughts on atoms in the context of experiments he did on the quantities of different gases that could be dissolved in water.

From this, he developed the idea of partial pressures of gases in solution, a notion that continues to be used in contemporary chemistry. The theoretical model he had for partial pressure was that when a gas, let us say oxygen dissolves in water, then the oxygen atoms are interspersed with water ‘atoms’ in a regular grid.

zh: 道尔顿发现了溶液中分压概念，这使他得以估算大气中主要气体比例并提出“道尔顿定律”。他还利用分压原理并测量气体密度，提出了原子量概念。他是第一个明确区分所谓“原子的机械混合物”（例如溶解在水中氧气）与化学化合物的人。
en: Dalton discovered the notion of partial pressure in a solution, which led him to estimate the proportions of the principal gases in the atmosphere and formulate ‘Dalton’s Law’. He also introduced the concept of atomic weights by utilizing the idea of partial pressure and measuring the densities of gases. He was the first to clearly distinguish what he termed mechanical mixtures of atoms, for example, oxygen dissolved in water, from chemical compositions.

zh: 本书的一个主要目标，便是阐明确定简单物质和化合物中基本粒子的相对重量、构成一个化合物粒子的简单基本粒子数量，以及形成一个更复杂化合物粒子所需较简单的复合粒子数量的重要性与优势。
en: Now it is one great object of this work, to shew the importance and advantage of ascertaining the relative weights of the ultimate particles, both of simple and compound bodies, the nuimber of simple elementary particles which constitute one compound particle, and the number of less compound particles which enter into the formation of one more compound particle

zh: 他在分子量相对顺序上判断正确。他对氮和氧分子量估算误差至少为两倍；对于化合物气体而言，其误差则小得多。氮分子和氧分子误差较大原因，很可能是他假设这些气体为单原子气体。
en: He got the relative order of molecular weights right. His estimates of the molecular weights of nitrogen and oxygen are out by a factor of at leas two; for compound gases, his errors are much smaller. The larger errors for Nitrogen and Oxygen molecules are probably due to his assumption that these gases were monatomic.

zh: 在把这一理论应用于求解弹性流体比热之前，我们必须首先确定其基本粒子的相对重量。暂且假设（这一点将在后文证明）：如果一个氢原子质量为1，则氧为7，氮为5，亚硝酸气体为12，一氧化二氮为17，碳酸为19，氨气为6，碳化氢为7，烯烃气体为6，硝酸为19，一氧化碳为12。
en: Before we can apply this doctrine to find the specific heat of elastic fluids, we must first ascertain the relative weights of their ultimate particles. Assuming at present what will be proved hereafter, that if the weight of an atom of hydrogen be 1, that of oxygen will be 7, azote 5, nitrous gas 12, nitrous oxide 17, carbonic acid 19, ammoniacal gas 6, carburetted hydrogen 7, olefiant gas 6, nitric acid 19, carbonic oxide 12,

zh: 他得出估算值汇总于表5.1 中，该表将其与现代数值进行对比，并把他所命名化合物名称转换为现代化学式。
en: The estimates that he arrived at are summarized in Table 5.1, which compares them with the modern values, and translates his names for compounds into modern chemical formulae.

zh: 在
中，他详细阐述了原子存在多种级别假说。基本原子即元素——当时他已能识别出二十种。这些元素可以成对结合形成他所称的二元原子，成三结合形成三元原子，以此类推。这些更高层次原子组合与我们现在所知分子非常接近。如图5.2 所示，现在已知他的一些化学式是错误的。例如，他认为水由一个氢原子和一个氧原子组成，这也是基于氢气是单原子这一假设得出又一结论。
en: In

he elaborated the hypothesis that atoms came in several orders. The primary atoms were the elements – of which he was already able to identify twenty. Pairs of these could be bound together to form what he called binary atoms, triples to form ternary atoms etc. These higher orders correspond pretty closely to what we now know as molecules. As Figure 5.2 shows, some of his formulae are now known to be wrong. For instance, he believed water was made of one hydrogen and one oxygen atom, another consequence of the assumption that hydrogen gas was monatomic.

zh: 他关于水“原子”构想在某些方面竟出人意料地具有现代性。如今我们认为原子由中子和质子组成原子核以及围绕其周围电子云构成。而他则认为，二元、三元等原子具有由基本粒子组成的核心，周围环绕着他所称的“热气层”。
en: The idea he had for a water ‘atom’ was in some ways strikingly modern. We now think of atoms as being made of a nucleus of neutrons and protons surrounded by a cloud of electrons. He thought that binary and ternary, etc., atoms had a nucleus of elementary particles surrounded by what he called an atmosphere of heat.

zh: 从道尔顿1808 年模型到20 世纪中叶模型，转变主要体现在两点：
en: The shift from Dalton’s model of 1808 to the mid-twentieth-century model came down to two points:

zh: 1. 道尔顿把化学元素视为基本粒子。20 世纪中叶理论则把质子和中子视为“基本”粒子。20 世纪末理论甚至把这些粒子进一步分解为夸克和胶子。
en: 1. Dalton took the chemical elements to be elementary particles. Mid-twentieth-century theory took protons and neutrons to be the ‘elementary’ particles. Late twentieth-century theory decomposed even these into quarks and gluons.

zh: 2. 道尔顿把气体的弹性归因于围绕由化学元素构成原子核的热质或热的气层。当气体受热时，热质被添加到原子中，原子因此变大，从而使气体膨胀。这与现代基础教科书中描述的围绕原子核电子云有明显相似之处。我们认为，至少固体的弹性是由电子云之间静电排斥力造成。甚至在玻尔原子模型中，我们也曾有这样一个概念：当向原子输入能量时，其电子会跃迁至更高能级，从而导致原子膨胀，这与道尔顿关于“随着热量增加，热质气层会膨胀”的观点相去不远。

We accept that it is the electrostatic repulsion of the electron clouds that is responsible for at least the elasticity of solids. We even had the concept in the Bohr model of the atom that when you added energy to an atom, its electrons moved to higher levels with a consequent expansion, which is not far from Dalton’s concept that the
