zh: 唯物主义的认知过程总是如此：当人们发现某种被视为原子或不可分割粒子（用卢克莱修的话说就是“原质”）时，却又发现它们是由更基本粒子组成。目前通用标准模型包含一组基本粒子：夸克、胶子、轻子和中微子。这些粒子之下是否还存在更细微层次，仍有待观察。
en: There is a repeated process by which materialist understanding discovers what it takes to be atomic or indivisible particles,

in Lucretius terms, only to find that they are composed of even more basic ones. The Standard Model in use now has a set of elementary particles: quarks, gluons, leptons and neutrinos. It remains to be seen whether a further level of detail will be detected below these.

zh: 热、物质与时间

道尔顿思想，就像化合物一样，建立在他人奠基性工作之上。托里切利1643 年发现并测定大气压，为理解分压奠定基础。随后几年，化学家们鉴定出新元素气体：1766 年氢气、1772 年氮气和1777 年氧气，这些发现对于理解构成大气层各种分压至关重要。然而，道尔顿研究仍以热是一种称为“热质”（caloric）的独立实体这一观念为基础。这一概念基于布莱克和瓦特开创性工作，他们量化了热量、比热和潜热，从而为蒸汽动力工业资本主义时代奠定基础。
en: Dalton’s ideas, much like compounds, are built on the foundational work of others. Torricelli’s discovery and measurement of atmospheric pressure in 1643 laid the groundwork for understanding partial pressures. In the years that followed, chemists identified new elemental gases: hydrogen in 1766, nitrogen in 1772 and oxygen in 1777, which were crucial for conceptualizing the various partial pressures that constitute the atmosphere. However, Dalton’s work still operated under the notion of heat as a separate entity, known as ‘caloric’. This concept was based on the pioneering work of Black and Watt, who quantified heat, specific heat and latent heat, thereby setting the stage for the era of steam-powered industrial capitalism.

zh: 我们此前已论述过，这一社会新技术基础如何为理解经济提供关键概念工具。
但出于提高工程效率的需要，它同时也为热力学研究奠定基础，并推动了原子论发展下一阶段：把热理解为运动。
en: We have already commented on how this new technical basis for society prepared key conceptual tools for the understanding of the economy.
But through the necessities of engineering efficiency, it also prepared the study of thermodynamics and motivated the next stage in the development of atomism: the understanding of heat as motion.

zh: 如果蒸汽机没有被发明出来，我们无疑会停留在低于当前理论水平位置。热所取得的成就通过蒸汽机，以更加强烈语气向思考者们提出了这个问题：这种能够让我们取代风力、水力、马力和人力的一种媒介究竟是什么？
en: If the steam-engine had not been invented, we should assuredly stand below the theoretic level which we now occupy. The achievements of Heat, through the steam-engine, have forced, with augmented emphasis, the question upon thinking minds: What is this agent, by means of which we can supersede the force of winds, of rivers, of horses and men ?

zh: 在18 世纪末至19 世纪初，关于热的哲学存在两大流派。一方面，有被称为唯物主义者的人，如道尔顿和许多其他化学家，他们认为热是物质的一种独特形式。另一方面，则有被称为“机械论者”的学派，他们认为热是原子的机械运动。最终占上风机械论思想，其渊源至少可追溯至培根，他认为热仅在热体的较小粒子中发生膨胀。这种膨胀被其他粒子所阻碍、排斥并击退，从而产生一种来回运动，导致了热与火的狂暴。
en: In the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries there were two schools of philosophy on heat. On the one hand, there were those who were styled
, like Dalton and many other chemists, who thought that heat was a distinct form of matter. On the other hand, there were what were termed

for whom heat was the mechanical motion of atoms. The mechanistic ideas, which eventually triumphed, went back at least as far as Bacon,who believed that heat expanded only in the smaller particles of a hot body. This expansion was checked, repelled and beaten back by other particles, creating a back-and-forth motion that caused the fury of heat and fire.

zh: 但“热是机械运动”这一观点，不得不面对一种起初看似同样合理的唯物主义观点。
en: But the idea that heat was mechanical motion had to contend with what initially seemed an equally plausible materialist view.

zh: 热量会流动。这与液体行为极为相似。如果把一块湿布与一块干布接触，湿气就会向干布扩散；如果把一块热金属与一块冷金属接触，热量也会以类似方式扩散。
en: Heat flows. This seemed very like the behaviour of a liquid. If you bring a wet cloth into contact with a dry one, the dampness spreads into the dry cloth. If you bring a hot piece of metal in contact with a cold one, the heat spreads into a similar way.

zh: 当气体被压缩时，它会升温。这被解释为热量被挤出了原子之间空隙。
en: When a gas is compressed, it heats up. This was interpreted as the heat being squeezed out of the gaps between the atoms.

zh: 摩擦被解释为释放了此前被物体过于紧密地封存的热量。如果观察到火石和钢片摩擦产生火花，这种解释似乎合乎情理。敲击似乎把火花从钢片中释放出来，这暗示着热量原本潜藏在其中。
en: Friction was interpreted as releasing heat that had hitherto been too tightly contained in objects. If one observed a spark being struck from a flint and steel, this seemed a plausible account. The blow appeared to release the spark from the steel, implying that the heat was latent within it.

zh: 温度计使科学家能够研究比热，即使不同物质温度升高相同度数所需热量。水每升高一度所能吸收热量是汞的三十倍。化合物“热容量”被认为反映了原子之间可供热量进入空间大小。
en: Thermometers allowed scientists to study specific heat, which refers to the amount of heat needed to raise the temperature of different substances by the same number of degrees. Water can absorb thirty times more heat than mercury for each degree of increase in temperature. The ‘heat capacity’ of a compound was taken to indicate how much space there was between the atoms for heat to enter.

zh: 据廷德尔所述，一项关键观察结果推翻了唯物主义解释。那就是伦福德伯爵在镗削炮管时的经历。伦福德观察到，炮管在镗孔时会变得非常烫。
en: According to Tyndall, a crucial observation discredited the materialist account. It was Count Rumford’s experience with cannon boring. Rumford observed that cannons got very hot when being bored.

zh: 最近，我在慕尼黑军械库车间里负责监督大炮镗孔工作，我惊讶地发现，黄铜炮在镗孔过程中短时间内就会产生相当大热量；而镗刀从炮身上分离出来的金属屑所产生热量则更为强烈（通过实验我发现，其温度远高于沸水）。
en: Being engaged, lately, in superintending the boring of cannon, in the workshops of the military arsenal at Munich, I was struck with the very considerable degree of heat which a brass gun acquires, in a short time, in being bored; and with the still more intense heat (much greater than that of boiling water, as I found by experiment,) of the metallic chips separated from it by the borer.

zh: 我越是深思这些现象，就越觉得它们奇妙而引人入胜。对它们进行彻底研究，似乎甚至有望让我们更深入地洞察热的隐秘本质；并使我们能够就一种火热流体存在与否提出一些合理推测：关于这一课题，各个时代哲学家们一直意见分歧。
en: The more I meditated on these phenomena, the more they appeared to me to be curious and interesting. A thorough investigation of them seemed even to bid fair to give a farther insight into the hidden nature of heat; and to enable us to form some reasonable conjectures respecting the existence, or non-existence, of an igneous fluid,: a subject on which the opinions of philosophers have, in all ages, been much divided.

zh: 正如我们所言，关于摩擦标准解释是：它释放了被摩擦物体中潜藏热量。唯物主义者秉持“无中不能生有”原则。热量总和保持恒定。如果燧石与钢片摩擦产生火花时释放了热量，那么这热量在燧石撞击钢片之前就必须已经隐藏在钢片之中。同理，被镗削的大炮所产生热量，在被镗床磨成粉末之前，就必须已经潜藏在青铜之中。伦福德对此并不信服，于是进行了实验。
en: As we have said, the standard account of friction was that it released heat latent in the subject being rubbed. The materialists held a ‘nothing from nothing’ principle. The total amount of heat remained constant. If heat was released in a flint on steel spark, then it must have been hidden in the steel before the flint struck it. Analogously, the heat of a bored cannon must have been latent in the bronze before it was ground to dust by the boring machine. Rumford was not convinced and experimented.

zh: 上述机械操作中实际产生热量究竟从何而来？
en: From whence comes the heat actually produced in the mechanical operation above mentioned ?

zh: 难道是镗刀从金属块中分离出来金属碎屑所提供吗？
en: Is it furnished by the metallic chips which are separated by the borer from the solid mass of metal ?

zh: 如果是这样，那么根据现代关于潜热和热质理论，这些被削成碎屑金属部分热容量不仅应该发生变化，而且这种变化还应足够大，足以解释所产生所有热量。
en: If this were the case, then, according to the modern doctrines of latent heat, and of caloric, the capacity for heat of the parts of the metal, so reduced to chips, ought not only to be changed, but the change undergone by them should be sufficiently great to account for all the heat produced.

zh: 但实际上并未发生此类变化；因为我发现，当取等量（按重量计）这些金属屑，以及用细锯从同一金属块上切下薄片，并把它们在相同温度（即沸水温度）下放入等量冷水中（即
）时，从观察结果来看，放入金属屑那部分水，其温度既没有比放入金属薄片另一部分水低，也没有比后者高。
en: But no such change had taken place; for I found, upon taking equal quantities, by weight, of these chips, and of thin slips of the same block of metal separated by means of a fine saw, and putting them, at the same temperature, (that of boiling water,) into equal quantities of cold water, (that is to say, at the temperature of 59° F . ) the portion of water into which the chips were put was not, to all appearance, heated either less or more than the other portion, in which the slips of metal were put.

zh: 他得以驳斥了“摩擦热是黄铜中释放出的某种物质”这一假说。其他实验证明，加热或冷却过程中并未伴随质量变化。相反，热量必定来自那匹不幸被套在驱动镗床的马所做的功。他认为马的力量可以产生热量，甚至可以用于烹饪，但产生热量绝不会超过把马的饲料作为燃料所能获得热量。
en: He was able to reject the hypothesis that the heat of friction was some substance released from the brass. Other experiments proved that there was no weight change associated with heating or cooling. Instead, the heat must have come from the work put into the borer by the unfortunate yoked horse driving it. He held that heat could be produced by a horse’s strength and indeed used for cooking, but never more heat than could be obtained by using the horse’s food as fuel.

zh: 在探讨这一课题时，我们绝不能忽视一个最引人注目现象：即这些实验中摩擦产生热源显然是取之不尽的。毋庸赘言，任何隔离的物体或物体系统能够无限持续提供的东西，绝不可能是某种物质；在我看来，若非“运动”（MOTION），要对那些实验中能够被激发并传递任何事物形成清晰认识，似乎极其困难，甚至完全不可能。
en: In reasoning on this subject we must not forget that
, that the source of the heat generated by friction in these experiments appeared evidently to be
It is hardly necessary to add, that anything which any
body or system of bodies can continue to furnish
cannot possibly be a
; and it appears to me to be extremely difficult, if not quite impossible, to form any distinct idea of anything capable of being excited and communicated m those experiments, except it be MOTION.

zh: 这里明显呼应了马克思关于劳动力和工资购买的生活资料作为生产性劳动必要能量来源论述。在第［5］章中，我们曾提及马克思剥削理论依赖于功与能量物理等价相关概念。上文我们已引用廷德尔关于这些主题讲座内容。事实证明，马克思实际上曾旁听过这些讲座，廷德尔在其中总结了伦福德研究成果。
en: There are obvious echoes here of Marx discussing labour power and wage goods as the necessary source of energy for productive labour. In Chapter [5], we referred to the dependence of Marx’s theory of exploitation on concepts relating to the physical equivalence of work and energy. We have cited above from Tyndall’s lectures on these topics. It turns out that Marx actually attended these lectures in which Tyndall summarized the work of Rumford.

zh: 马克思和恩格斯对许多参与热力学（包括第一定律和第二定律）发展科学家著作有所了解，在某些情况下还进行了深入研究——其中包括赫尔曼·冯·亥姆霍兹、朱利叶斯·罗伯特·迈尔、詹姆斯·普雷斯科特·焦耳、尤斯图斯·冯·李比希、让·巴蒂斯特·约瑟夫·傅里叶、萨迪·卡诺、鲁道夫·克劳修斯、威廉·汤姆森、彼得·格思里·泰特、威廉·格罗夫、詹姆斯·克拉克·麦克斯韦以及路德维希·爱德华·玻尔兹曼。此外，我们知道，在1867年《资本论》第一卷出版前后，马克思曾多次参加自然科学公开讲座，其中包括英国物理学家约翰·廷德尔（其著作《热作为运动的一种形式》）所做一系列讲座。廷德尔本身就是当时物理学发展进程中重要人物，他是J.R. 迈尔思想主要倡导者——迈尔是能量守恒定律（热力学第一定律）共同发现者之一。马克思关注了廷德尔关于太阳光研究，特别是其与热相关部分。
en: Marx and Engels had some familiarity with and in some cases had closely studied the works of many of the scientists involved in the development of thermodynamics (both the first and second laws) – including Hermann von Helmholtz, Julius Robert Mayer, James Prescott Joule, Justus von Liebig, Jean-Baptiste Joseph Fourier, Sadi Carnot, Rudolf Clausius, William Thomson, Peter Guthrie Tait, William Grove, James Clark Maxwell, and Ludwig Eduard Boltzmann. In addition, we knew that Marx had attended numerous public lectures on natural science in the years leading up to and following the publication of Capital, Volume I in 1867, and that among these was a series of lectures by the English physicist John Tyndall, author of Heat Considered as a Mode of Motion. Tyndall, a major figure in the developing physics in his own right, was the principal advocate of the ideas of J.R. Mayer – one of the co-discoverers of the conservation of energy (the first law of thermodynamics). Marx followed Tyndall’s research on the Sun’s rays, particularly as it related to heat.

zh: 廷德尔讲座使他了解到，热是原子或分子运动结果；冰的膨胀、熔化和汽化，是由于分子运动克服了内聚力所致；他还能够估算大气中气体分子实际速度。
从《自然辩证法》笔记和片段中可以明显看出，恩格斯对当时科学领域这些主题非常熟悉。
en: Tyndall’s lectures taught him that heat is a result of atomic or molecular motion, and that the expansion, melting and vaporization of ice occur due to molecules’ motion overcoming cohesion forces, and he could estimate the actual velocities of gas molecules in the atmosphere.
Engel’s familiarity with these topics of the science of his time is obvious from the notes and fragments for

zh: 但现在我们要转向两个问题，这些问题似乎超出了马克思和恩格斯对其所处时代力学的认知范围，这些问题是麦克斯韦和玻尔兹曼能够提出但尚未给出充分答案的。
en: But we now move to two questions that pass beyond the boundary of what Marx and Engels seem to have known about the mechanics of their day, questions that Maxwell and Boltzmann could pose but not yet give an adequate answer to.

zh: 1. 为什么时间似乎具有方向性？
2. 知识或信息与功之间有何关系？
en: 1. Why does time appear to have a direction?
2. How does knowledge or information relate to work?

zh: 从历史上看，这两个问题曾以相反顺序被提出，但我们将先讨论“时间之箭”。这与第5.1 节和第5.4 节中已提出问题是相关的，因为恩格斯和达尔文不仅都隐含接受了时间具有方向性这一观点，还分别针对这种方向性提出了不同假说。
en: Historically, the questions were posed in the opposite order, but we will deal with times arrow first. It relates to issues already raised in Sections 5.1 and 5.4 since both Engels and Darwin implicitly accept not only that time is directional, but also provide distinct hypotheses for that directionality.

zh: 自古以来，过去与未来之间差异以及时间“流逝”便显而易见。出生、成长、死亡和衰败都是显而易见。人们从经验中知道，春天雪会融化，热锅会冷却等等。这种时间方向性并不值得大惊小怪。时间流逝或许令人惋惜，但似乎是不言而喻。就连牛顿这样严谨哲学家，也把时间流逝视为公理性假设，这一点我们此前已加以批判。
拉格朗日力学和哈密顿力学发展——这两者侧重于受守恒定律约束完整轨迹——突显了把时间视为流动观点之不足，并揭示出力学基本定律在时间轴上具有对称性。
en: The difference between the past and the future, and the ‘flow’ of time has been obvious since antiquity. Birth, growth, death and decay were obvious. People knew from experience that snow melts in the spring, that hot pans cool down, etc. This direction of time was unremarkable. Time’s flow and passage might be regretted but seemed self-evident. Even a careful philosopher like Newton took time-flow as an axiomatic assumption, which we criticized earlier.

The development of Lagrangian and Hamiltonian mechanics, which focus on complete trajectories constrained by conservation laws, emphasized the inadequacy of viewing time as a flow, revealing that the basic laws of mechanics were symmetrical with respect to the time axis.

zh: 在抽象动力学中，若把系统中每个运动粒子的运动瞬间逆转，则该系统将向后运动，其中每个粒子都将沿其原路径运动——当再次处于同一位置时，速度与先前相同——也就是说，用数学术语表述，当
变为
时，任何解仍然是解。
en: IN abstract dynamics an instantaneous reversal of the motion of every moving particle of a system causes the system to move backwards, each particle of it along its old path,-and at the same speed as before when again in the same position – that is to say, in mathematical language, any solution remains a solution when
is changed into −

zh: 因此，如果宇宙中每一个物质粒子的运动在任何瞬间都被精确逆转，自然进程从那时起将永远被彻底逆转。瀑布脚下爆裂泡沫气泡会重新聚合并落回水中；热运动会重新凝聚其能量，把水流以水滴形式抛向瀑布上方，重新形成一股紧密上升水柱。原本由固体摩擦产生、并通过传导、辐射及吸收而消散热量，将重新回到接触点，并使运动物体逆着它先前屈服那股力量反弹回去。巨石将从泥浆中回收重建其原有崎岖形态所需材料，并重新与它们曾经脱落山峰合为一体。
en: If, then, the motion of every particle of matter in the universe were precisely reversed at any instant, the course of nature would be simply reversed for ever after. The bursting bubble of foam at the foot of a waterfall would reunite and descend into the water : the thermal motions would re-concentrate their energy and throw the mass up the fall in drops reforming into a close column of ascending water. Heat which had been generated by the friction of solids and dissipated by conduction, and radiation with absorption, would come again to the place .of contact and throw the moving body back against the force to which it had previously yielded. Boulders would recover from the mud the materials required to rebuild them into their previous jagged forms, and would become reunited to the mountain peak from which they had formerly broken away.

zh: 追踪两颗相撞台球轨迹时，若把轨迹方向颠倒，情景似乎完全相同。在真实台面上，球体因摩擦而减速；而在真空中，原子则无摩擦地滑行，从而实现了完美可逆性。然而，热力学却揭示了根本上不可逆过程。热量自然从高温物体流向低温物体，封闭系统熵不会减少。虽然理论力学可能不区分过去和未来，但热力学证实了我们对时间方向性的本能感知。
en: Tracing the paths of two colliding billiard balls, the scenario appears identical if the paths are reversed. On a real table, balls decelerate due to friction, whereas atoms glide without friction through space, allowing perfect reversibility. However, thermodynamics has uncovered fundamentally irreversible processes. Heat naturally flows from hot to cold bodies, and the entropy of closed systems does not decrease. While theoretical mechanics may not differentiate between past and future, thermodynamics confirms our innate sense of time’s directionality.
body.review: 底本写closed systems（封闭系统）的熵不减；此处保留原措辞。该说法没有在此句中明示隔离条件，不将原书措辞静默改为isolated systems。

zh: 热力学最初是一门经验科学，源于生产实践需求。
致力于完善蒸汽机工程师们是其最初推动力。用马克思话来说，这是一门由新的物质生产方式驱动科学。作为资本主义工业节省劳动时间冲动产物，热力学断言了时间方向不可抗拒客观性。鉴于此，热原子论面临挑战在于证明，力学定律本身就使时间指针指向未来。
en: Thermodynamics starts as an empirical science, an outgrowth of the practical needs of production.

Engineers perfecting steam engines were its initial impulse. It was, in Marx’s terms, a science driven by the new mode of material production. A child of capitalist industry’s drive to economize on labour time, thermodynamics asserted the inexorable objectivity of time’s direction. Given this, the challenge for the atomic theory of heat was to demonstrate that the laws of mechanics themselves set time’s compass pointing to the future.

zh: 汤姆森——上文曾提及他指出了时间理论可逆性——对此给出如下解释。
en: Thomson, whose pointing out of the theoretical reversibility of time is cited above, gave an explanation in the following way.

zh: 他没有去探讨时间可逆性更复杂实例——例如瀑布倒流或摩擦力逆向作用——而是选择聚焦于更简单热传导案例。他提出，设想一根金属棒，左侧温度均匀而较热，右侧温度均匀而较冷，且整体被完美隔热层包裹。随着时间推移，热量会扩散到整根金属棒，最终导致从一端到另一端温度保持一致。
en: Instead of exploring the more complex instances of time reversal, such as waterfalls flowing in reverse or friction working backwards, he chose to focus on the simpler case of heat transfer. Imagine a metal bar, he proposed, uniformly heated on the left side and uniformly cooled on the right, all encased in perfect insulation. Over time, the heat would spread throughout the bar, eventually leading to a consistent temperature from one end to the other.

zh: 他承认，尽管当时人们普遍认为金属棒中热量源于其原子运动，但在1875 年，物理学界对原子在金属内部振动机制尚不完全了解。他设想了一个由带小孔的可透过隔板隔开腔体，腔内分别充有热气和冷气。如果能远程控制这些小孔开闭，左侧高速热分子将穿过隔膜，而右侧低速冷分子则会从右向左通过。这种交换将使两侧分子平均速度趋于平衡。
en: He acknowledges that while it was accepted that heat in a bar of metal was due to the motion of the bar’s atoms, in 1875, physics had an imperfect understanding of how atoms vibrated within metal. He proposed a cavity with warm and cold gas, separated by a permeable barrier with small holes. If these holes could be opened or closed remotely, hot fast molecules from the left would pass through the barrier, while cold slow ones would pass from right to left. This exchange would equalize the average speeds of the molecules on both sides.

zh: 汤姆森明确考虑的是有限系统，其中气体分子数量是固定的。但他有限系统仍涉及数量极其庞大分子：例如，其中一个例子中就包含8,000,000,000,000 个氮分子。我们将用数量少得多的分子——仅80 个——来说明这一原理。我们不考虑分子在三维空间中以不同速度自由运动情况，而是采用一个更简单模型。我们将运动限制在二维空间内，以便绘制简单示意图。进一步把分子运动方向限定为上下或左右，并假设速率均为常数。换言之，我们将对模型自由度进行量子化，或减少其数量，从而得到所谓“格子气模型”。
en: Thompson was explicitly considering finite systems, with fixed numbers of gas molecules. But his finite systems still involved very large numbers of molecules: 8,000,000,000,000 molecules of nitrogen in one example. We shall illustrate the principle with much smaller numbers: just eighty molecules. Instead of looking at molecules moving freely in three dimensions at varying velocities, we will take a much simpler model. We will restrict the motion to two dimensions to allow us to draw simple pictures. We will further restrict the directions of motion of the molecules to be either up/down or left/right and assume velocities are constant. In other words, we will quantize or reduce the number of degrees of freedom of the model, obtaining what is termed a lattice gas model.
body.review: 本段底本拼作Thompson，前后文作Thomson；中文按同一人物统一为汤姆森，英文保留底本拼写。

zh: 这些简单格子模型已被证明足以满足许多实际需求——例如空气动力学计算机模拟。
平面格子气模型由于涉及镶嵌结构，可以是六边形格子，也可以是我们将要使用直角格子（图5.4）。在这两种类型中，其行为均由一组规则来规定，这些规则把进入格子粒子与离开格子粒子联系起来，从而满足质量、动量和能量守恒。本例中将使用规则在图5.3 中以示意图形式展示。
en: These simple lattice models have been proven to be adequate for many practical purposes – computer simulation of aerodynamics being an example.

Lattice gas models for the plane, since they involve tessellation, can either be hexagonal or the right-angle one we will use (Figure 5.4). In both types, the behaviour is specified by a set of rules that relate incoming particles on the lattice to outgoing ones in such a way as to conserve mass, momentum and energy. The rules we will use in this example are displayed diagrammatically in Figure 5.3.

zh: 格子气模型便于高效地进行数字模拟。作者们为此专门构建了专用计算机。
由于这些模型处理的是以恒定速率运动粒子，我们无法像汤姆森最初例子那样模拟温度差，但可以通过压力差来阐释一个类似、实质上不可逆过程。
en: Lattice gas models lend themselves to efficient digital implementation. The authors have constructed specialized machines for this purpose.

Since they work with particles moving at constant velocities, we cannot model temperature differences as in Thomson’s original example, but we can illustrate a similar effectively irreversible process using pressure differences.

zh: 请看图5.4。你可以看到，最初有序状态最终演变为气体原子以看似随机方式分布在格子区域内（图5.4.b）。
en: Look at Figure 5.4. You can see how initial order ends up with gas atoms spread through the area of lattice in what appears to be a random fashion(Figure 5.4.b).

zh: 这两幅图生动地阐释了熵增概念。图（a）描绘了一种高度有序状态，所有八十个原子都位于左侧，并向右或向下运动。图（b）则显示这些原子已分散在整个区域内，在动量方面，它们向任何方向（上、下、左或右）运动概率均等。
en: The two images effectively illustrate the concept of increasing entropy. Image (a) depicts a highly ordered state with all eighty atoms positioned to the left, moving either right or down. Image (b) shows these atoms spread out across the area and, in terms of momentum, with an equal likelihood of moving in any direction—up, down, left or right.

zh: 一旦原子在格子状态中随机分布，在后续观测中发现它们全都位于同一侧概率就微乎其微。如果我们在过程进行时记录左侧原子数量（图5.5），会发现左侧原子数起初为80，但很快演变为在40附近不规则地振荡。
en: Once the atoms are randomly distributed among lattice states, the chances of finding them all on one side upon further observation are exceedingly slim. If we record how many atoms were on the left as the process proceeds (Figure 5.5), we see the left count starts at eighty but rapidly evolves to oscillate noisily around forty.

zh: 格子气简单状态结构使其便于进行概率分析。图5.4 中快照是在原子离开格子节点时拍摄。共有80 个格子位置可供原子离开，每个格子节点离开原子数在0 到4 之间。
en: The simple state structure of lattice gases lends them to easy probability analysis. The snapshots in Figure 5.4 are taken as atoms leave lattice nodes. There are eighty lattice positions from which atoms can depart, and each lattice node can have between zero and four atoms leaving it.

zh: 图5.3 矩形二维格子气系统的演化规则。每个灰色矩形代表一条规则，指示入射与出射分子的配置，并保持物质、能量和动量守恒。作者绘图。
每个灰框中双箭头左侧为入射配置，右侧为出射配置；细箭头表示粒子运动方向。
en: Figure 5.3 The evolution rules of a rectangular 2D lattice gas system are illustrated, with each grey rectangle representing a rule indicating the configuration of incoming and outgoing molecules, conserving matter, energy and momentum. Figure by authors.

如果暗能量确实存在，相空间因而不断膨胀，那么即使宇宙具有无限的年龄，也不会出现回归。

Suppose you had the physical apparatus we built in the 1990s that could update a lattice gas twenty million times a second, then you would have to run it for around 150,000 years to have a good chance of the gas molecules all returning simultaneously to the left-hand side. This is with a tiny number of atoms. Thomson in his examples assumed vastly greater numbers 8,000,000,000,000 molecules, and these molecules had much more freedom of movement. They could move in any direction and at a continuous range of velocities. In such an example, the chances of all molecules ending up on one side would be so low that it would not have occurred in what we now estimate to be the entire duration of the universe.
If dark energy is real, and phase space consequently expands remorselessly, then even the age of an infinite universe is not going to give us recurrence.

zh: 图5.4 尺寸为5×165的气体格子。泪滴形状表示运动方向。格子气最初处于低熵配置：所有原子都在左侧，且只具有四种可能原子动量状态中的两种。经过1,000个时间步，原子均匀分布。作者绘图。
（a）初始状态；（b）经过1,000个时间步后的状态。
en: Figure 5.4 Gas lattice of dimension 5 × 165. Motion is indicated by the teardrop shape. The lattice gas is initially configured in a low-entropy state, with all atoms on the left side and only two of four possible atomic momentum states. After 1,000 time steps, the atoms are evenly distributed. Figure by authors.

zh: 因此，从一团空气极有序状态出发——无论是从温度角度，还是从氧分子和氮分子相对分布角度来看（因为汤姆森同时举了这两个例子）——在允许其自由演化之后，重新回到那种有序状态可能性微乎其微。
en: So, starting from a very ordered state of a volume of air, whether in terms of temperature or in terms of relative distribution of the oxygen and nitrogen molecules, for Thomson used both examples, a return to that order after it was allowed to freely evolve is vanishing unlikely.

zh: 因此，诸如热量从高温向低温流动等理论过程，可以以一种与牛顿原子运动相容方式得到解释。然而，汤姆森所描述机械逆转可能性，引发了一个问题：如果原子在达到平衡后突然逆转运动，会发生什么？
en: Theoretical processes, such as heat flow from hot to cold, are thus explained in a way compatible with Newtonian atomic motion. However, the possibility of mechanical reversal, as described by Thomson, raises questions about what would happen if atoms’ motion suddenly reversed after reaching equilibrium.

zh: 图5.5 起初，八十个原子全在左侧。系统趋于较高熵的状态，左侧原子数围绕四十这一均值振荡，即约一半原子处于空间的左半部。这种熵涨落是汤姆森论证的一个依据。作者绘图。
图题：空间左半部的原子数；纵轴Number of atoms：原子数；横轴Time step：时间步。
en: Figure 5.5 At the start, all eighty atoms are on the left. The system settles to a higher entropy state with oscillations around a mean of forty, with around half of the atoms in the left half of the space. This entropy fluctuation is a basis for Thomson’s argument. Figure by authors.

zh: 此前发生碰撞和扩散现在必须“倒转”进行。经过与最初扩散过程完全相同时间后，系统必须恢复到初始状态：左侧是高温、高速分子，右侧是低温、低速分子，只不过此时所有分子运动方向都必须与之前相反。同样地，如果我们在格子气模拟中于第1,001 步应用图5.3 中逆向规则，并重复此操作1,000 次，那么所有原子最终都会聚集在左侧。但这一次，所有动量都将指向左侧或向上。秩序将从无序中重现。
en: The collisions and diffusion that had previously occurred must now play backwards. After the exact same time that the diffusion had originally taken, the initial starting point must be recovered with hot, fast molecules to the left and cold, slow ones to the right, except that in each case now, the movements must be in the reverse sense. Similarly, were we in our lattice gas simulation to apply the inverse rules of Figure 5.3 at step 1,001 and continue doing this 1,000 times then all our atoms would end up on the left. But this time all momenta would be towards the left or upwards. Order would have been recreated from disorder.

zh: 然而，这种回归“伊甸园”前景极其敏感。只要改变图（b）中一个原子动量，应用反向演化规则就无法重现图（a）状态，而是会产生另一种原子四处散乱、看似无序状态。此外，即使反转操作完美无缺，结果也只是昙花一现：
en: But this prospect of a return to Eden is exquisitely sensitive. Change the momentum of one atom in picture (b), and the application of the reversed evolution rules will fail to recreate picture (a), yielding instead another apparently disordered state with atoms all over the place. Moreover, even should the reversal work perfectly, the result would be evanescent:

zh: 现在假设在开始后某个时刻，温度已大致达到平衡，并让每个粒子运动瞬间发生逆转。每个分子将沿其原路径回溯，而在与最初时间间隔相等第二个时间间隔结束时，每个分子将处于与起始时相同位置，并以相同速度运动；因此，将再次出现最初给定不均匀温度分布，唯一区别在于每个粒子都朝着与其初始运动方向相反方向运动。这一差异不会妨碍随后立即开始均化过程；尽管各分子运动轨迹完全不同，但平均而言，该过程将遵循与系统最初被置于自发状态后立即发生情况相同规律。
en: Suppose now the temperature to have become thus very approximately equalised at a certain time from the beginning, and let the motion of every particle become instantaneously reversed. Each molecule will retrace its former path, and at the end of a second interval of time, equal to the former, every molecule will be in the same position, and moving with the same velocity, as at the beginning; so that the given initial unequal distribution of temperature will again be found, with only the difference that each particle is moving in the direction reverse to that of its initial motion. This difference will not prevent an instantaneous subsequent commencement of equalisation, which, with entirely different paths for the individual molecules, will go on in the average according to the same law as that which took place immediately after the system was first left to itself.

zh: 因此，根据汤姆森观点，我们将得到一种时间对称性（图5.6）。从我们通常时间方向来看，气体从熵低、概率小状态向熵高、概率大状态运动。如果我们把所有运动方向逆转，它将从熵高状态演化回熵低状态，但随后会穿过熵低状态，并再次进入概率更大熵高状态。
en: So, according to Thomson, we would have a time symmetry(Figure 5.6). Viewed from the perspective of our normal time direction, the gas moves from a low-entropy improbable state to a high entropy probable state. If we reverse all motions, it evolves back from high entropy to low entropy, but would then pass through the low-entropy state and again move into a more probable high entropy state.

zh: 既然热力学时间之箭具有这种更深层次时间对称性，那么它究竟意味着什么？
en: What does the thermodynamic arrow of time then amount to, given that it possesses this deeper time symmetry?

zh: 回顾图5.6。从时间10 开始，所有原子运动都发生逆转，因此系统以逆向方式重演其历史，直到时间20，它到达了时间0状态的镜像。
由于时间20 这种低熵状态本质上是不太可能出现，因此极有可能，从时间20开始，该系统将演化为一种更无序状态。但这一论点隐含了时间0 之前“前史”。
en: Look back at Figure 5.6. From time 10, all atomic motions reverse, so the system recapitulates its history in reverse until time 20, it arrives at a mirror image

of its state at time 0. Since this low-entropy state at time 20 is inherently improbable, the overwhelming likelihood is that from time 20 on the system evolves into a more disordered state. But this argument implies the prehistory before time 0.

zh: 根据力学定律时间对称性，时间-1 状态必须是时间21 状态镜像。A 时段是D 时段镜像。因此，可以推断时间-1 和时间21 熵必须相同，而通过归纳法，在通向时间0的A时段内，熵本应呈下降趋势！
en: By the time symmetry of the laws of mechanics, the state at time −1 must be the mirror image of that at time 21. Period A is the reflection of period D. As such, the entropy must be inferred to be the same at time −1 and time 21, and by induction, the entropy for period A leading up to time 0

zh: 因此，把时间不对称归因于概率解释并非最终的答案。如果我们假设一个孤立系统当前处于低熵状态，那么它在一小时后处于高熵状态确实很可能。但同样，一小时前它处于比现在更高熵状态也必然很可能。
en: So the explanation that time asymmetry arises from probability turns out not to be final. If we assume that an isolated system is in a low-entropy state now, then it is indeed probable that it will be in a higher entropy state in an hour’s time. But it must also be probable that an hour ago it was in a higher entropy state than it is now.

zh: 图5.6 汤姆森所描述的有限系统的时间演化。时间0时，系统处于低熵状态，随后向熵增加的方向演化。时间10时，所有粒子的运动方向被逆转。系统于是演化回原来的低熵状态，并在时间20到达该状态。此后熵再次增加，但在微观层面沿着一条不同的路径演化。作者绘图。

en: Figure 5.6 The time evolution of a finite system as described by Thomson. At time 0, the system is in a low-entropy state and evolves towards increasing entropy. At time 10, all particle motions are reversed. The system now evolves back to its original low-entropy state, attaining it at time 20. Entropy then starts to increase again but follows, at the microscopic level, a different path. Figure by authors.

zh: 如果你有一个像格子气那样有限模型系统，它遵循对称动力学定律（这些定律具有守恒性质），那么你确实会观察到这样的景象。如果我们将逆演化规则对图5.4.a 应用1,000 次，就会得到一幅看似随机的图c，其中原子分布于整个体积中。对图c应用正向规则，最终又会回到图5.4.a。把这一概念推广到宏观层面时，其蕴含意义令人不安。我们是否应该根据概率推断：一秒钟前世界中那个看似不太可能出现低熵状态，很可能是在两秒钟前一个高熵状态之后才出现？
en: If you had a finite model system like a lattice gas that evolves under symmetrical dynamical laws, ones which have conservative properties, that is indeed what you would observe. If we applied reverse evolution rules 1,000 times to picture 5.4.a, we would get an apparently random picture
with atoms throughout the volume. Apply the forward rules to picture

and we would end up again with picture 5.4.a. When applying this concept globally, the implications are unsettling. Should we infer, based on probability, that a seemingly improbable low-entropy state of the world one second ago was likely preceded by a higher entropy state two seconds prior?

zh: 认为当前熵增加源于几秒钟或几天前一瞬间低熵状态——而在那之前时间曾逆向流动——这种观点是否合理？
en: Is it plausible to believe that the current rise in entropy originates from a fleeting low-entropy condition a few seconds or days earlier, before which time flowed in reverse?

zh: 难道我们对过去记忆仅仅是虚幻？汤姆森关于封闭系统的论点似乎暗示了这种可能性。他说，在熵减阶段（时间从-10 到0，或从10 到20 之间，见图5.6），意识会发生逆转。
en: Could it be that our recollections of the past are merely deceptive? Thomson’s argument about closed systems would seem to imply this possibility. He says that during an entropy-reducing phase (times −10 to 0 or times 10 to 20 in Figure 5.6) consciousness would reverse.

zh: 如果关于生命唯物主义假说也是正确的，那么生物将向后生长，虽然对未来有清醒认知，却对过去毫无记忆，并会重新回到未出生状态。
en: if also the materialistic hypothesis of life were true, living creatures would grow backwards, with conscious knowledge of the future, but no memory of the past, and would become again unborn.

zh: 我们会知道未来，但因记住了它，便以为那是过去。
en: We would know the future but, remembering it, think it was the past.

zh: 他回避了“这种情况正在发生”这一结论，因为他说自己只是在考虑有限且孤立系统。他谨慎指出，这并不适用于与宇宙其余部分相互作用系统：
en: He avoids the conclusion that this is happening because he says he was just considering finite and isolated systems. He is careful to state that it does not apply to systems communicating with the rest of the universe:

zh: 关于热传导这一众所周知古老定律，有一种奇怪却真实理解：即在1,000 年时间里，一根铁棒一半自行比另一半升温一度可能性极小；而且，这一现象在1,000,000 年内发生概率，是1,000 年内发生概率1,000 倍，并且在极其漫长时间内肯定会发生。但须记住，我们假设这根铁棒表面覆盖着一层不透热的漆层。若摒弃这一不可能理想假设，并认为宇宙中分子数量是无限；那么我们便可断言，除非有外部热源或冷源作用，否则铁棒一半温度永远不会高于另一半。这一实例足以阐明能量耗散理论所依据哲学基础。
en: It is a strange but a true conception of the old well-known law of the conduction of heat to say that it is very improbable that in the course of 1,000 years one half the bar of iron shall of itself become warmer by a degree than the other half; and that the probability of this happening before 1,000,000 years pass is 1,000 tines as great as that it will happen in the course of 1,000 years, and that it certainly will happen in the course of some very long time. But let it be remembered that we have supposed the bar to be covered with an impermeable varnish. Do away with this impossible ideal, believe number of molecules in the universe to be infinite ; then we may say one half of the bar will never become warmer than the other, except by the agency of external sources of heat or cold. This one instance suffices to explain the philosophy of the foundation on which the theory of the dissipation of energy rests.

zh: 在上述对汤姆森1875 年论文论述中，我们的评注自由采用了“概率较低状态熵值较低”这一概念。这一结论证明归功于玻尔兹曼1872 年论文（译为
），他在其中通过统计学论证证明了封闭系统中熵必然趋于增大。
1876 年，玻尔兹曼挚友洛施密特提出了与汤姆森类似的可逆性论点，
他在其中明确指出，如图5.6 所示，若粒子运动方向发生逆转，则熵必然减小。
en: In the account of Thomson’s 1875 paper above, our commentary has freely used the notion that less probable states have lower entropy. Proof of this was due to Boltzmann’s paper of 1872 (translated as
) in which he proved in terms of statistical arguments that the entropy in a closed system must tend to increase.
In 1876, Boltzmann’s close friend Loschmidt made a similar reversibility argument to Thomson
where he explicitly pointed out that in the event of particle reversal then entropy must decrease as shown in Figure 5.6.

zh: 玻尔兹曼1872 年证明中关键细节基于这样一个假设：当气体中两个分子（A和B）在位置
发生碰撞时，每个分子到达位置
的概率在统计上相互独立
。但在两个分子刚刚碰撞之后，它们位置和速度并非相互独立。碰撞这一行为使得它们位置产生相关性——它们必须非常接近彼此才会发生碰撞。
en: The fine detail of Boltzmann’s 1872 proof rested on the assumption that when two molecules (A and B) of a gas collided at location
, the probability that each molecule would arrive at position
was statistically independent.

But immediately after two molecules collide, their position and velocities are not independent. The act of collision has correlated both their positions – they must have been very close to one another to collide.

zh: 如果把图5.6 中时间10 时所有运动方向逆转，那么分子运动就绝对不是相互独立。它们运动已被预先确定为恰好能使系统返回起始位置。在这种情况下，玻尔兹曼用来推导时间箭头假设就被违背了，时间箭头可能会逆转——熵可能会随时间而减小。
en: If you reverse all motions at time 10 in Figure 5.6, then the motions of the molecules are most definitely not independent. They are predetermined to be exactly such as will return the system to its starting position. In that case, the assumption that Boltzmann had relied upon to deduce an arrow of time is violated, and the time arrow could reverse – entropy could decline with time.

zh: 但我们确实把熵增加作为经验事实所经历。如何从宇宙本质及其初始状态角度来解释这一点呢？
en: But we do experience a rise in entropy as an empirical given. How is one to explain this in terms of the nature of the universe and its initial state?

zh: 我们有两种设想可供选择。一种假设是，整个宇宙目前正处于一种极不可能状态。然而，也可以设想，这种不大可能的状态持续漫长岁月，以及从这里到天狼星距离，与宇宙年龄和规模相比都微不足道。因此，在这个整体上处于热平衡状态（因而已“死亡”）宇宙中，必定存在一些大小与我们银河系相当相对较小区域（我们称之为“世界”），它们在相对短暂的漫长年代里会显著偏离热平衡状态。在这些“世界”中，状态概率增加与减少同样频繁。对于宇宙整体而言，时间两个方向是无法区分，正如在空间中没有“上”与“下”之分。然而，正如在地球表面某个地点，我们可以把指向地球中心方向称为“下”，同样，处于某个“世界”中、处于特定时间段生物，可以把时间方向定义为从概率较低状态向概率较高状态发展（前者即“过去”，后者即“未来”），并基于这一定义，它会发现这个与宇宙其余部分隔离小区域，“最初”总是处于一种概率较低状态。在我看来，这种观点似乎是理解热力学第二定律及每个独立世界热寂现象有效性唯一途径，而无需假设整个宇宙从一个确定初始状态单向演变为最终状态。有人提出异议，认为为了解释一小部分世界生命状态，而把宇宙如此大一部分设想为“死亡”状态，这种做法既不经济也毫无意义——我认为这一异议站不住脚。我至今仍清楚记得，曾有人坚决不相信太阳可能距离地球2000 万英里，其理由是：难以想象竟会有如此广阔空间仅充满以太，而生命却如此稀少。
en: One has the choice of two kinds of pictures. One can assume that the entire universe finds itself at present in a very improbable state. However, one may suppose that the eons during which this improbable state lasts, and the distance from here to Sirius, are minute compared to the age and size of the universe. There must then be in the universe, which is in thermal equilibrium as a whole and therefore dead, here and there relatively small regions of the size of our galaxy ( which we call worlds ), which during the relatively short time of eons deviate significantly from thermal equilibrium. Among these worlds the state probability increases as often as it decreases. For the universe as a whole, the two directions of time are indistinguishable, just as in space there is no up or down. However, just as at a certain place on the Earth’s surface we can call ‘down’ the direction towards the centre of the Earth, so a living being that finds itself in such a world at a certain period of time can define the time direction as going from less probable to more probable states ( the former will be the ‘past’ the latter the ‘future’) and by virtue of this definition he will find that this small region, isolated from the rest of the universe, is ‘initially’ always in an improbable state. This viewpoint seems to me to be the only way one can understand the validity of the second law and the heat death of each individual world without without invoking an unidirectional change of the entire universe from a definite initial state to to a final state. The objection that it is uneconomical and hence senseless to imaging such a large part of the universe as being dead in order to explain why a small part is living – this objection I consider invalid. I remember only too well a person who absolutely refused to believe that the Sun could be 20 million miles from the Earth, on the grounds that it is inconceivable that there could be so much of space filled only with aether and so little with life.

zh: 现代物理学通常直接接受这样观点：整个宇宙始于一次熵值较低大爆炸——即玻尔兹曼所提出第一个备选方案。
但关于其第二个备选方案变体——即存在多个局部区域或“岛屿宇宙”——至今仍在讨论之中。
现代“热寂”情景涉及恒星坍缩成黑洞，最终蒸发为辐射。
en: Modern physics generally just accepts that the whole universe just started in a low entropy big bang – the first of Boltzmann’s alternatives.
But variants of his second alternative, with multiple local regions or island universes, are still discussed.
Modern ‘heat death’ scenarios involve stars collapsing into black holes, which eventually evaporate to radiation.

zh: 玻尔兹曼对熵阐释可用于解释结构最初如何形成。卢克莱修把此归因于“clinamen”（即原子的不可预测偏转）。卢克莱修设想原子最初处于“下落”状态，因此他假设它们沿着平行向下轨迹运动。如今我们知道，正如玻尔兹曼所言，“在太空中没有上下之分”。因此，我们不能假设初始状态下存在平行下落。据推测，最初大爆炸没有优先方向，而仅仅是一团由电子、质子、中子和电磁辐射（光子）组成物质。这些物质相当于卢克莱修所写“corpora”（即“第一体”）。

or unpredictable swerve of atoms. Lucretius envisaged the atoms as initially ‘falling’, so he assumed parallel downward paths. We now know that, as Boltzmann said, ‘in space there is no up or down’. So we cannot assume initial parallel falling. The initial big bang is assumed to have had no preferred direction, but just a mass of electrons, protons, neutrons and electromagnetic radiation (photons). These were equivalent to the
or first bodies of which Lucretius wrote.

en: If we assume these were in thermal equilibrium, which the relative uniformity of the cosmic background radiation suggests, then the problem that Lucretius faced remains. What brought the ‘first bodies’ together?

zh: 弗劳奇
关于秩序源于混沌的论证，依赖于玻尔兹曼本人尚不知道的几项知识：亚原子粒子、α粒子的结合能以及爱因斯坦的质能等价关系。这些发现都出现在玻尔兹曼自杀早逝后的二十年内；倘若他没有自杀，我们有理由认为他本可以亲眼见到这些发现。自玻尔兹曼发表最初那篇论文以来的一个半世纪中，他的思想得到了日益广泛的应用。我们对信息、
经济
乃至引力

en: Frautschi’s

demonstration of order from chaos relies upon several things that Boltzmann himself did not know: sub-atomic particles, the binding energy of α particles, Einstein’s mass-energy equivalence. All were discovered within two decades of Boltzmann’s premature death by suicide, in the absence of which he might reasonably be expected to have seen them. In the century and a half since Boltzmann’s original paper, the application of his ideas have spread. Our understanding of information,
the economy
and even gravity
have been shown to be derivable from his statistical theory of entropy.
